title: Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Specialist, AWS Security
description:
Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information regarding security clearances please visit (https://www.agsva.gov.au/).

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud service provider, providing virtualised infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers all over the world. AWS runs a globally distributed environment, operating at massive levels of scale. Businesses, from start-ups to enterprises to large government customers, run their operations and applications on AWS’ highly secure infrastructure.

AWS Security is looking for a GRC Specialist to contribute to the certification, accreditation, assurance, and authorisation activities across the security program. The successful candidate is a problem-solver, quick-study, with a broad understanding of the regulatory landscape, cloud technologies, experience in security and compliance.


Key job responsibilities
* Serve as the GRC Specialist for designated (physical and/or logical) components within the cloud capability, to perform assurance and authorization activities to ensure adherence to standards and protocols.
* Collaborate with internal teams and customers to establish baselines and level-set the security requirements, security controls, and security objectives.
* Implement ISM, PSPF, DSPF, ASIO T4, NIST and/or other security compliance frameworks into design and build baselines to achieve the agreed security posture.
* Create, optimise, and support cross-functional working groups and projects aimed at enhancing security efficiency and effectiveness across the organization.
* Utilise domain expertise to develop thought leadership material on cloud and emerging technologies, contributing to the organization’s knowledge base and industry positioning.
* Deliver to tight deadlines and drive results, demonstrating exceptional attention to detail and ensuring accuracy in all aspects of security management.


A day in the life
In your day-to-day you will need to exercise sound judgment in making trade-offs between short versus long term security and business goals. You will demonstrate resilience and navigate difficult situations with composure and tact, with a goal to achieve a great outcome for the customer. You will be successful in this role by regularly analysing your own performance with a critical eye. A broad understanding of the AWS business and its interconnections is required. This position will also provide training, advice, and mentorship to other teams throughout AWS.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

The team is comprised of security professionals with a cross section of national security and private sector experience, providing a range of perspectives required for creative problem solving. We value diversity of thought, creativity, and a strong Bias for Action and Earn Trust. We believe that there are no "perfect" security solutions and we develop and iterate using a continuous improvement process.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Systems Administrator, Senior
description:
Overview

The Work

The Systems Administrator, Senior will be administering, optimizing, and troubleshooting computer systems, including Windows and UNIX systems (Linux or Solaris), ensuring optimal performance and reliability. You will be responsible for leading initiatives, collaborating with vendors, overseeing system requirements for multiple projects, and ensuring compliance with client guidelines.

This position aligns with Cayuse’s core values of Innovation, Excellence, Collaboration, Adaptability, and Integrity by fostering technical solutions that meet customer needs, promoting teamwork, and prioritizing quality in deliverables.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the setup, configuration, and operational activities for mainframe, mini, or client/server-based business systems.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) in managing operating systems such as Windows or UNIX (Linux and Solaris).
  • Plan, implement, and manage custom system solutions to meet organizational needs.
  • Continuously monitor, analyze, and optimize system operations and resource utilization.
  • Conduct system capacity planning to ensure scalability and performance.
  • Analyze system faults; identify root causes and resolve technical issues.
  • Perform diagnostic tests and engage in detailed problem analysis for hardware and operating systems.
  • Collaborate with vendors during troubleshooting and resolve complex technical problems.
  • Evaluate, install, and manage software during various phases of testing and production.
  • Conduct thorough reviews and prepare clear and accurate documentation for system testing, software installation, and configuration.
  • Design and execute preventive maintenance plans to ensure system integrity and availability.
  • Proactively address system and environment-related issues to minimize downtime.
  • Collaborate with business units to determine system/environment requirements for multiple projects, ensuring alignment with project timelines.
  • Coordinate effectively with vendors to ensure resolution of technical issues and perform updates as necessary.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Qualifications – Here’s What You Need

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 6–8 years of related experience or Master’s Degree with 2–6 years of experience.
  • Considerable experience in configuring and administering Windows and UNIX systems (Linux or Solaris).
  • DoD 8140-compliant certifications (e.g., IAT Level II credentials).
  • Top-Secret Clearance is required.
  • Must be able to pass a background check. May require additional background checks as required by projects and/or clients at any time during employment.

Minimum Skills:

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate in a clear, professional, and articulate manner.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with high-level attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast past environment with changing priorities; adaptable to change and a quick learner.
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well independently as well as on a multi-functional team.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately
  • Proficient in MS Office, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in analyzing system faults, running diagnostic tests, and optimizing complex systems for operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrated expertise in system capacity planning and resource utilization analysis across multiple systems.
  • Familiarity with system configuration and documentation processes for software installations and testing.
  • Proven ability to administer systems with varying schedules for multi-project environments.
  • Exceptional troubleshooting, problem-solving, and decision-making skills for systems and environments of varying complexity.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to interface effectively with internal teams and external vendors.

Our Commitment to you / overview of benefits

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance; Wellness Program
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability options
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance (Company Provided)
  • Voluntary Life and AD&D options
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with matching after one year
  • Paid Time Off

Reports to: Program Manager

Working Conditions

  • Professional office environment, with the ability to work onsite in the main office.
  • Must be physically and mentally able to perform duties extended periods of time.
  • Ability to use a computer and other office productivity tools with sufficient speed to meet the demands of this position.
  • May require lifting and moving hardware equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Some tasks may involve standing, bending, or working in confined technical spaces.
  • Must be able to establish a productive and professional workspace.
  • Must be able to sit for long periods of time looking at computer screen.
  • May be asked to work a flexible schedule which may include holidays.
  • May be asked to travel for business or professional development purposes.
  • May be asked to work hours outside of normal business hours.

Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Cayuse is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, skills, and abilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with any applicable federal, state, or local law.

description:

Sign-On Bonus! *Applicable to external candidates only

title: Chief Information Officer
description:
ABOUT BENNETT COLLEGE:
Founded in 1873, Bennett College is a historically Black liberal arts college for women located in Greensboro, North Carolina. For more than 150 years, Bennett has empowered women through transformative education grounded in leadership, social justice, innovation, and service. As one of only two historically Black colleges for women in the United States, Bennett College prepares students to become intellectually engaged, globally aware, and socially responsible leaders who positively impact their communities and professions.
Bennett College fosters an inclusive and collaborative campus culture that values academic excellence, student success, technological innovation, and continuous institutional improvement. Employees are expected to support the College's mission while contributing to an environment of integrity, accountability, and excellence.
GENERAL SUMMARY:
The Chief Information Officer (CIO) serves as the College's senior technology executive and provides visionary leadership for the strategic planning, implementation, management, security, and continuous improvement of the institution's information technology infrastructure, enterprise systems, digital transformation initiatives, and cybersecurity programs.
Reporting directly to the President and serving as a member of the President's Executive Leadership Team, the CIO partners with academic and administrative leaders to develop innovative technology strategies that advance teaching and learning, student success, institutional effectiveness, operational excellence, and long-term organizational sustainability. The CIO provides executive oversight for all Information Technology functions, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking, cloud technologies, telecommunications, instructional technology, user support services, data governance, and emerging technologies. The position provides leadership and direction to Information Technology staff, including directors, managers, systems administrators, network engineers, information security personnel, help desk staff, database administrators, technology support specialists, and other departmental personnel.
The CIO is responsible for establishing a comprehensive technology roadmap aligned with the College's strategic priorities while ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient technology services across the institution. As a strategic advisor to the President, Cabinet, and Board of Trustees, the CIO champions innovation, responsible technology governance, and data-informed decision-making to support Bennett College's mission and long-term success.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Strategic Technology Leadership
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive institutional technology strategy aligned with Bennett College’s mission and Strategic Plan.
  • Serve as the principal advisor to the President and Executive Leadership Team on technology trends, risks, investments, and innovation.
  • Provide executive leadership in digital transformation initiatives that enhance institutional effectiveness and operational efficiency.
  • Develop short- and long-range technology plans supporting academic excellence, enrollment growth, student engagement, and administrative effectiveness.
  • Lead institution-wide technology governance and strategic prioritization of technology initiatives.
  • Leadership of a formal Technology Governance Committee.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the Information Technology division.
Information Technology Operations
  • Direct all aspects of the College’s technology infrastructure including servers, storage, cloud platforms, wireless networks, telecommunications, and enterprise applications.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of all institutional technology services.
  • Oversee implementation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of enterprise technology systems.
  • Ensure technology services effectively support classroom instruction, hybrid learning, online education, research, and administrative operations.
  • Establish service delivery standards and continuously improve customer service across campus.
  • Strengthen institutional data strategy, analytics, and business intelligence responsibilities.
Cybersecurity, Risk Management & Compliance
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive institutional cybersecurity strategy.
  • Lead cybersecurity governance, threat detection, vulnerability management, and incident response planning.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal and state regulations including FERPA, GLBA, PCI-DSS, HIPAA (where applicable), and other information security standards.
  • Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity, backup strategies, and emergency technology preparedness.
  • Conduct regular institutional technology risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Promote cybersecurity awareness through ongoing education and training initiatives.
  • Regular reporting of technology risk, cybersecurity posture, and strategic initiatives to the Board of Trustees.
Enterprise Systems & Digital Transformation
  • Provide executive oversight for the College’s ERP, CRM, learning management systems, financial systems, HRIS, and student information systems.
  • Partner with campus stakeholders to optimize enterprise technology solutions that improve institutional effectiveness.
  • Lead technology modernization efforts through automation, cloud adoption, systems integration, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies.
  • Champion data-driven decision-making through effective business intelligence, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
Academic Technology & Student Success
  • Collaborate with Academic Affairs to enhance instructional technology and innovative teaching practices.
  • Ensure technology resources effectively support faculty, students, researchers, and staff.
  • Promote equitable access to technology resources that improve student engagement and academic achievement.
  • Support technology initiatives that enhance student recruitment, retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
Data Governance & Institutional Effectiveness
  • Establish institutional standards for data governance, integrity, accessibility, privacy, and security.
  • Collaborate with Institutional Effectiveness and Enrollment Management to improve reporting, analytics, and decision support.
  • Promote responsible data stewardship across all divisions.
  • Ensure enterprise data supports strategic planning, accreditation, compliance reporting, and operational excellence.
  • Responsible for institutional AI strategy, governance, and responsible use of emerging technologies.
Budget & Resource Management
  • Develop, administer, and monitor the Information Technology operating and capital budgets.
  • Identify cost-effective technology investments while maximizing institutional resources.
  • Lead technology procurement, contract negotiations, vendor management, and software licensing.
  • Monitor return on investment for technology initiatives.
  • Pursue external funding opportunities and technology partnerships when appropriate.
Leadership & Personnel Management

title: Senior Director of Clubhouse
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Director of Clubhouse is a key member of HALI’s senior leadership team and plays a vital role in advancing the organization’s mission to provide high-quality, peer-led, recovery-oriented support services. This position ensures the excellence, stability, and growth of HALI’s Clubhouse Program while helping shape the organization’s strategic direction.

HALI is grounded in the values of recovery, peer support, empowerment, dignity, and social justice. Through a person-centered approach, the Senior Director of the Clubhouse Program Services helps create environments where people who have experienced significant mental health and/or co-occurring life challenges can thrive, build community, and maintain housing stability.

The Director of Clubhouse is the senior on-site leader responsible for daily operations, program fidelity, and staff supervision, while working every day as a genuine, hands-on member of the Clubhouse community. This role balances consensus-based, member-driven decision-making with bottom-line accountability to HALI's Executive Leadership, OMH, and Clubhouse International's accreditation standards.

Essential Responsibilities

Clubhouse Culture, Work-Ordered Day & Employment

  • Build and protect a Clubhouse culture grounded in the International Standards for Clubhouse Programs, which promotes voluntary lifetime membership based upon a collaborative relationship based upon shared decision-making, mutuality and cultural humility.
  • Work daily, side-by-side with members in units such as Business/Administration, Culinary, and Outreach as an active participant, not solely a supervisor. Ensure the work-ordered day generates real, needed work that members choose to do, and maintain an evening/weekend/holiday program so members always have somewhere to belong.

Program Operations, Compliance & Accreditation

  • Oversee day-to-day operations, facilities, safety, and budget, coordinating with HALI's Chief Program Officer and finance team on fiscal management.
  • Ensure compliance with NYS OMH licensing, reporting, and accreditation requirements, submitting required reports on schedule. This includes maintaining training records for all Clubhouse staff.
  • Track census, attendance, and outcome data (employment, education, housing, hospitalization) to inform program efficiency and improvement.

Staff Leadership & External Relationships

  • Recruit, hire, train, and supervise generalist staff who rotate through units alongside members; model and teach Clubhouse philosophy and peer support principles to staff, members, interns, and volunteers.
  • Facilitate staff and community meetings that use peer values and Clubhouse standards to guide shared decision-making, and make final personnel decisions when needed while leading through consensus wherever possible.
  • Build partnerships that expand members' employment, education, and social opportunities; and report regularly to HALI leadership, regulatory bodies, and funding sources.

Additional Note: This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive listing of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties and responsibilities may change as organizational needs evolve.

title: Job Fair - Associate - Animal Intake Diversion
description:
Position Overview The Animal Intake Diversion Associate is often the first point of contact for community members facing a difficult decision about a pet. This position manages animal intake with compassion and accuracy while actively working to keep pets in their homes whenever it is safe and appropriate to do so. Through surrender counseling, reunification services, and connection to safety net resources such as the Pet Food Pantry and Pets for Life, this role helps the Louisiana SPCA serve people and pets before, and sometimes instead of, shelter admission. Key Responsibilities Intake Diversion and Pet Retention

  • Guides owners considering surrender through a supportive, judgment-free conversation to understand the root cause and identify options that could keep the pet in the home
  • Connects clients to safety net resources including the Pet Food Pantry, low-cost veterinary services, spay/neuter programs, behavior support, and crisis assistance
  • Works with the Pets for Life program to assist owners in keeping pets in the home
  • Supports self-rehoming by coaching owners on responsibly placing a pet themselves when surrender is not the best path
  • Assists customers in receiving pet food via the Pet Food Pantry and maintains the shelter food pantry, including inventory and restocking
  • Documents diversion conversations, resources provided, and outcomes accurately for program tracking

Intake and Reunification

  • Manages owner surrender, stray, and return intakes, gathering complete histories and entering accurate information into the shelter software system
  • Scans all incoming animals for microchips and pursues reunification through microchip registries, lost and found reports, and community outreach
  • Guides owners through the redemption process to reunite lost pets with their families, including applicable fees and requirements
  • Remains alert to each animal’s behavior and physical condition at intake, flagging medical or behavioral concerns to the appropriate team immediately
  • Communicates with empathy when guiding owners toward the most fitting decision concerning their animals

Community Education and Operations

  • Educates the public on humane pet ownership, humane law and regulations, animal ordinances, intact permits, and the services and resources offered by the Louisiana SPCA
  • Maintains working knowledge of basic humane law enforcement procedures including the redemption process, responsible animal ownership, public safety, and enforcement of animal ordinances
  • Provides exceptional customer service in person, by phone, and by email, working with a sense of priority in every interaction
  • Balances revenue at the end of each day and ensures all deposits are placed in the appropriate area
  • Ensures all paperwork is organized, up to date, and located in the correct area

Success Criteria

  • Intake conversations consistently explore alternatives before admission, and diversion outcomes are documented and measurable
  • Lost pets are reunited with owners quickly through consistent microchip scanning and reunification follow-through
  • Intake records are complete, accurate, and entered same day
  • Clients in crisis leave with a resource, a plan, or both, regardless of the outcome for the animal

Organizational Expectations

  • Treats all animals humanely, properly, and with compassion at all times, regardless of the situation or circumstance, and promotes a humane and caring attitude toward all animals
  • Remains alert and aware of animal behavior and physical condition for client and employee safety; ensures animals are handled humanely and appropriately by clients, employees, and volunteers
  • Supports teamwork across departments by being cooperative, flexible, and helpful
  • Maintains confidentiality at all times
  • Attends all training and animal handling classes available
  • Contributes to the general appearance and upkeep of the interior and exterior lobby and public areas
  • Takes inventory of assigned supplies and restocks as needed

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate for this role you must have experience operating in large-scale data center or a background in telecom networks and display a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically, as this is needed to align the future of Infrastructure Delivery with the larger objectives of the business.
You will be responsible for managing a group of technicians who are installing and building server rack capacity for our customers. You must be passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to innovations in Data Center Infrastructure.

- Managing and developing teams of technicians and engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring the highest levels of performance.
- Delivering capacity to existing Data Centers
- Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
- Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
- Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
- Liaising with internal teams & management groups
- Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
- Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
- Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

title: Systems Administrator
description:
Harry Maxwell are recruiting for an intermediate Systems Administrator on behalf of an established Australian engineering and construction business, with a mix of corporate and project-based operations across the country. This is a great opportunity to join a stable, well-regarded business and take genuine ownership of the systems that keep it running.

About the Role
Reporting to the Group Manager, Information Systems and Technology (IS&T), you will take ownership of day-to-day systems administration across the business — working closely with the wider IS&T team, project sites and external vendors to keep infrastructure, security and endpoint systems running smoothly.

This is a genuinely varied role at the centre of the business's IT operations. Systems administration — infrastructure, network, cloud and project work — is the vast majority of the role, with a small amount of desktop support for corporate and project staff. It's suited to someone a few years into their systems administration career who wants ownership of real infrastructure, rather than someone coming purely from a desktop support background.

Key responsibilities
  • Manage day-to-day operations of corporate and project IT systems, including monitoring, configuration, maintenance and repairs
  • Manage backup and disaster recovery processes, restoring data within agreed timeframes
  • Work with internal staff and external vendors to patch and upgrade hardware and software

About you
  • 3-5 years' experience in a Systems Administrator role, ideally in engineering, construction or a similar project-based industry

  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 admin centre, Entra ID (Conditional Access, PIM), Intune (device/app/config management), Defender XDR and Sentinel

  • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple conflicting priorities and complex problems with a strong delivery focus
  • Self-motivated, well organised, with a positive can-do attitude
  • Australian citizenship or permanent residency required (visa holders cannot be considered for this role)
Highly regarded
  • Certifications such as MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) or SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst)
  • Exposure to Essential Eight maturity uplift and ISO 27001 control environments
  • Palo Alto firewall experience
  • Experience in a business of similar size and complexity, supporting both corporate offices and remote/project sites

title: Senior Databricks Data Engineer
description:
Join us at OGS

We are OGS—Omnicom's Integrated Solutions Engine that brings together a global talent community and connected capabilities in data, creative, media, commerce, and technology to build adaptive, future-ready solutions.

We are redefining the global capability center - not as an offshoring hub, but as a true inside edge. OGS is the place where the future is tested, built, and scaled for the world’s most ambitious agencies and clients.

With over 4300+ talented professionals in India, we are proud to be a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative community that thrives on innovation and excellence. Our teams work with some of the world’s most iconic brands, helping them move faster and achieve more—everywhere. We are growing rapidly and looking for passionate individuals to be part of this journey.


YOUR ROLE

We want to ensure that OGS continues to be the first choice for customers seeking innovative marketing technology, data, and analytics solutions. Our goal is to be recognized as a leader in technical excellence, delivering scalable and modern data platforms that drive business value for our clients.

This role sits within the Data & Technology arm of our business, specifically within the Tech Delivery team.

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Databricks Data Engineer to join a strategic data transformation programme focused on migrating a large-scale enterprise data platform from Informatica to Azure Databricks. The successful candidate will play a critical role in modernizing data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and analytics capabilities while ensuring continuity of business-critical data processes.

This role requires strong technical expertise in Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Oracle databases, and modern Data Lakehouse architectures. The ideal candidate will be capable of independently delivering complex solutions from design through implementation while collaborating with architects, business stakeholders, and cross-functional delivery teams.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment of data engineering solutions on Azure Databricks.
  • Participate in the migration of existing ETL/ELT workloads from Informatica to Azure Databricks.
  • Analyse Informatica mappings, workflows, and dependencies and translate them into scalable Databricks solutions.
  • Design and develop performant batch and streaming data pipelines using PySpark and SQL.
  • Build and maintain data ingestion frameworks for structured and semi-structured data sources.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Delta Lake-based data architectures using Medallion Architecture principles (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
  • Work closely with Solution Architects and Business Analysts to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, validation, and monitoring processes throughout the migration lifecycle.
  • Create technical specifications, design documents, and operational support documentation.
  • Participate in code reviews and enforce engineering best practices and development standards.
  • Support deployment activities through CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, project managers, and delivery teams to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across the project team.
  • Support production releases and troubleshoot complex data issues when required.


SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4-6 years of hands-on experience with Azure Databricks in enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale data migration and modernization projects.
  • Strong experience migrating ETL processes from Informatica or similar ETL platforms to cloud-native architectures.
  • Strong understanding of Lakehouse architecture and modern data engineering principles.
  • Extensive experience in Data Modelling, Data Warehousing, and Data Lake design.
  • Experience working with large-scale enterprise data platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in client-facing environments and collaborating with business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and engineering best practices.


ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Databricks & Data Engineering

Azure Databricks, Databricks Genie AI, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, Databricks Asset Bundles, Lakehouse Architecture, Medallion Architecture, Advanced Data Engineering patterns and best practices


Azure Services

Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2), Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Key Vault, Azure Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Azure DevOps, Azure Functions


Database Technologies

Oracle Database (Must Have), Oracle SQL, Oracle Stored Procedures, Oracle Data Modelling, Oracle Data Warehouse Concepts and Ms SQL server

Engineering Practices

title: Sr. Counsel, M&A
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

AMD is seeking an Sr. Corporate Counsel, M&A to provide strategic legal support for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic business transactions. The role serves as a key legal advisor, partnering closely with Corporate Development and senior business leaders. The successful candidate will independently lead significant portions of transactions, identify legal and business risks early, negotiate transaction documents, and help drive post-acquisition legal integration. This role requires the confidence to engage with senior executives, communicate complex legal and business issues clearly, and build trusted relationships with leadership throughout the transaction lifecycle.

THE PERSON:

You are a pragmatic, business-minded lawyer with deep M&A and venture capital knowledge and a proven track record of managing complex transactions and drafting legal documents. You provide expert legal counsel, guiding internal clients through strategic transactions. You balance legal risk with business objectives, communicate clearly, and take ownership of ambiguous, time-sensitive matters. You are collaborative, direct, and humble, with the ability to improve processes and move work forward with urgency while protecting AMD’s interests.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support all legal aspects of M&A, joint ventures, minority investments, acquihires, and other strategic transactions.
  • Prepare, review, and negotiate transaction documents, including letters of intent, purchase agreements, and ancillary documents.
  • Provide practical counsel on deal structuring, risk allocation, purchase price mechanics, rep and warranty insurance, indemnification, and other key transaction terms.
  • Manage matters relating to AMD Ventures’ investments and portfolio management.
  • Coordinate due diligence reviews and work closely with subject-matter experts and third-party advisors.
  • Prepare materials for executive review regarding deal structure and risks.
  • Advise on regulatory matters (e.g. CIFIUS, HSR, and other merger control antitrust or foreign direct investment filings) and help facilitate regulatory approval processes for transactions.
  • Provide legal support for post-closing legal integration matters.
  • Analyze complex legal issues requiring the identification and evaluation of multiple factors.
  • Coordinate actively with stakeholders across AMD including Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Human Resources, Privacy, IP, Stock Administration, IT, Corporate Development, Real Estate, Export Control, Government Relations, Investor Relations, and Corporate Communications.\Direct and manage external law firms to ensure transaction deadlines are met.
  • Develop and maintain standardized processes, playbooks, and template documents that drive efficiency and best practices across M&A transactions and minority investments.
  • Support other corporate matters as needed.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstrated experience handling sophisticated M&A and minority investments in a sophisticated in-house legal department, top-tier law firm, or a combination of both.
  • A deep understanding of transaction structures, including joint ventures, minority investments, and acquihires.
  • Experience with both domestic and cross-border transactions.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to translate complex legal concepts into digestible, easy to use content for senior leaders and other non-legal teams.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to align stakeholders, solve problems, and execute priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex projects and transactions, manage competing priorities, track deliverables, and drive timely execution independently.
  • Strong business judgment, proactive issue-spotting skills, and the ability to identify and address legal and business risks before they become problems.
  • Excellent organizational skills and exemplary attention to detail.
  • High integrity, professionalism, sound ethics, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.

Santa Clara, CA or San Jose, CA

  • Minimum of 5 years hands-on design, requirements development and implementation experience involving; Engineering Systems, Hardware / Software Engineering, and/or Data Information Systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional, global environment

title: Staff Software Engineer - Vision - New Platforms
description:
Primary Function of Position:

As a Vision Software Staff Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the software and embedded architecture definition of the real-time, high-definition video processing, imaging, and intra-body illumination systems at the heart of a new generation surgical robotic platform.

You will drive the deep integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi-processor embedded architectures, bringing sound engineering judgment to the trade-offs between hardware, software, and algorithms, and procedure-specific product requirements.

Critical to the success of this role is experience diagnosing and debugging complex vision systems end-to-end – from sensor and optics through the video pipeline to software – driving root cause investigations and collaborating with hardware and algorithms teams to resolve difficult, multi-disciplinary issues. Familiarity with working in a regulated industry and with design controls for medical devices is a plus.

The successful candidate must excel at evaluating design trade-offs through detailed technical deep dives, proof-of-concept development, and rapid iteration, translating rough requirements into robust, well-reasoned embedded software architectures.

A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the ability to make the work fun and interesting. Supporting you will be a development and management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and wants you to succeed.

Essential Job Duties

  • Lead the definition of hardware, software, and algorithms architecture for the real-time video processing engine, image sensors, and intra-body illumination systems of a new generation surgical robotic platform, from concept through implementation.
  • Drive the integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi-processor embedded architectures, ensuring robust interfaces between hardware, FPGA/ISP, and software components.
  • Evaluate multiple design trade-offs for the embedded vision software architecture through detailed technical deep dives, proof-of-concept development, and rapid iteration.
  • Lead bring-up and integration of new, high-performance cameras and image sensors, and the integration and evaluation of advanced camera pipeline video processing algorithms.
  • Diagnose and debug vision system issues end-to-end – sensor, optics, video pipeline, and software – leading root cause investigations in close collaboration with hardware, algorithms, and systems engineering teams.
  • Drive development and enhancement of the color and power control functions for intra-operative illumination.
  • Lead formal risk analyses for vision and illumination subsystems; identify additional hardware requirements and develop software mitigations to minimize potential failures.
  • Design and develop offline simulation environments and hardware/software diagnostic tools that accelerate development, debug, and test.
  • Perform and guide detailed design, development, documentation, and verification of embedded vision software and supervisory state machines, in compliance with regulatory requirements and Intuitive's internal guidelines.
  • Contribute broadly across the video and vision software stack, including extension of current processing frameworks to new hardware platforms.
  • Apply high-level and specialized imaging/vision expertise to deliver innovations and problem-solving approaches that can be leveraged across multiple products.
  • Mentor and guide engineers across the vision team.

Required Education and Training

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
  • A minimum of 12 years of experience developing and supporting embedded systems, with significant focus on video, imaging, or vision systems (or 8 years with a Master's degree, or 5 years with a PhD).

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
About this role
Join a team at the forefront of protecting and shaping the future of technology. As our Cybersecurity Analyst, you'll sit at the point where new technology meets risk, advising project teams, reviewing solution designs, and making sure security is designed in rather than retrofitted.

This is a second line role. You won't be building or operating controls. Your job is to review the work of delivery and engineering teams, form your own view of the risk, and say so. That independence is what makes the role useful, and it's also what makes it demanding. You'll be influencing teams you don't control and holding a position when a program is under pressure to move.

A core part of the role is working out what assurance each project needs, from architecture review and penetration testing through to supplier assurance and control review. You'll arrange the internal teams and vendors who carry that work out, review the quality of what they produce, and track findings through to closure. Where risk remains, you'll put it in front of the people accountable for accepting it.

You'll be part of a collaborative Cybersecurity Assurance team that helps guide secure decision-making, provides oversight of technology and cyber risk, and supports the adoption of new technologies in a way that balances innovation with strong security practices. It's a highly visible role, with reporting that reaches delivery teams, management and Board risk forums.

What you'll be doing

  • Partnering with project teams to discover and document security requirements early and embed them into key initiatives and business change.
  • Scoping the security services each project needs, including security architecture review, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, supplier assurance and control review, and maintaining the schedule that delivers them.
  • Providing independent cybersecurity and technology risk oversight, assurance and reporting across projects and strategic programs.
  • Coordinating internal teams and external delivery partners, including vendor-delivered testing and supplier assurance activity.
  • Preparing reporting on assurance status, service demand, risk themes and remediation progress, including input to management and Board Risk Committee papers.
  • Supporting internal and external audits through evidence collation and interviews and providing line 2 oversight of finding closure.
  • Contributing to the maturity of nib's Information Security Management System, security policies and control frameworks.

About you
You'll have at least three years' experience in cybersecurity or technology risk and, need to be comfortable reviewing other people's work, forming an independent view, and explaining it clearly to the people who built it.

You're organised. A large part of this role is knowing what assurance work is in flight, what it depends on, who's delivering it and when it lands, then making that visible to everyone from delivery teams through to the Board.

You'll have a strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, including security-by-design, control effectiveness, vulnerability management, access management, data protection and cloud security, and you enjoy partnering with project teams to deliver practical, secure outcomes without creating unnecessary friction.

You'll bring:

  • Excellent written, visual and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain security requirements, assurance outcomes and risk decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience scoping, coordinating or overseeing cybersecurity services such as security architecture review, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, supplier assurance or control review.
  • Experience assessing technical risk using a formal framework such as ISO 31000 and reviewing solution designs and assurance outputs to identify security implications, control gaps and remediation expectations.
  • Working knowledge of cloud environments and shared responsibility models, particularly AWS and Azure, and the security considerations for SaaS, PaaS and AI-enabled services.
  • Familiarity with secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices, and how security controls are applied through development and deployment pipelines.
  • Relevant experience and/or qualifications in cybersecurity, technology, risk or a related discipline. Industry certification achieved or in progress is well regarded (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC, SC-200, AZ-500 or similar).
  • Experience working in a regulated or compliance-bound environment, including exposure to APRA expectations such as CPS 234 and CPS 230.

Don't tick every box? If this role excites you and you bring relevant experience, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who we are
nib is a leader in private health insurance, disability support and health services, reshaping the industry through bold innovation, strategic disruption and trusted partnerships. We deliver great value health insurance and support services to protect, connect and empower you to access healthcare when and where you need.

We have a mission and vision of people enjoying better health. Through our success, we aspire to more prosperous and sustainable communities, helping members and travellers make more informed healthcare decisions and generally live healthier lives.

We're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and employment experience. If you require adjustments to our online application, recruitment, selection and/or assessment process, or would like this advertisement in an alternative format, please contact us at nibemployment @nib.com.au.

description:

Since its establishment in 1981, Pioneer Circuits has been leading the way in technology solutions for mission-critical systems. About the Opportunity

The role of the Cross-Section Reader involves overseeing the cross-section and solderability testing procedures for printed circuit boards. This includes performing key responsibilities such as executing cross-section operator functions, which encompass the preparation of cross-section coupons, conducting meticulous micro section analyses, and carrying out solderability testing. Crucially, the position is responsible for ensuring that all tasks are completed in strict adherence to Team Leader directives, Traveler information, and established Standard Operating Procedures.

  • Inserts positioning pins in coupons and carefully places microsections into molds.
  • Operates the oven in accordance with SOP or Traveler instructions.
  • Prepares acrylic and epoxy for use in the evaluation process.
  • Performs grinding, polishing, and washing of microsections following SOP guidelines.
  • Documents any non-conformance parts and submits them to Quality Control for preliminary review and disposition.
  • Reviews the manufacturing logbook to verify the accurate recording of all processed jobs.
  • Notifies the team leader promptly of any process or personnel issues that may arise during the evaluation process.
  • Performs other duties as required, showcasing flexibility in contributing to various tasks as needed

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work in chemical environments

  • Must be able to remain focused with minor interruptions

$20—$25 USD

title: Software Development Engineer (Chip Product Security)
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

As a key member of our Business Enterprise Applications team with focus within our IT Global Operations & Supply Chain team, you will use your expert software engineering skills to develop product security. When you join our passionate and engaged team, you will notice right away we are committed to success. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing the performance of systems that impact AMD product life cycle and modifying to improve the quality of the generated code.

THE PERSON:

Your technical abilities will directly impact AMD’s success with tier-one partners. You will work collaboratively with developers and global operations teams inside AMD. This position requires an outstanding background of software development, debugging skills, communication skills, ability to prototype, testing and to clearly articulate possible technical challenges associated with the implementation. Must be self-motivated, able to work well within a team and able to adapt to a fast-paced environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop code, unit test, debug, and implement requests for programs, small projects, and system changes in a custom application environment with a focus on product security.
  • Assist in the development and documentation of system architecture, designs, and consult on encryption management solutions.
  • Analyze and improve performance of the infrastructure and applications.
  • Works with eco-system partners to help improve the security of the entire compute base from CPU to GPU
  • Very good communicator, able to engage and effectively respond to diverse stakeholders.
  • Support global business users to ensure enterprise applications SLAs are met.
  • Work both independently and as part of a strong, collaborative, and global team
  • Self-starter who requires minimal supervision
  • Able to proactively support team culture that fosters knowledge sharing, excellence, and collaboration.
  • Since the position entails working with confidential information, a high level of integrity is required.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Extensive software development experience in Java, .Net, C++, Python, SQL, UNIX/Linux.
  • Web & mobile application development, Tomcat, JBoss or WebSphere.
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture systems and concepts, including CPU architecture, fundaments of the system memory hierarchy and caches, and underlying system hardware and firmware.
  • Knowledge of existing hardware architecture(s) (prefer x86 and/or ARM) including associated security and/or virtualization extensions.
  • Must possess an understanding of all aspects of data, client/server and network security, including such areas as firewall administration, encryption technologies and network protocols.
  • Experience with firmware, APIs, applications, OSes and their interactions within Windows, Linux, gaming, compute, and virtualization environments.
  • Eagerness and ability to quickly learn new concepts.
  • Worked in cross-site and matrix environments.
  • Database development, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server.
  • Possess fundamental knowledge of security principles and properties, including confidentiality, integrity, availability, authentication, authorization, and auditing.
  • Understand industrial security standards: TCG, DMTF, OCP NIST, FIPS, Common Criteria, etc.
  • Working knowledge of cryptography and encryption key management an asset.
  • Relevant industry experience is highly beneficial.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology Systems Security or related field strongly preferred.

title: Interactor
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Our studios are considered one of the foremost motion picture and television production and post-production facilities in the world. They inform, engage, and transport audiences to new worlds. The key to that lies with our Studio Operations group, which includes areas like soundstage/backlot set rentals, events, design, culinary, construction, landscaping and much more. Whether it’s hosting an unforgettable studio tour, creating an optimal workspace, or equipping talent to tell the best stories, these teams lay the foundation for the memorable experiences we provide.

Your New Role…

Are you a Harry Potter fan? If so, you’ll love working at the Warner Bros. Studio Tour London (WBSTL) – The Making of Harry Potter.

As an Interactor, part of the Show Experience team, you’ll be an ambassador for the Tour by guiding, entertaining and enlightening visitors whilst on their magical journey. You’ll get up close and personal with authentic Props, Sets and Costumes from the Harry Potter films, and share your passion for filmmaking through detailed and engaging storytelling. From delivering exciting, scripted speeches and special effects demonstrations, to providing expert Harry Potter insight, it's your job to make sure that we exceed their expectations at every opportunity and ensure that they have the best possible experience.

What’s in it for you?

  • £13.45 per hour
  • 25 days holiday (pro-rata)
  • GymPass or free access to our on-site gym
  • Exclusive access to our Screeners App, with our exciting Warner Bros. and HBO content
  • Staff discounts on Studio Tour tickets, retail, food and beverage
  • Access to Friends and Family events
  • Free on-site staff car parking
  • Complimentary staff shuttle bus between Watford Junction and our Studio Tour
  • On-site staff Studio Café
  • Option to join our pension and private healthcare schemes

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Proactively engage and assist with the varied needs of our Visitors by delivering a world class Visitor experience. Anticipate what the Visitors need and be fan obsessed.
  • Present a friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable interface between the Tour itself and all visitors to the Tour, working as an ambassador for both.
  • Actively listen and lead with empathy, integrity, and transparency.
  • Proactively seek ways to support your team to w
  • rk towards the collective goal of exceeding Visitors’ expectations.
    Continuously improve your own skills and knowledge in relation to the Franchise, Tour operations and your own personal performance.
  • Conduct Added Value Tours and assist in Audio Descriptive Tours as required.
  • Work with the management team to enhance the Show and Visitor experience at every opportunity.
  • Hold pride for your workspace – keep a safe and tidy working area. Deep cleaning of Sets as required by Management Team.
  • Adhere to and champion all guidelines and policies in accordance with WBD policies and procedures.

You will be required to stand for up to 5 hours at a time, perform light lifting and work outdoors in all weather conditions. Areas and shows that Interactors perform in contain water-based smoke effects, flashing lights and sudden loud noises; you also will be expected to interact with live show elements such as live actors portraying Death Eaters. Occasionally you will be required to attend communication sessions and training sessions outside of your core working hours. Full training will be provided for successful candidates.

Qualifications & Experience…

  • Understanding of the Harry Potter film series and filmmaking.
  • Previous work experience in a customer/visitor facing role, where a strong emphasis was placed on quality of service and/or experience. Previous work on-stage is desirable.
  • Presentation skills – enthusiasm and ability to speak in public to groups of up to 300 on a microphone. Both scripted elements and improvisation required.
  • Demonstrable ability to learn new skills and adapt to new situations within a visitor focused environment.
  • Able to contribute positively and enjoy working effectively as part of a large and varied team.

Working Pattern…

Contracts range from 16 to 40 hours per week. You will be required to work weekends as part of this working pattern. Weekend work includes both Saturday and Sunday.


Your normal hours of work are between 8am and 10pm over the peak summer period/weekends, and from 8am until 8pm at other times, though some evening event work (finishing at 00:30) is required for events. Shifts outside of these hours can be opted into, and these hours can start as early as 7am. We provide a free shuttle bus from Watford Junction; however this cannot be relied on if your start/finish time falls outside of our opening hours, therefore you must ensure that you are able to arrange your own travel arrangements to/from work on these occasions.


All working patterns will include weekends and Bank Holidays (those on part-time contracts will work a proportionate number of weekends and bank holidays as those on a full-time contract).

Business Overview…

Warner Bros. Studio Tour London – The Making of Harry Potter opened its doors on 31st March 2012. The unique attraction offers visitors the ultimate chance to get up close to authentic sets, discover the magic behind spellbinding special effects and explore the behind-the-scenes secrets of the Harry Potter film series including stepping in to the Great Hall and Gringotts Wizarding Bank. The Studio Tour has welcomed over 15 million visitors and has been well received with 96% of the 46,000+ reviews on TripAdvisor rating it as ‘Excellent’ or ‘Very Good’ and over 60,000 4- or 5-star ratings on Google Reviews.

Onsite Working - This role is advertised as Onsite, meaning all working hours and days (regardless of shift pattern) will be carried out at the place of work. Subject to any applicable laws, WBD / your Line Manager reserves the right to change this working agreement, where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

title: Sr. Project Manager - Software PMO
description:
Primary Function of Position:

Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.

Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products. We’re looking for people with proven track records of delivering complex, integrated, cross-functional products with high standards of quality. Digital program managers are engaged in all aspects of the product lifecycle from requirements analysis and architectural design to software engineering development, QA, deployment, and market rollout. Our program managers align hardware and software engineering, clinical and regulatory schedules, and ensure that the right products are created at the right time, with low drama.

At Intuitive, Program Management is not a task-based job. We are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. This means that while strong program management fundamentals are a must, the role requires an understanding of product development and manufacturing, and, most importantly, managing through influence.

We look for candidates who know what success looks like and feel a personal stake in the services they support and the people they manage. People who understand how medical technology products are developed. People with a deep well of positive energy and unbounded enthusiasm. We look for people who hold themselves and their program teams to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. People with unshakeable integrity and deep wisdom & judgment. People who need to know why. People who are comfortable in ambiguity and excel at bringing order to it. People who strive to simplify and to clarify. People who are as comfortable presenting to execs as they are with their nose buried in a burndown chart.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Effectively manage cross-functional development programs across Intuitive’s different Business units and shared services, overseeing critical projects, and delivering against commitments.
  • Help teams prioritize tasks to focus on the critical activities that drive progress and avoid being sidetracked by less important issues.
  • Collaborate with the cross-functional teams to ensure the right people are updated with the right information at the right time on status and ensure that cross-product dependencies are understood, planned for, and crisply executed
  • Perform risk analysis, develop contingency plans, and gather data from functions to proactively raise prioritization and scheduling tradeoff decisions
  • Drive required discipline and rigor in requirements analysis, design, development, and testing through good development practices and effective use of phase gates.
  • Work across the organization and external partners as needed to align functional support and input for the project
  • Contribute to and help lead improvement Intuitive project management processes and ongoing improvements to the way we ship new products and capabilities.
  • Function as a primary point-of-contact for stakeholders across the org.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrated history of leadership in project, program, and portfolio management of software delivery programs, at scale.
  • Demonstrated excellence in program management capabilities across product lifecycle, from ideation through commercialization.
  • Strong grasp of software product development engineering principles, manufacturing, servicing, and quality control.
  • Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations
  • Proven ability to think strategically, plan and align product development with business goals and market needs.
  • Naturally accountable and responsible; self-starter, self-motivated, self-directed, self-sufficient.
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, written and verbal, to all levels of an organization.
  • Experience with development and commercialization of medical technology.
  • Ability to recognize project challenges and drive creative and simple solutions with a customer-focused approach
  • Proven ability to influence at various levels and drive conflict resolution with low drama

Required Education and Training

  • At least 8 years of program & project management experience with a bachelor’s degree and 6 years with a Master’s degree. This must include hands-on experience with development and commercialization of highly technical medical devices.

title: Senior Data Scientist – Informatica Governance & Marketplace
description:
Senior Data Scientist – Informatica Governance & Marketplace
Position: Data Scientist – Senior
Client: Government Services Integration Cluster
Ministry: Ministry of Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement
Location: 222 Jarvis Street, Toronto, ON
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite – 5 days per week
Contract: September 10, 2026 – March 31, 2027
Openings: 1
Security Clearance: No Clearance Required
Closing Date: September 23, 2026 at 3:00 PM EST
Submission Limit: 1 candidate
Position Overview
The Government Services Integration Cluster is seeking a Senior Data Scientist with strong hands-on experience in Informatica, data governance, metadata management, data cataloguing, and Data Marketplace solutions.
The successful candidate will support the implementation of Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) governance capabilities and contribute to the development of a Data Governance & Marketplace Proof of Concept (POC). The role will involve configuring Informatica governance capabilities, developing metadata ingestion processes, supporting data discovery and lineage, establishing business glossary and stewardship workflows, and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.
The candidate must be comfortable working in a 100% onsite environment in downtown Toronto and bridging business requirements with technical data governance solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Informatica Governance & Marketplace Development
  • Configure and implement Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) governance capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain Data Marketplace solutions supporting self-service data discovery and consumption.
  • Configure and manage:
    • Business Glossary
    • Data Catalog
    • Data Marketplace
    • Metadata Management
    • Data Lineage
    • Data Quality integrations
    • Data Stewardship workflows
  • Build metadata ingestion pipelines and automate metadata harvesting from source systems.
  • Configure workflows, approval processes, and governance controls within Informatica.
Data Governance Enablement
  • Work with business and technical stakeholders to define data governance requirements.
  • Translate governance policies and requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Support creation and maintenance of:
    • Data domains
    • Data ownership models
    • Stewardship assignments
    • Data classifications
  • Implement data governance standards, controls, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Apply strong knowledge of metadata management, data quality, data lineage, and Master Data Management (MDM) concepts.
Proof of Concept (POC) Delivery
  • Support the planning and execution of a phased Data Governance & Marketplace POC.
  • Assist with requirements gathering, solution design, scope definition, and technical planning.
  • Recommend MVP capabilities that can be delivered within aggressive timelines.
  • Configure and demonstrate governance and marketplace functionality.
  • Present functionality, technical capabilities, and business value to stakeholders.
  • Support the transition of the POC toward production implementation.
Integration & Data Platforms
  • Collaborate with data engineering and technical teams to integrate Informatica governance capabilities with:
    • Azure Data Platform
    • SQL Server
    • Power BI
    • Other enterprise data sources
  • Integrate Informatica with both cloud and on-premises data sources.
  • Develop or support metadata automation and API-based integrations where required.
  • Work with data engineering teams to support metadata ingestion and cataloguing.
Agile Collaboration & Documentation
  • Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Governance teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Document requirements, user stories, technical designs, configurations, and governance processes.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery activities.
  • Provide technical documentation, configuration guides, knowledge-transfer materials, and implementation support.


Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications
Candidates must meet the following requirements:
1. Data Management / Data Governance Experience
  • 5+ years of experience in data management, metadata management, or data governance solutions.
2. Informatica Experience
  • 2+ years of hands-on Informatica experience.
3. Informatica Governance / Catalog Experience
Hands-on experience implementing at least one of the following:
  • Informatica Data Catalog
  • Informatica Data Governance & Catalog
  • Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC)
  • Informatica Data Marketplace
4. Data Governance & Metadata Expertise
Strong understanding of:
  • Data Governance frameworks
  • Metadata Management
  • Master Data Management (MDM) concepts
  • Data Quality principles
  • Data Lineage
5. Data Integration Experience
  • Experience integrating Informatica with cloud and on-premises data sources.
6. SQL
  • Proficiency in SQL.
7. Agile
  • Experience working in Agile project environments.
Technical Evaluation Focus
The evaluation criteria identified for this requisition place emphasis on:
  • Technical Skills – 50%
  • Databricks/Azure – 25%
  • Informatica – 25%
Candidates should therefore clearly demonstrate relevant Azure/Databricks and Informatica experience in their resumes.
Preferred / Asset Qualifications
The following experience is preferred but not mandatory:
  • Experience with Azure Cloud.
  • Knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK data governance principles.
  • Experience implementing enterprise data catalogs and data marketplaces.
  • Familiarity with data privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
  • Informatica certification(s).
  • Experience within financial services, insurance, or other regulated industries.
Nice-to-Have Technical Experience
  • Informatica Cloud Data Governance & Catalog (CDGC)
  • Informatica Data Marketplace
  • Informatica EDC (Enterprise Data Catalog)
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Power BI
  • Data Quality and Data Observability tools
  • API integrations
  • Metadata automation
  • Databricks / Azure
Expected Deliverables
The successful candidate will be expected to:

SpringHealth Behavioral Health and Integrated Care, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, offers a holistic approach and integrated care for people with cognitive, developmental, or intellectual disabilities who often need additional resources. The behavior analysts, therapists, social workers, counselors, and psychologists at SpringHealth combine their expertise to deliver high-quality behavioral services for clients to live more positive, active, and social lives. Job description:

Job Purpose

Support the secure and efficient management of the organisation's Identity and Access Management (IAM) services by ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, administering the joiner-mover-leaver (JML) lifecycle, monitoring system activities, facilitating periodic access reviews, and supporting the onboarding and integration of new systems. The incumbent is expected to develop a strong understanding of the organisation's identity and access management framework and apply this knowledge to effectively support current and future IAM platforms and technologies.

Responsibilities

The System Operation Manager duties and responsibilities include:

  • Review daily discovery and provisioning logs; action exceptions and resolve failures.
  • Execute and verify offboarding / deprovisioning; support joiner and mover events.
  • Coordinate and follow up on access reviews / recertifications to completion.
  • Support requirement gathering and test integrations end to end for new systems.
  • Read logs, troubleshoot, and trace issues across connected systems.
  • Communicate clearly with HR and end users; document procedures and runbooks.
Qualifications & Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 2-5 years in IAM operations, identity administration, or IT security operations.
  • Strong candidates with adjacent experience and clear IAM aptitude will also be considered.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one IAM / IGA or access platform
  • Experience operating within ITSM / ticketing workflows and meeting defined SLAs.
  • Exposure to access governance, audit, or compliance activities is an advantage.
Skills

  • Sound understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, including Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle, user provisioning and deprovisioning, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), access certification, and Segregation of Duties (SoD).
  • Working knowledge of identity services and directory technologies, such as LDAP, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Understanding of system integration concepts, including identity provisioning, authentication, and access management workflows across enterprise applications.
  • Ability to test and validate IAM integrations, provisioning processes, and access workflows to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and recommend practical solutions.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new IAM platforms and technologies, with a strong understanding of core IAM principles rather than reliance on a specific product.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying, analysing, and reconciling identity and access data, as well as supporting reporting requirements.
  • Experience with C#/.NET is preferred for scripting, troubleshooting, and developing custom integrations.
  • Working knowledge of scripting languages and APIs, including PowerShell and REST/JSON, with an understanding of audit and compliance requirements.
