title: Senior Principal Toxicologist-Scientist
description:
The Position

Translational Safety Toxicologists provide scientific leadership across drug development, from early research through clinical development and marketed products. This Senior Principal Scientist role is intended for an experienced portfolio toxicologist who can immediately assume independent toxicology and safety leadership for multiple fast-moving development programs, including programs involving novel modalities and novel, accelerated, or otherwise nontraditional regulatory strategies. The successful candidate will integrate toxicology, pathology, pharmacology, translational, and clinical information to identify and contextualize risk, shape development strategy, and enable timely, high-quality decisions.


Working in a collaborative team environment, the Senior Principal Scientist leads the safety assessment of Genentech therapeutics by creating a best weight-of-evidence synthesis of existing knowledge and comprehensive investigations of toxicologic activity, strategic planning, and designing/implementing/supervising toxicology studies in support of program advancement. The role combines toxicological evaluation and contributes visibly to the scientific and strategic direction of cross-functional portfolio development teams, the broader toxicology leadership, and senior decision makers.


The Opportunity

  • Serve as lead toxicologist for multiple complex development programs across therapeutic areas and modalities and contribute to overall program development on interdisciplinary project team
  • Provide scientific leadership in the design and implementation of safety assessment strategies to support program advancement and decision-making from discovery and candidate selection through regulatory milestones and later-stage development, as needed.
  • Partner closely with pathologists, study operations professionals, translational scientists, pharmacologists, clinicians, and regulatory colleagues to design fit-for-purpose GLP and non-GLP safety programs that answer key development questions efficiently
  • Rapidly synthesize complex or incomplete datasets, leverage the external literature, and develop clear weight-of-evidence positions that support risk assessment, dose selection, study design, and program decisions.
  • Anticipate potential target-, modality-, or mechanism-related safety issues and design or lead investigative and mechanistic studies in collaboration with pathologists and subject matter experts.
  • Proactively manage potential safety liabilities and communicate impact to teams, leadership, and governance committees
  • Contribute to and incorporate new approach methodologies (NAMs) that strengthen translation and decision making.
  • Identify opportunities to refine study design and reduce or replace animal use where scientifically appropriate, while maintaining robust safety assessment and regulatory readiness.
  • Author regulatory documents and presentations; represent Translational Safety and Genentech/Roche in interactions with health authorities and support programs using novel, accelerated, or otherwise nontraditional regulatory strategies.
  • Advance the external scientific standing of Genentech/Roche through high-quality publications, presentations, scientific collaborations, and participation in relevant professional or industry forums.
  • Provide proactive, high-impact scientific and strategic toxicology leadership beyond assigned programs, including leadership of cross-functional initiatives, therapeutic-area or expert working groups, and functional capability-building efforts.
  • Mentor toxicologists and other scientists, promote rigorous and pragmatic scientific decision making, and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative, high-performing team culture.
  • Lead or provide support to inter- and intra-departmental initiatives.

Who You Are

Senior Principal Scientist

  • PhD and post-doctorate or equivalent experience in toxicology or a relevant field along with a minimum of 8+ years relevant experience in the pharmaceutical/biotechnology/CRO industry related to toxicology.
  • Extensive experience in drug development demonstrating strong decision making, complex problem solving and critical data analysis and interpretation required.
  • Extensive experience in drug development and written/verbal interactions with global regulatory authorities are required.
  • Extensive experience in small molecules, degraders, and ADCs across multiple therapeutic areas is highly desirable.
  • Experience in de-risking metabolites and impurities highly desirable
  • Experience with, or strong scientific interest in, novel therapeutic modalities and the unique safety-assessment challenges they create.
  • Proven track record of demonstrating ability to independently support and influence drug-development programs as a toxicologist, including interpretation of nonclinical safety data in a broader translational and regulatory context
  • Consistent track record of demonstrating strong decision-making, complex problem solving, critical data analysis and interpretation, excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build and lead productive cross-functional collaborations both within and external to Genentech
  • Recognized expertise and a demonstrated record of scientific leadership in at least one area relevant to translational safety, toxicology, or drug development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex toxicology and safety issues clearly to project teams, senior leaders, and regulatory audiences.
  • Direct experience with health-authority interactions, novel development pathways, or regulatory strategies that require a high degree of scientific judgment and integration.
  • Evidence of scientific thought leadership through influential internal contributions, publications, presentations, professional society activity, or other recognized contributions to the field.
  • Board certification in toxicology is desirable.

Location

South San Francisco, California

This is not a fully remote position. Regular on-site presence in South San Francisco is an essential expectation of the role. On-site presence required at least 3 days per week.


Relocation benefits are available for this position.


The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $173,100 and $321,500 annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

title: QMAP (NOC)
description:
Job Description

Situated at the base of the Rocky Mountains, Balfour Senior Living in Louisville, CO at Cherrywood Village is seeking talented and team-oriented associates.

The Memory Care QMAP administers resident medication or assist residents with self-administration of medication and coordinate treatments to residents. Provide assistance with activities of daily living while encouraging independence and ensuring each resident’s physical, social, cultural, and intellectual well-being.

SHIFTS: Full-Time | Sunday-Thursday 2pm-10pm

PAY: $21.00-23.00hr

Additional Comp: $1.50 shift diff

What will I do every day?

  • Observe residents for any changes in condition and report to Care Services Director, Resident
  • Care Coordinator (RCC)/Dementia Care Coordinator (DCC), or appropriate physician
  • Assist residents with simple requests as needed or find an appropriate associate to assist
  • Learn resident preferences for opportunities to provide exemplary customer service, exceed resident expectations and enhance resident satisfaction
  • Document and report changes of condition and use company forms for resident care documentation
  • Provide medication set up and assistance
  • Log in medications from pharmacies, verify physician’s orders and communicate any concerns immediately
  • Track all medications and re-order as needed
  • Perform the following tasks with residents: track vital signs, weight, diabetic testing and/or insulin injection (if state allowed), ambulation, and general activities
  • Follow all regulatory and company policies regarding the destruction of medications as identified by the physician, pharmacy, or Care Services Director
  • Assist in documenting and removing medications that are discontinued by the resident’s physician
  • Familiar with the meaning and usage of common medical abbreviations, symbols, and terms relative to the administration of medications
  • Support, lead and participate in resident-centered wellness programs
  • Work toward maintaining each resident’s self-respect, personal dignity, and personal safety
  • Assist resident assistants as needed and whenever primary tasks are completed
  • Track supplies that are needed and communicate to Care Services Director or RCC/DCC
  • Work as part of the team within your department and across the community
  • Support open and honest communication with and between all associates
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which includes wearing the proper uniform and name tag when working
  • Look for ways to reduce costs and create efficiencies on a daily basis
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and report any issues or concerns immediately
  • Support continuous improvement
  • Adhere to all regulations, laws and Kisco standards, including the Associate Handbook
  • Understand and support the community sales process
  • Perform other related duties as required

What will I need to be successful in this role?

  • Bring a smile to work every day
  • Be a great team player
  • Be a high school graduate
  • Nursing Assistant course (State approved, if required)

Special Requirements/Certifications I may need?

  • Must be 21 years of age (or meet state requirements)
  • Have current First Aid and CPR certification
  • Have completed the required training, and/or certification (according to state) for assisting with medications
  • Must be knowledgeable of pertinent regulations with monitoring and licensing of the residence
  • Basic competency in the use of multiple forms of technology, including: Microsoft Office applications, internet-based and custom applications
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays as needed

What’s in it for me? (Great Question!)

  • Competitive pay
  • A free meal per shift
  • Healthcare Benefits including Vision & Dental (Full-time only)
  • Matching 401k (Full-time only)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Rewards and Bonus Opportunities
  • Continuous Training and Growth Opportunities

What do we do?

We create a great place to live for our residents and a great place to work for our associates. Kisco Senior Living has been a dynamic, award-winning leader in the senior living industry for over 30 years.

All offers of employment are subject to satisfying our pre-employment process which includes: successfully passing a drug screen, TB test, Background check and Physical Exam (all paid for by us).

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:

Nadia Care is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our mission-driven engineering team. You will be a high-impact individual contributor responsible for building and scaling technical solutions that improve maternal health outcomes. This role requires a blend of product-minded development and a deep commitment to operational excellence in a regulated healthcare environment.

You will collaborate closely with product, clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to build our next generation care team and member facing applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Stack Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable features across our mobile web platforms using React and Python.
  • Care-Team Automation: Develop AI-native workflows to automate internal administrative tasks, such as AI-assisted documentation and member summaries, to reduce manual work for our care team.
  • Production Reliability: Own the stability and performance of the production environment, utilizing tools like Datadog for monitoring and ensuring HIPAA compliance for PHI.
  • Technical Standards: Set high standards for code quality, testing methodologies, and deployment automation within a small, agile team.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Data, and Clinical Ops teams to translate complex healthcare workflows into practical, high-leverage technical solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a full-stack engineer, ideally within a early stage startup.
  • Expert-level skills in Python, SQL, Typescript/Javascript, and CSS.
  • Deep experience with modern React, MaterialUI, and Tailwind CSS.
  • Prior experience working in regulated environments (e.g., healthcare, fintech) and a strong understanding of HIPAA/PHI security requirements.
  • Ability to navigate technical ambiguity and a proven track record of shipping practical solutions to messy workflow bottlenecks.
  • Problem solver who prioritizes iteration and business impact over perfection
  • Experience with AWS and IaC (AWS CDK, Terraform) strongly preferred.

Why join us:

Working with us is a chance to build something from the ground up, shape the future of maternal health, and grow with a team that values impact, ownership, and care. As an early team member, you’ll help define how we deliver care and support at scale.

At Nadia Care, we recognize that great talent deserves great rewards. The expected base salary for this position is between $140K - $155K annually, based on relevant and direct experience.

Our Interview Process

At Nadia Care, we value transparency and want you to feel prepared at every stage of your candidate journey. Below is our standard interview process for this role:

  1. Recruiter Interview | 30 minutes
  2. Async Codility Technical Assessment | 70 minutes (2-day window)
  3. Hiring Manager Interview | 1 hour
  4. Collaborator Interviews
    1. Engineer Team | 1 hour
    2. Director, Product Strategy & Insights | 30 minutes
  5. Executive Leadership Interview | 30 minutes

Please note that this process is subject to change, but we will always keep you informed along the way.

For full-time employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally:

Time Off That Works for You

  • Recharge with annual paid holidays off.
  • Full-Time Salaried Employees (Exempt): Enjoy unlimited time off after the 90-day introductory period.
  • Full-Time Hourly Employees (Non-Exempt): Receive three weeks of paid time off after the 90-day introductory period.

Comprehensive Health & Wellness Coverage

  • Medical Insurance: Access top-tier healthcare, covering hospital, surgical, and prescription drug benefits. Coverage begins the first of the following month.
  • Dental Insurance: Coverage for preventive care, as well as basic and major procedures.
  • Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine eye exams and eyeglasses.

Security & Future Planning Options

  • Stock Option Grant: We believe in shared success.
  • Life Insurance: Financial protection for your beneficiaries.
  • Disability Insurance: Short-term and long-term coverage in case of illness or injury.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Opportunity to save for the future.

We’re building something great and want you to be part of it. If you're looking for a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contributions make an impact, apply today!

Remote positions are open to candidates in the contiguous US only. Due to operational and compliance requirements, we are unable to hire candidates residing in ND, AL, HI, PR or outside the contiguous US.

Please note that our recruitment team will only contact candidates via an official company email address ending in @nadiacare.com. Be cautious of scams; Nadia Care will never ask for financial information or payments at any stage of the hiring process.

title: Director, Revenue Cycle
description:
TULEA HEALTH OVERVIEW

At Tulea Health, we are compassionate partners seeking to elevate the infusion experience for patients through collaboration with the health systems that serve them. We create industry-leading Ambulatory Infusion Centers that deliver comfortable, consistent, caring therapy experiences personalized for each patient. Our innovative model does not compete with our health system partners but rather operates under their brand. We provide the financial investment, resources, personnel, supporting technology, and specialized expertise needed to drive success through a performance-oriented partnership model.

ROLE SUMMARY

Our Revenue Cycle Director will lead the strategy and execution of our revenue cycle function across our growing portfolio of infusion services sites, partnering closely with local site teams to drive financial performance for our customers. You will own the integrity of our revenue management processes and technology infrastructure enterprise-wide, building the people, processes, and controls needed to deliver accurate and appropriate reimbursement for our services. You will build, lead, and develop a team of revenue cycle professionals, and integrate with our customer and clinical operations teams as well as with our health system partners to build and sustain the ongoing financial health of our infusion center operations. This role will set the vision for, and continuously and measurably improve, the efficiency and effectiveness of our client-focused revenue cycle processes across the portfolio.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and oversee the day-to-day activities associated with accurate and efficient revenue cycle processes for our Ambulatory Infusion Centers including claims management, payment posting and reconciliation, denial management, insurance follow-up, and other related tasks, building and leading a team of revenue cycle professionals accountable for this work.
  • Partner with our clinical team members to integrate revenue integrity appropriately and effectively into our patient-facing processes and engagement strategies especially for patient co-payment, prior authorization management, and accurate and compliant documentation.
  • Integrate with our customers’ patient financial assistance infrastructure to help facilitate access to care and support our patient navigators and clinical team members.
  • Own the selection, development, implementation and ongoing utilization of technology to support our revenue cycle performance, in partnership with our clinical and IT stakeholders.
  • Establish and actively manage the key performance indicators that lead to continued overachievement of customer-specific service level standards and financial performance targets across our portfolio of sites.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to senior customer operations and health system leadership, shaping payor engagement and collaboration strategies in conjunction with our health system partners.
  • Partner with our corporate finance and executive leadership teams to deliver accurate and timely reporting, financial forecasting, and customer management, translating site-level performance into enterprise-wide insights.
  • Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of revenue cycle professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
  • Develop and implement standardized revenue cycle policies, procedures, and best practices across our growing portfolio of Ambulatory Infusion Centers to ensure consistency, scalability, and compliance as we grow.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and thought partner to executive leadership on revenue cycle performance, trends, and opportunities, presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF YOU…

  • Have 5+ years of experience leading, managing, and executing the revenue cycle for an ambulatory or outpatient
    infusion center, home infusion, specialty pharmacy, or specialty physician practice with infusion services.
  • Have 5+ years of experience building, leading, and mentoring a team including performance management.
  • Can demonstrate how you have driven accurate and efficient revenue cycle performance across multiple sites or a growing portfolio of locations for ambulatory infusion services or an allied domain with a high degree of integrity,
    efficiency, and collaboration.
  • Relish the opportunity to work in a collaborative, team-based environment where your work has an immediate and direct impact on the mission of our organization - creating a superior patient experience.
  • Have a track record of creating, executing, and leading highly productive revenue cycle processes and teams that support consistent and effective reimbursement for the services for which you and your team are accountable.
  • Communicate effectively and confidently with executive and health system leadership, translating complex revenue cycle data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Understand and have utilized industry-standard provider revenue cycle management technology tools. Experience with infusion-specific solutions is a significant plus.
  • Show a propensity to innovate and overcome obstacles and solve problems to eliminate barriers to success.
  • Have utilized continuous process improvement methodologies and techniques in previous roles.
  • Have a background of working in a cross-functional environment where collaboration with your colleagues, particularly those in patient-facing clinical roles, is an essential part of your ongoing success.
  • Thrive in a rapidly evolving environment with a diverse group of stakeholders who welcome innovative ideas and solutions with a common goal.
  • Are comfortable stepping outside your role and respectfully challenging your peers and senior leaders across functions to ensure effective overall performance based on a high degree of trust.
  • Embrace being part of a fast-paced, dynamic team in a high-growth environment; this includes having excellent interpersonal and listening skills, as well as a desire to remove barriers to growth through innovation and creativity.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Tulea Health is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Tulea Health is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact hr@tuleahealth.com. Tulea Health participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

title: Lead Materials Specialist
description:
How will you make a difference?

As a Material Planning & Execution Specialist – Scheduling & Inventory you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficient flow of materials, optimized inventory levels, and on-time delivery performance across the cabs manufacturing operation. Through collaboration with operations, engineering, sales, quality, and supply chain teams, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance production planning, improve inventory accuracy, reduce operational variances, and strengthen supplier performance. This role will use data-driven decision making to identify opportunities for greater efficiency, improved customer delivery performance, and year-over-year inventory optimization.

What do we want to know about you?

Do you have:

  • A minimum two current years’ experience in a production or materials role in manufacturing industry.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing techniques and processes.
  • Bachelor's Degree, required in Engineering, Supply Chain, or Business (or equivalent demonstrated combination of education and experience).
  • Strategic and creative thinking to analyze issues that may arise and create solutions.
  • Experience with MRP systems.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while having a high degree of attention to details.
  • Knowledge of production/materials control system.
  • Understanding of continuous improvement, lean manufacturing concepts and production schedules preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Demonstrates effective communication skills and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to influence, motivate, coach, and drive accountability.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Access.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Oversees Production Scheduling and Material Planning
  • Work with various MRP, quality, and MES software systems to manage material and other systemic requirements.
  • Collaborates with warehouse team to review and improve inventory accuracy and cycle counting programs
  • Lead material presentation on all the production lines.
  • Ensure work order and transactional accuracy as our customers and internal stakeholders change material requirements for modernization and new build locomotive programs.
  • Meet inventory targets including month-end and quarter-close processes for inventory in addition to achieving an elevated level of accuracy during yearly physical inventory.
  • Drive YOY inventory reduction and accuracy improvements & customer on-time performance.
  • Provide clear communication and technical materials guidance to management and other Wabtec employees daily.
  • Be expected to occasionally report on and present materials metrics and project improvements to senior and executive leadership.
  • Work as part of a cross functional team, driving a "one team" focus, dedicated to customer success within the shop.
  • Be expected to take ownership of and lead projects for plantwide materials process improvement in addition to your scheduling and inventory responsibilities.
  • Be expected to take a leadership role in your department, flexing outside your traditional job responsibilities to assist and improve other shop operations functions.
  • Be expected to respond to issues and communicate quickly and effectively when time is of the utmost importance and to work long hours to ensure that the job gets done.

Who will you be working with?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services. Our team is focused on continually improving our best-in-class production capabilities. We combine deep domain expertise and tenured experience to deliver unparalleled products for our customers. Here you’ll interact daily with team members during the problem resolution process and will partner with other key stakeholders to support our internal customers and their responsibilities.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $68900-98200 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.


We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: REHABILITATION TECHNICIAN
description:

The Spaceport Experience Coordinator supports the planning and execution of employee programming, events, onsite services, and special initiatives that enhance daily life at Starbase. This role manages vendor logistics, prepares internal communications, assists with onboarding new residents, and plays a lead role in tour and guest support. The Coordinator is at the center of operations for employee experience and is essential to ensuring day-to-day offerings run smoothly and meet the SpaceX standard. The ideal candidate is highly organized, communicative, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-moving environment. They take ownership of logistics and follow-through, thrive on problem-solving, and are passionate about creating seamless experiences for both employees and guests.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coordinate logistics for experience events and programming, including timelines, run-of-show, vendor support, RSVPs, and onsite execution
  • Serve as a lead support for school, VIP, and internal tours, ensuring prep materials, handoffs, and tour logistics are complete and aligned
  • Manage resident orientation flow, assisting with welcome materials, amenity walkthroughs, and service introductions
  • Oversee scheduling, coordination, and communication for onsite service vendors (e.g. massage therapists, barbers, dog groomers)
  • Assist with weekly updates to internal calendars and communication platforms, including announcements and service reminders
  • Track and submit vendor invoices, purchase orders, and related expense documentation
  • Collaborate with technicians and specialists to prep event materials and ensure all programs are properly staged and supported
  • Partner cross-functionally with facilities, culinary, housekeeping, hospitality, and onsite leadership to align execution
  • Help collect feedback and observations to inform program improvements and planning

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 1+ years of experience in hospitality, event coordination, operations, or employee engagement

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong multitasking and time management skills
  • Experience coordinating events, vendors, or guest-facing programs
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Drive, or tools like Asana
  • Service-oriented with a proactive and collaborative work style
  • Organized, reliable, and comfortable working with shifting priorities

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be available for evenings, weekends, and overtime as needed
  • Must be able to travel to support offsite experience programs or operations at other SpaceX sites

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Head of AI Platform Partnerships
description:

News Corp Australia’s unrivalled content is a premium, high-value asset for global LLM developers and technology platforms. Just as semiconductors and energy are inputs to AI products, so is our editorial. And as consumers continue to evolve the way in which they consume news and journalism, we have a tremendous opportunity to form highly strategic partnerships with those platforms that could benefit from our content as an input.

As Head of AI Platform Partnerships, you will drive our monetisation strategy across major horizontal Search & AI platforms; including OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, and Amazon- as well as emerging channels. Balancing local deal leadership with global News Corp integration, you will maximise licensing revenue, deepen enterprise understanding of AI content usage, and safeguard our core intellectual property. This role has two direct reports.

  • AI Center of Excellence: Serve as an internal SME on AI and search platforms—delivering actionable insights, performance optimization, and shared learnings across publishing groups.

  • Strategic Partner Management: Manage high-level relationships with major Search & AI tech platform partners and serve as the main escalation lead for platform issues.

  • Market & Regulatory Intelligence: Track evolving AI technologies, legal precedents, and copyright legislation to defend IP rights and capture new opportunities.

  • Team Leadership: Coach and develop a high-performing team focused on partner management, integration, and commercial analysis.

Capabilities & Competencies

  • Rights & Licensing: Deep experience with content rights, commercial contracts, and licensing frameworks.

  • Platform & AI Knowledge: Strong understanding of search and AI product mechanics (LLMs, grounding/RAG, algorithms) and publisher optimization strategies.

  • Executive Communication: Ability to translate complex tech concepts into clear, commercial narratives for senior leadership.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong financial judgment focused on enterprise value, commercial trade-offs, recurring revenue, and pricing structures.

  • Adaptive Leadership: Track record of driving results and building strong cultures within fast-changing, ambiguous environments.

Who are you?

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Law, Commerce, Strategy, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience in big tech, digital media, SaaS, strategic business development, or IP licensing. Experience working with or within search and AI platforms will be highly regarded.

  • Demonstrated track record of negotiating and closing complex multi-party content licensing or technology agreements.

  • Direct experience in AI, content rights, or data syndication models is highly advantageous.

  • Experience working within large matrixed organisations and leading people to high performance outcomes.

Why News Corp Australia

Join a culture where innovation is our operating rhythm. You’ll work on a diverse portfolio of Australia’s most loved brands and play a pivotal role in leading the technological shift in how we create commercial content. Our vibrant, hybrid work environment and dynamic, values-driven culture empowers you to push boundaries, collaborate as one unified team, and make a positive, measurable impact for all Australians.

  • Health & wellbeing - Advice, support and facilities for healthy minds and bodies (including an onsite gym at our Adelaide, Brisbane & Sydney offices)

  • Time off - News offers a range of leave options to support your personal needs and moments that matter in life: Parental leave, Birthday leave, Volunteer leave, Career break and Compassionate leave.

In addition to our perks and benefits, employees have access to a number of initiatives and programs that support their wellbeing and professional growth, such as:

  • Giving back - Make a difference to our communities through volunteer opportunities and company-organised charity drives

We are proud to be Australia’s most impactful media group, we’re even prouder of what we stand for: Together, we inform, advocate and inspire all Australians, for a better Australia.In an evolving media industry our brands continue to drive the story and influence the agenda - 7.4 million Australians read one of our national, metro or regional paid daily titles a week. title: Canvasser
description:
About MF Professional Services, Inc.

MF Professional Services, Inc. (MFPS) provides human resources, payroll, benefits administration, and operational support to mission-driven organizations. This position may perform services on behalf of MFPS clients, including Mi Familia Vota and Mi Familia en Acción.

Position Summary

MFPS is seeking eight Canvassers to conduct door-to-door voter outreach in McAllen and surrounding Rio Grande Valley communities.

Canvassers will travel through assigned neighborhoods, knock on doors, speak directly with community members, and provide approved information about voter registration, voter education, civic participation, and electoral engagement. Employees will use approved scripts, materials, and MiniVAN to document voter contacts and outreach results.

Although this position is classified as hybrid, it requires substantial in-person fieldwork and outdoor door-to-door canvassing throughout the Rio Grande Valley.

This is a temporary position. The duration of the assignment will depend on campaign timelines, available funding, and organizational needs. Temporary employment does not guarantee continued employment or an extension of the assignment.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Conduct door-to-door canvassing within assigned McAllen and Rio Grande Valley communities.

  • Engage community members respectfully using approved scripts, talking points, and campaign materials.

  • Provide accurate information about voter registration, voter education, civic participation, and approved electoral initiatives.

  • Support voter identification, registration, education, and Get Out the Vote activities as assigned.

  • Respect individuals who decline to participate or request that an interaction end.

  • Accurately record doors knocked, successful contacts, responses, voter-registration activity, and other assigned metrics.

  • Use MiniVAN, VAN, mobile applications, or other approved field technology.

  • Protect voter information and completed, incomplete, spoiled, and unused voter-registration forms.

  • Return all forms, equipment, identification, and campaign materials according to established procedures and deadlines.

  • Never falsify, alter, discard, withhold, or misuse voter-registration forms or voter information.

  • Attend required launches, trainings, safety briefings, check-ins, and daily debriefings.

  • Follow assigned turf, schedules, geographic boundaries, goals, and reporting requirements.

  • Maintain regular communication and required check-ins with the Canvass Lead.

  • Promptly report inaccessible turf, equipment problems, safety concerns, or community incidents.

  • Follow property-access, solicitation, voter-registration, data-security, and field-safety procedures.

  • Report injuries, threats, harassment, accidents, law-enforcement interactions, or unsafe conditions promptly.

  • Treat community members, coworkers, supervisors, and members of the public with dignity and respect.

  • Accept coaching, retraining, and constructive feedback.

  • Accurately record all time worked and follow organizational attendance, timekeeping, meal-period, and rest-break procedures.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Previous door-to-door canvassing, voter-registration, campaign, community-outreach, organizing, customer-service, sales, or other public-facing experience preferred.

  • Strong communication, listening, and interpersonal skills.

  • Dependable, punctual, and comfortable approaching and speaking with residents at their homes.

  • Ability to follow scripts, instructions, turf assignments, reporting requirements, and safety procedures.

  • Ability to remain professional during difficult or unexpected interactions.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to complete forms and records accurately.

  • Ability to accept coaching and work independently and collaboratively as part of a field team.

  • Ability to use a smartphone, tablet, MiniVAN, or comparable mobile application.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and protect sensitive voter and organizational information.

  • Familiarity with McAllen and surrounding Rio Grande Valley communities preferred.

  • Experience working with Latino or other diverse communities preferred.

  • Professional proficiency in English and Spanish preferred.

  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including daytime, evening, and weekend assignments.

  • Ability to travel throughout McAllen and the Rio Grande Valley.

  • Must satisfy any voter-registration eligibility, training, appointment, or certification requirements applicable in Texas.

Physical and Work Requirements

This position requires extended periods of walking and standing outdoors. The employee must be able to travel on foot through residential neighborhoods while navigating sidewalks, stairs, uneven surfaces, and varying terrain.

The position requires the ability to carry outreach materials weighing up to 25 pounds and regularly use a smartphone, clipboard, voter-registration forms, literature, and other field equipment.

Work may occur in heat, rain, wind, direct sunlight, traffic, noise, and other changing field conditions. Reasonable accommodations will be considered for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Overview & Position Summary

This position supports residential construction operations by sourcing, bidding, negotiating, and contracting with trade partners and suppliers to support assigned communities. The role ensures competitive pricing, accurate scopes of work, and timely availability of materials and services to meet construction schedules and cost targets. Working cross-functionally with Construction, Estimating, Design, and Operations, this position contributes to budget accuracy, value engineering efforts, and consistent purchasing execution. The role operates with moderate supervision while applying professional judgment, market knowledge, and construction understanding to resolve routine to moderately complex purchasing challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Source, evaluate, and maintain qualified trade partners and suppliers to support assigned divisions or communities.
  • Prepare, issue, and manage bid packages, scopes of work, and takeoffs to ensure complete, accurate, and competitive pricing.
  • Solicit, analyze, and compare bids; negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts in alignment with company policies and budget targets.
  • Coordinate closely with Construction, Estimating, Operations, and Product teams to align purchasing decisions with plans, specifications, schedules, and build cycles.
  • Maintain purchasing data, contracts, scopes, and pricing within purchasing and ERP systems, ensuring consistency and accuracy across communities.
  • Support value engineering initiatives by analyzing costs, identifying alternatives, and recommending cost-effective solutions without compromising quality.
  • Monitor trade partner performance, availability, and compliance; assist in resolving pricing discrepancies, scope gaps, or performance concerns.
  • Support new community setup activities, including bid launches, contract awards, documentation setup, and community kickoff coordination.
  • Research market conditions, materials, and supplier trends to support competitive positioning and informed purchasing decisions.
  • Assist with process improvements, documentation standards, and best practices to improve purchasing efficiency and cost control.

Education & Experience

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in purchasing, supply chain, or construction operations OR 6–8 years of equivalent experience.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in homebuilding or residential construction purchasing.
  • Familiarity with procurement platforms or construction-related purchasing tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Solid understanding of purchasing principles, contract terms, and cost analysis.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor-management capabilities.
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, evaluate alternatives, and recommend solutions.
  • Effective communication skills for working with suppliers and cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with purchasing or ERP systems, spreadsheets, and data analysis tools.
  • Detail orientation with strong organizational and follow-through abilities.
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, scopes, and material requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills using prior experience and analytical thinking.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced work environment.

Working Conditions

Work is primarily conducted in a professional office setting with regular interaction across departments and suppliers. Occasional travel to construction sites is required to verify scopes, evaluate supplier performance, or support operational needs. Limited travel to vendor facilities, trade events, or regional meetings may also be required based on business priorities.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods in an office environment.
  • Ability to walk construction sites with uneven surfaces during field visits.
  • Ability to lift and carry documents, samples, or materials up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to use hands and fingers for computer work, documentation, and communication tools.
  • Ability to clearly communicate in person, by phone, and in written formats.

Comprehensive Benefits Package

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families:

  • Competitive Compensation: We provide a competitive compensation structure that rewards performance and results.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive coverage includes medical, dental, and vision insurance options, as well as Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).
  • Financial Future: Access a 401(k) retirement savings plan.
  • Time Off: Our time-off benefits include vacation, sick leave, paid holidays, and other leave types (bereavement, jury duty, FMLA, military leave).
  • Insurance & Protection: Company-provided life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, and short- and long-term disability coverage are included. An employee assistance program (EAP) is also available.
  • Exclusive Perks & Discounts
  • Homeownership & Financing: Take advantage of exclusive home purchase and financing discounts.
  • Pet Insurance: Enjoy discounted group pet insurance rates.

If you are ready for more than a job and seek a career with one of the most respected organizations in the industry, we encourage you to connect with us. Please visit our website at www.richmondamerican.com for additional information.

Sekisui House U.S., Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Loans Service Delivery QA and Reconciliation Associate
description:
About the Job

Location: Taguig

Corporate Title: Rank and File

Our Operations team is looking for experienced professionals to join us in Taguig with the role of Loans Service Delivery QA and Reconciliation Associate.

In this role, you will conduct quality assurance reviews across the Bank's consumer lending products, including Auto Loans, Mortgage Loans, Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Salary Loans, and ROPA, to ensure compliance with bank policies, standard procedures, regulatory requirements, and approved turnaround times. You will identify, assess, and escalate operational, compliance, and reputational risks through the review of loan records and documents, while supporting risk mitigation initiatives and maintaining the accuracy and integrity of lending processes.

Your dream. Our focus.

East West Banking Corporation (EastWest) is one of the largest universal banks in the Philippines, and is committed to continuously invest in people and in process, product, and service enhancements, and embrace new ideas to enhance the EastWest experience.

We empower our employees to drive their careers and are committed to provide the runway for them to grow. We value teamwork and individual initiative. Join us and be part of a highly engaged team, and a workplace that promotes development and goal attainment.

Whether you're just starting out, or already a seasoned professional, EastWest can help you unleash your potential, and bridge the gap between dream to success.

What the role will entail

  • Review and validate loan applications, supporting documents, collateral records, and customer information to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with KYC and lending requirements.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews across consumer lending products, ensuring adherence to the Bank's policies, credit guidelines, delegation of authority, maker-checker controls, and prescribed turnaround times.
  • Extract and analyze reports, account records, and loan files to identify discrepancies, control exceptions, process deviations, and potential risk exposures.
  • Coordinate with business units to clarify findings, escalate issues, and support the timely correction and regularization of documentation and process gaps.
  • Prepare and submit QA checklists, validation results, and review reports within established service-level and turnaround-time standards.
  • Help strengthen operational compliance and risk management by delivering accurate quality assurance reviews and supporting initiatives that mitigate audit, regulatory, and reputational risks.

What we're looking for

title: Sr. Investor - Intuitive Ventures
description:
Job Description

Intuitive Ventures is seeking a driven and intellectually curious investment professional to join our team as an Investor. This role sits at the heart of our deal-making engine — sourcing compelling opportunities, leading rigorous due diligence, managing portfolio relationships, and contributing to the fund's evolving investment thesis.

Candidates will be evaluated and placed at the appropriate level based on experience, demonstrated track record, and scope of prior responsibility. Both levels require a hands-on operator with strong analytical instincts, a developing network, and the drive to build proprietary deal flow.

Key Responsibilities

Due Diligence & Investment Committee

  • Lead specific due diligence workstreams including market sizing, customer references, GLG calls, and financial modeling

  • Draft high-quality investment memos for senior review and IC preparation; own deal mechanics from term sheet through close (P5)

  • Coordinate legal and technical reviews under partner guidance; synthesize findings across workstreams

Pipeline & Deal Sourcing

  • Independently source and qualify early-stage investment opportunities through outreach and ecosystem engagement

  • Maintain and update the deal pipeline database; conduct initial outreach to founders and screen inbound deals against fund criteria

  • Lead initial founder meetings and make prioritization recommendations

  • Proactively develop co-investor and ecosystem partner relationships

Portfolio Management

  • Serve as day-to-day point of contact for assigned portfolio companies; track key milestones and flag material risks to the senior team

  • Coordinate introductions between portfolio companies and internal business units and external networks

  • Support founders on introductions, recruiting, business development, and resource access

  • Escalate risks proactively and track performance against board-approved milestones

Strategic Landscape & Thesis Development

  • Develop sector overviews, competitive landscape maps, and market intelligence across assigned focus areas

  • Present landscape findings to the broader investment team on a regular cadence

  • Produce detailed landscape analyses that inform new investments and portfolio strategy

Conferences, Competitive Intelligence & Reporting

  • Attend relevant industry conferences; build foundational network and identify emerging companies

  • Maintain competitive intelligence trackers across assigned verticals

  • Lead quarterly reporting for assigned portfolio companies including KPI analysis and commentary

  • Represent the fund at conferences; own CI tracking and contribute to fund-level reporting

Qualifications

Required

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree

  • More than 3 years of post-graduate experience in venture capital, investment banking, private equity, management consulting, or a relevant operating role

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to build financial models, conduct market analysis, and synthesize complex information into clear investment recommendations

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to draft polished memos and present findings with conviction

  • Self-directed with high ownership mentality; able to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • Prior experience in or deep familiarity with one or more of the fund's focus areas

  • Existing relationships within the venture ecosystem — founders, co-investors, accelerators, or corporate development teams

  • Experience supporting or managing portfolio company relationships

title: 2026 Australia and New Zealand - Chess Academy
description:
What if your next chess move took you to Sydney to play the world champion?

The Chess Academy Australia and New Zealand is a one-of-a-kind program open to all students across Australia and New Zealand colleges and universities, whether you're a seasoned competitor or just love the game. In partnership with Team Liquid, IMC is bringing together the brightest student chess players in the country for a chance to qualify through an online Swiss-format tournament on Chess.com and, if you advance, travel to Sydney to compete in the championship finals against the best student players in the country.

This is more than a chess tournament. It's an opportunity to step inside one of the world's leading trading firms, connect with IMC's traders, researchers and technologists, and experience what it's like to think fast, compete hard, and perform under pressure. These are the skills that define both great chess players and the people who thrive at the world's top trading firms.

What You'll Do

  • Compete at the highest level: Qualify through an online Swiss-format tournament on Chess.com and, if you advance, travel to Sydney to compete in the championship finals against the best student players in the country.
  • Play Magnus Carlsen: All finalists take part in a showmatch experience with the World Chess Champion, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to sit across the board from one of the greatest players in history.
  • Learn from the best: Finalists will take part in an exclusive masterclass led by Magnus and Grandmaster Robert Hess, an opportunity to hear how two of the world's elite players think about the game.
  • Go behind the scenes at IMC: Tour IMC's Sydney office and get a firsthand look at the environment where some of the world's fastest and most sophisticated trading takes place.
  • Build your network: Connect directly with IMC traders, researchers, technologists, and recruiters. Whether or not a career in trading is on your radar, this is a rare chance to meet and learn from world-class professionals.

Key Dates

  • Applications Close: Sunday, November 1 2026
  • Eligibility Notifications: Wednesday November 4 2026
  • Virtual Qualifiers: Monday 9 November, Tuesday 10 November, Wednesday 11 November 2026
  • Championship at IMC Sydney: Wednesday 9 December 2026

What You'll Need

  • Currently enrolled as a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate student at an Australian or New Zealand college or university
  • Participants enrolled at a university in New Zealand must also hold New Zealand citizenship
  • 18 years of age or older
  • A valid Chess.com account
  • Available to compete in the virtual qualifiers during the week of 9, 10 or 11 November 2026
  • Available to travel to Sydney for the finals on 9 December 2026
  • Open to all majors and academic backgrounds, all skill levels welcome

Ready to Apply?

Applications are open to all enrolled students regardless of chess rating or experience level. If you love the game and want to test yourself against the best, we want to hear from you.

Apply by Sunday 1 November 2026.

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Senior IT Application Analyst
description:

As a Senior IT Application Analyst, you’ll help modernize and support the enterprise applications Community Transit employees rely on every day. You’ll play a key role in replacing our PeopleSoft Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, helping guide new solutions from implementation and integration through transition and ongoing support.

You’ll provide senior-level technical leadership across our enterprise application portfolio – solving complex problems, shaping technical solutions, coordinating integrations and enhancements, and ensuring applications are reliable, secure, and sustainable. You’ll partner across business departments, IT teams, project teams, and vendors to navigate dependencies, resolve issues, and successfully transition new and changing systems into operation.

We’re looking for an experienced application professional who brings strong technical judgment, problem-solving, and collaboration skills and is comfortable leading complex work across teams. You’ll also mentor other analysts, strengthen technical practices, and help build long-term application support capabilities. PeopleSoft and strong data management experience are especially valuable, particularly for candidates excited to apply that expertise while transitioning to modern, cloud-based ERP and HCM platforms.

Hybrid telework may be available. Work is performed in an office environment and requires the use of office equipment and technology. You will be required to move throughout and between different office buildings and may need to complete tasks in noisy environments. You may also be required to lift and carry materials up to 10 pounds occasionally.

title: Staff Product Manager, Data Strategy & Products
description:
This role offers the opportunity to shape a new data product portfolio and influence how data powers future innovation at Intuitive. You will work at the intersection of healthcare, robotics, AI/ML, clinical research, and platform product strategy.

You will have meaningful leadership visibility, broad cross-functional exposure, and the opportunity to build foundational products that help teams move faster, make better decisions, and unlock new value from data.

Intuitive is a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care. Data increasingly powers how we create value for hospitals, surgeons, patients, and internal innovation teams.

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager, Data Strategy & Products to define and scale connected data products that accelerate AI/ML development, clinical research, product innovation, and future health system-facing services.

This role will lead product discovery, prioritization, business case development, and roadmap execution across a complex stakeholder landscape. The successful candidate will turn ambiguous opportunities into clear product bets, investment recommendations, and measurable outcomes.

  • Facilitate roadmap reviews, prioritization forums, and execution checkpoints.
  • Partner with engineering, data science, architecture, governance, security, privacy, clinical, regulatory, and commercial teams to execute the roadmap.

  • Build trusted partnerships across functions and serve as a product leader for data-driven innovation.

title: HELPER-PRODUCTION WORKER/ TRIMMER
description:
Production Helper


Join Laminate Technologies as a Production Helper and become an integral part of our dynamic manufacturing team. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented environment where every team member plays a vital role in delivering high-quality products. If you are motivated, adaptable, and eager to develop your skills in a manufacturing setting, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities:

- Assist Machine Operators by performing tasks such as pushing, trimming, holding materials or tools, and supporting production processes.

- Maintain cleanliness and organization of work areas to ensure a safe and efficient environment.

- Inspect workpieces for smoothness, defects, and measure them to verify accuracy of machine operation using appropriate measuring tools.

- Examine raw materials for defects and verify conformance to quality standards before processing.

- Lift, move, and handle raw materials and finished products safely and efficiently.

- Support multiple departments and positions as needed, demonstrating flexibility and teamwork.

- Follow safety protocols and company policies to promote a safe working environment.

- High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

- Flexibility to work in various departments and adapt to changing priorities.

- Good communication skills and ability to work well within a team.

Please note: As this role requires a high level of security clearance, you will need to be / have been a NZ, UK, Australian, Canadian or USA citizen for a minimum of 10 years to be eligible for this role.

The successful candidate is required to undergo a psychological assessment as part of the pre-employment security vetting process.

Your skills and dedication deserve recognition, and NZDF delivers with competitive pay matched to your experience. But that's just the beginning – safeguard your loved ones with a fully funded life cover of up to $300,000 and critical illness protection. Other benefits include discounted additional insurances, free will services and savings schemes for the Defence community. Get expert financial guidance and mortgage broker services. Join us in shaping a brighter future, where everyone thrives.


Me pēhea te tuku tono | How to Apply

Applications close on Wednesday 7 October 2026.

Use the links on this page where you’ll be directed to the Defence Careers website.

Please Note:

  • All applications must be made online, via the Defence Careers website. Each listing contains the Position Description and a Contact Us option for any queries or technical issues.

  • Your cover letter will be a key part of our selection process, so please highlight how your experience relates to the key activities outlined in the Advert and Position Description.

  • Applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment drug-screening test prior to any offer of employment being made.

NZDF Employees/Members – please apply internally via the HR Toolkit; this will ensure that you are visible as an internal candidate.

NZDF Contractors – please apply via the Defence Careers website.

NZDF Reserves – please apply via the Defence Careers website if you cannot access the HR Toolkit.

Please Note:

To be eligible for the required level of government security clearance with the NZ Defence Force, you need to meet certain citizenship and residency criteria. Here’s what you need to know:

Higher Level Security Clearance

  • You must be a New Zealand Citizen for at least the last ten (10) years.

  • At minimum, you must hold New Zealand Permanent Residence or have a current New Zealand Residency Class Visa, and you must be a citizen of and have lived in Australia, Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America or New Zealand continuously for the last ten (10) years.

  • To obtain this level of clearance, you must have a background history of fifteen (15) years that can be verified and assessed appropriately by the NZ Security Intelligence Service (NZSIS) to determine if you are suitable for a security clearance at this level.

If you do not meet the minimum criteria, unfortunately, your application will not be accepted. We do welcome your application at a time when you will meet the requirements.

title: Director of Alliances
description:
DataHub is an AI & Data Context Platform adopted by over 3,000 enterprises, including Apple, CVS Health, Netflix, and Visa. Innovated jointly with a thriving open-source community of 13,000+ members, DataHub's metadata graph provides in-depth context of AI and data assets with best-in-class scalability and extensibility.

The company's enterprise SaaS offering, DataHub Cloud, delivers a fully managed solution with AI-powered discovery, observability, and governance capabilities. Organizations rely on DataHub solutions to accelerate time-to-value from their data investments, ensure AI system reliability, and implement unified governance, enabling AI & data to work together and bring order to data chaos.

About DataHub

DataHub transforms enterprise data into trusted context, enabling intelligent decision-making by humans and AI agents. The company was founded by the creators of the popular DataHub open source product that has more than 16,000 contributors and is used by thousands of organizations. The company’s flagship product, DataHub Cloud, is the leading context management platform trusted by the Global 2000 to ensure that context is always relevant, reliable, and continuously refreshed across the entire data estate.

The Role

DataHub | Reports to Chief Marketing Officer

Partnerships are a core lever in DataHub's growth. We're hiring a Director of Alliances to own our partnership strategy end to end: building the systems that let partners help us close deals faster, deliver complete solutions, and generate new pipeline.

You'll build and run three interlocking motions: co-selling with hyperscalers and technology partners, certifying systems integrators to implement DataHub, and co-marketing with partners to source net new opportunities. This is a builder role. You'll design the playbooks, negotiate the agreements, and run the day to day partner relationships that turn strategy into revenue.

What You'll Own

Partner-Influenced (Co-Sell)

  • Build and run a structured, repeatable co-sell playbook with hyperscalers and other strategic technology partners
  • Register deals, introduce account executives to partner counterparts, and drive joint pursuit of opportunities
  • Own hyperscaler alliance relationships, including specialization and co-sell scoring programs
  • Grow the share of deals that are meaningfully influenced by a partner

Partner-Fulfilled (Certification)

  • Stand up a certification program for systems integrators, covering technical enablement, implementation, and specialized delivery tracks (such as compliance or migration work)
  • Build enablement content, technical training, and a tiered partner scoring model
  • Manage relationships with a portfolio of SI and GSI partners
  • Grow the number of certified partners who can independently deliver DataHub implementations

Partner-Sourced (Co-Marketing)

  • Identify and prioritize target accounts using partner pipeline, look-alike data, and joint account mapping
  • Plan and execute joint marketing programs, from webinars to executive events, tailored to technical, business, and economic buyer personas
  • Build joint partner pages, co-branded content, and the tracking infrastructure needed to attribute partner-sourced pipeline
  • Grow the volume of net new opportunities sourced through partners

Program and Relationship Management

  • Own the partnership roadmap and planning cadence, coordinating across sales, marketing, and product
  • Negotiate and manage partnership agreements
  • Represent DataHub at partner and industry events, including partner participation in DataHub's own conference and field events
  • Partner closely with the technical enablement and events functions to deliver a complete partner experience

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel roles at an enterprise software or data infrastructure company
  • Direct experience building or scaling co-sell programs with hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)
  • Experience standing up SI/GSI partner programs, including certification and enablement
  • A track record of turning partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue, not just signed agreements
  • Comfort operating at both strategic and hands on levels: you can build a three year alliance strategy and also personally register a deal in APN
  • Strong cross functional collaborator, able to align sales, marketing, and product around shared partner goals
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for partner negotiations and executive reporting

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the data catalog, data governance, or metadata management space
  • Experience with compliance or regulatory frameworks relevant to regulated industries
  • Existing relationships within the AWS, Google Cloud, or major SI partner ecosystems

Reporting and Location

This role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and works closely with sales leadership, product marketing, and the technical enablement team.

Benefits and Perks

We invest in people so they can do their best work and enjoy doing it. Our benefits reflect the way we build: practical, thoughtful, and designed to support long-term growth.

Competitive compensation

We offer salaries that reflect your skills, experience, and the impact you make. You bring value—we make sure you're recognized for it.

Equity for everyone

Every team member receives an ownership stake in the company. When we grow, you grow with us.

Remote Work

All roles are remote unless otherwise specified in the job description. Review the job description to confirm if the role you are interested in is remote or hybrid.

Location flexibility

Home office, coworking space, or something in between? We support your ideal setup. You’ll receive a monthly coworking stipend to use whenever you need a change of pace or in-person collaboration time.

Comprehensive health coverage

Your well-being matters. We cover 99% of medical, dental, and vision premiums employees, and 65% for dependents.

Flexible savings accounts

We offer FSAs to help cover planned or unexpected healthcare costs. You can also opt into a Dependent Care FSA to support family needs.

Support for every path to parenthood

Through Carrot Fertility, we provide inclusive fertility benefits and family-forming support. All U.S. employees have access, regardless of age, gender identity, or family structure.

Time off that works for you

We trust you to take the time you need. Our unlimited PTO and sick leave policy is designed for flexibility, rest, and real life.

Why Join Us

DataHub is at a rare inflection point: we’ve achieved product-market fit, earned the trust of leading enterprises, and secured backing from top-tier investors like Bessemer Venture Partners and 8VC. The context platform market is expected to grow from $1B to $9B in the next five years—and we’re leading the way.

By joining our team, you’ll:

  • Tackle high-impact challenges at the heart of enterprise AI infrastructure
  • Ship production systems that power real-world use cases at global scale
  • Collaborate with a high-caliber team of builders who’ve scaled some of the most influential data tools in the world
  • Build the next generation of AI-native data systems, including conversational agents, intelligent classification, automated governance, and more

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy working with customers, and want to be part of a fast-growing company changing the industry, we want to hear from you!

The Station Engineer collaboratively uses judgment to determine adaptations in methods for non-routine aspects of assignments and may be required to perform activities such as station and plant design, collaborate closely with clients on project execution, cost estimating, field measurements, field testing, preparation and correction of field drawings, ordering material, initiation of permits, preparing operating and maintenance instructions, data analysis, compilation and reporting of technical data, construction support, subcontractor management and performance of other related duties.
