title: Community Engagement Specialist, Harvard Innovation Labs
description:
Job Summary:

The Community Specialist owns the relationship with our students in the Harvard Innovation Labs ecosystem. The Community Specialist acts as a community communications strategist, creating systems and campaigns that engage members, build community, and create responsive and customized experiences for students. The role is responsible for cultivating a strong sense of engagement and participation among all Harvard Innovation Labs (HIL) members and offers support by performing a variety of complex administrative and support duties to enhance the HIL programs and resources. This includes building and managing the day-to-day experience of participants using i-lab resources, coordinating communications across different channels, and developing and executing community-related programming. The role reports to the Assistant Director, Programming and Member Experience.

Please see for more information about the Harvard Innovation Labs.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Student Community & Program Management:

  • Responsible for the development and management of the student I-lab community and its 3000+ active members, including application cycle promotion, a weekly newsletter, i-lab member Slack workspaces, events planning, and customer service for program participants in collaboration with Operations and front desk teams.

  • Ensures that student members are connected, supports collaboration across Harvard Schools, and develops programming and systems to ensure that participants can communicate and collaborate with each other.

  • Manages inquiry processes from prospective student members, develops communications to convert applicants into members, and guides students through the application/membership funnel.

  • Fosters a positive and collaborative community through daily engagement with students. Monitors news, happenings, feedback, struggles, and wins. Oversees development and synthesizes data from customer surveys, feedback, focus groups, and other data sources to provide insights, support decision-making, and inform program improvements and strategy. Designs and executes regular “pulse checks” of the community (e.g., short surveys, quick interviews) and translates qualitative and quantitative data into clear, actionable recommendations for the team. Constantly seeks opportunities to serve students better and streamline administrative operations.

  • Plans and executes community-related programming such as welcome events, end of term events, sub-community sessions, lunches, dinners, and other programming that brings the community together. In total, supports ~30-40 events throughout the academic year in close collaboration with the Events and Operations teams, who lead event production and logistics.

  • Designs, launches, and manages student-facing initiatives that bridge the gap between HIL and the broader student community, such as a Student Ambassador program. Recruits, onboards, and supports student ambassadors and other student leaders to extend the reach of i-lab programs across campus.

  • Manages and supports the administration and execution of new programs/ community engagement opportunities: cross-university innovation mixers, collaborations with Harvard stakeholders (student clubs), and external partners (AWS NextGen).

  • Manages and oversees the Ingenuity Award program as part of the President’s Innovation Challenge, including timeline, application process, venture evaluation process, and supporting programming such as pitch practice.

Marketing, Communication, and Operations for Student Membership Community:

  • Develops and executes strategy to effectively communicate opportunities, events, resources, and applications to students while managing the overall editorial calendar for Student i-lab Member communications (in partnership with HIL marketing + communications team). Gathers useful information and resources for students, synthesizes and writes clear outputs that drive information and attendance, such as newsletters, event promotions, engagement tracking and RSVPs.

  • Serves as the primary liaison for the student track of the President’s Innovation Challenge (PIC) and Ingenuity Award finalists. Manages direct communications with the student finalist teams to gather promotional materials and share detailed workshops and schedules. Plans Ingenuity Award-specific programming (pitch sessions, orientation, finalist announcement, etc.).

  • Tracks engagement in student workshops and events: event registrations, attendance, and student surveys.

  • Supports the creation and execution of marketing collateral from the student perspective and makes recommendations for content based on student feedback (handouts, guides, videos, decks and presentations)

Other:

  • Represents HIL at internal and external events; leads or moderates founder panels, club meetings, attends ecosystem gathering across Harvard and Boston as a representative of the student i-lab.

  • Builds and nurtures close collaborations with teams across HIL, including Advising, Network Engagement, Marketing + Creative, Technology, Operations, and ensures that community initiatives are aligned and coordinated on objectives. Implement repeatable processes that work well for all involved. Supports additional HIL projects, operations, and events as needed.

  • May manage and prioritize the workload, performance management, and professional development of interns.

  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent is required.
  • 5+ years of experience in administrative support role(s) is required.
  • Education beyond high school may count toward experience.
  • Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) experience is a must.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Community engagement, student support, program management, or related experience.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Demonstrated customer service skills.

  • An individual who is naturally outgoing and has a positive attitude. Someone who can work well with others and build relationships across teams.

  • Good with people’s names, stories and, making connections.

  • Must possess superior communication skills with high creativity, energy, integrity, thoughtful judgement.

  • The position requires a high level of organization and proactivity, paired with strong problem-solving skills. The role requires you to work independently but have the judgement to know when to ask for help or clarification.

  • An individual who can learn various technology systems quickly and thinks carefully about how to best use the tools to get the job done. Someone comfortable learning university software and systems such as Salesforce, MIDAS, SurveyMonkey Apply.

  • Ability to perform in a fast-paced and demanding workplace, with a high standard of excellence and keen attention to detail.

  • Experience designing and executing community or membership communications (e.g., newsletters, campaigns, or multi-channel outreach) preferred

  • Comfort analyzing basic data and trends (e.g., surveys, participation data, dashboards) to inform decisions and improve programs.

Working Conditions:

  • Ability to work occasional extra hours as well as a flexible schedule, to meet deadlines and oversee and/or attend evening events.
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 40 hours per week, overtime eligible position

title: Cloud Developer REQ133
description:
As a Senior Cloud Developer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and supporting secure and resilient cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS. You will work closely with application, security, network, and operations teams to deliver reliable and compliant cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in cloud platforms, Infrastructure as Code, cloud networking, security, automation, and production operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure across enterprise and multi-account environments.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and operational activities using Terraform, Ansible, AWS Systems Manager, Python, and other automation tools.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure, networking, deployment, and automation issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.
  • Implement cloud security requirements and support the remediation of security, compliance, vulnerability, and audit findings.
  • Monitor and continuously improve cloud infrastructure availability, performance, resilience, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain cloud architecture documentation, technical standards, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with application, cybersecurity, network, cloud service provider, and vendor teams to translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, and supportable cloud solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance to engineers and project teams, participate in architecture and solution reviews, and promote engineering best practices across cloud infrastructure, automation, security, and operations.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise AWS cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in AWS architecture and core services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, and multi-account AWS environments.
  • Strong understanding of AWS IAM and cloud security, including least-privilege access, access governance, security controls, vulnerability remediation, and audit and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with Singapore Government Commercial Cloud (GCC/GCC+) environments would be a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with experience performing root cause analysis and resolving complex production infrastructure issues.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for cloud infrastructure automation and integration.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure deployment using tools such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, or equivalent.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams and communicate technical concepts to stakeholders at different levels.

  • Experience analyzing large datasets and developing metrics, KPIs, dashboards, reports, and executive recommendations.

  • Architecture & System Design: Distributed consensus, multi-tenant isolation, caching strategies, and event-driven systems.

  • Operational Excellence: Chaos engineering, observability (tracing, metrics, logging), and automated incident mitigation.

  • Technical Strategy & Execution: Ability to break down ambiguous, company-wide technical problems into clear, phased engineering initiatives.

title: Spacecraft Propulsion Technician
description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

As a Spacecraft Propulsion Technician, you will be part of the team developing and scaling production of the highest-powered electric propulsion system ever put into orbit. In this role you will support Hall effect thruster assembly, COPV proof testing, and system level production acceptance testing. The ideal candidate is a highly hands-on technician comfortable working across mechanical, electrical, and fluid systems in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on assembly of the Hall thruster and sub-assemblies to engineering drawings, BOMs, and work instructions
  • Support system integration and high-pressure operations following released procedures and safety protocols; leak checks, proof testing, pressure system functional verification on feed system and COPVs
  • Fabricate, bend, fit, and install precision tubing and fluid lines; perform and fitting operations to required standards
  • Fabricate wire harnesses from assembly drawings and electrical schematics
  • Collaborate closely with manufacturing, test, quality, and design engineering to resolve hardware issues in real time
  • Follow detailed work instructions and manufacturing procedures, performing all work in the MES system (scanning, material consumption, and built traceability)
  • Support setup of vacuum chamber for acceptance and performance testing
  • Support receiving, inspection, and handling of COPVs
  • Practice 5S principles of organizing and sustaining an efficient and presentable workspace
  • Provide consistent process improvement feedback to engineering and production leadership
  • Occasionally support vehicle integration operations and other related departments

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on aerospace assembly and test experience in propulsion, pressure systems, fluid systems, or high-reliability hardware
  • Experience with pressure testing, leak checking, proof/burst testing, or COPV handling
  • Familiarity with MES/MRP software
  • Familiar with calibrated tools including multi-meters, torque wrenches, safety cable guns, and crimpers
  • Demonstrated high level of ownership and problem-solving abilities
  • Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with electric propulsion systems and familiarity with pressure testing, vacuum chambers, turbo pumps, roughing pumps, gauges
  • Ability to read mechanical and engineering drawings and interpret tolerances (including GD&T)
  • Experience working with engineering teams in development and production environments
  • Experience operating forklifts, cranes, and heavy equipment
  • Strong communication skills with ability to communicate hardware and systems problems, and provide feedback on improving tooling processes and part design
  • Ability to obtain or currently hold top secret/SCI security clearance

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to perform repetitive tasks such as bending or twisting, grasping, standing, lifting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, carrying, and use hands to operate tools or machine controls
  • Must be able to lift and carry parts or equipment up to 50 lbs. unassisted
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time
  • Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Hourly pay range for this non-exempt role is $35 - $45 + equity in the company
  • Compensation will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). In this role, you will bridge broad business vision with seamless operational execution to optimize portfolio access, enhance revenue protection, and drive cross-functional alignment. Furthermore, you will champion operational excellence by identifying and executing opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to evolve contract operations and streamline processes across a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment.

Expert understanding and direct experience within the Payer/PBM and specialty pharmacy segment is preferred.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

HexArmor® is a leader in developing some of the most advanced PPE solutions for your eyes, hands, arms, and body. At HexArmor®, we believe safety is not a luxury – it’s a necessity. Since day one, we have worked hand-in-hand with our customers to design innovative, high performance PPE that helps ensure workers return home in the same condition they arrived. Our mission is to provide the protection that makes this possible, for every worker, everywhere. We sell both retail and direct-to-business.

SUMMARY

We are seeking an enthusiastic and creative Videography Intern to join our New Media team for the summer of 2027. The Videography Intern will work closely with the New Media Director to create engaging short-form video content for social media, streaming channels, product marketing, and other digital platforms. This role will provide hands-on experience developing creative concepts, filming, editing, and producing content that showcases HexArmor products and the brand in engaging ways.

The right candidate will have a strong interest in video production, storytelling, and current social media and video trends. The Videography Intern will have the opportunity to contribute creative ideas, work alongside team members on video concepts, and independently develop content with guidance from the New Media Director.

LOCATION

Onsite at HexArmor Corporate Headquarters in Grand Rapids, Michigan (640 Leffingwell Ave. NE Grand Rapids, MI)

SCHEDULE

This is a 14-week, full-time internship beginning May 17, 2027. Interns will work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, during our standard business hours of 8:30am to 5:00pm.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Capture on-site and studio footage using HexArmor-provided video, lighting, and audio equipment.
  • Develop creative concepts and ideas for short-form video, product content, and social media.
  • Film and produce engaging content that highlights HexArmor products and their applications.
  • Edit recorded footage into engaging, polished, and brand-aligned final deliverables.
  • Add motion effects, graphics, music, transitions, and sound design to enhance storytelling.
  • Follow current video, social media, and content trends and identify opportunities to incorporate them into HexArmor content.
  • Collaborate with the New Media team and other internal teams to develop and execute creative content.
  • Support photography and cinematography needs for product and brand content.
  • Maintain and manage video and audio equipment, digital storage systems, and content archives.
  • Track time and manage video projects through JIRA or similar project management tools.
  • Use basic AI tools and technologies to streamline video editing workflows, support creative ideation, and improve efficiency.
  • Assist with additional video, photography, and creative projects as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Video Production, Film, Media Production, Graphic Design, Creative Writing, Marketing, or a related field. Seeking 2027 and 2028 graduates.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition, or related creative tools.
  • Basic photography and cinematography skills.
  • Strong creative thinking and storytelling skills.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience creating video or other digital content through coursework, internships, personal projects, or extracurricular activities.
  • Experience creating content for social media platforms.
  • Portfolio or examples of video, photography, or other creative work.

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive Hourly Wage

title: Project Manager – Transmission & Data
description:
Salary: $6,000 – $8,500 per month

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – Transmission & Data to oversee the end-to-end delivery of enterprise telecommunications infrastructure and transmission network projects. In this role, you will lead project execution from initial scoping through to commissioning and handover, ensuring delivery within schedule, scope, and budget. You will serve as the operational bridge between enterprise clients, sales teams, engineering divisions, and regional network vendors.

Key responsibilities

  • Direct and coordinate full project lifecycles for transmission, data connectivity, and fixed-line telecom implementations (including SDH, DWDM, IP-VPN, and MPLS networks)

  • Liaise with local loop providers, sub-contractors, and regional carriers to facilitate smooth service provisioning, site surveys, cross-connects, and equipment installation

  • Oversee project scheduling, resource allocation, and budget tracking. Implement risk mitigation strategies to prevent delivery delays and cost overruns

  • Partner with Account Managers during the pre-sales phase to assess delivery feasibility, review technical project scope, and support CRM pipeline updates

  • Monitor internal provisioning workflows and order-management systems; maintain accurate technical documentation, delivery SOPs, and knowledge repositories

  • Facilitate regular progress meetings, manage acceptance sign-offs, and deliver status reports to client project sponsors and executive management

  • Undertake ad-hoc technical or project-related assignments to support evolving operational requirements

About you

  • Bachelor's Degree, Professional Degree, or Advanced Diploma in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline

  • Minimum 4 years of technical project management or provisioning experience within the telecommunications service provider or carrier industry

  • Strong working knowledge of carrier-grade transmission and data technologies (e.g., Optical Transmission/DWDM, OTN, Ethernet, IP/MPLS, Leased Lines)

  • Prior experience collaborating with regional telecommunications carriers, tier-1 operators, or cross-border network service providers (particularly across the APAC and Greater China regions) is an advantage

  • Full professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required

  • Professional fluency in spoken and written Chinese is required, and conversational Cantonese is advantageous, to communicate directly with non-English-speaking regional engineering teams, vendor NOCs, and enterprise client stakeholders based in Greater China

  • Proficiency in CRM platforms and project delivery management tools

  • Strong client-facing communication, contract coordination, and negotiation skills

  • Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, CCNA/CCNP) are preferred

Flexible Work Arrangement: Employees are eligible for hybrid work arrangement after probation, including one work-from-home day per week.

By submitting your personal data and/or resume, you give consent to collection, use and disclosure of your personal data and/or resume by the company (or its agent) for the purpose of the processing and administration by the company relating to this job application.

title: Senior Business Analyst (x3)
description:
About Airways:
Our people manage New Zealand's 30 million square kms of airspace, providing air traffic control, surveillance, communication, flight inspection, mapping, and airspace design services. We work with government, regulatory authorities, airlines, airports, and the general aviation community to ensure pilots, passengers and goods reach their destination - safely. At Airways, our values underpin all that we do. We value Safety, One Airways, Excellence and Success in all that we do.

Our organisation is made up of operational business groups that are supported by governance and corporate services functions. To learn more about our people and organisational structure, check out www.airways.co.nz/about.

About the Team:
The Technology Group is responsible for the effective delivery, management and services of all technology disciplines within the air navigation services environment, including engineering design, software design and development, technology architecture and infrastructure, asset management, installation and maintenance, technical training, workload planning, maintenance programme development, project management and logistics support.

The Portfolio Delivery department is a key function in the Technology Group responsible for the effective planning and delivery of programmes and projects that support Airways in achieving its strategic goals. The Portfolio Delivery team provides programme, project and delivery practice capabilities across Airways and works with business and technology stakeholders to provide governance, delivery support, standards, methods, tools and continuous improvement for portfolio, programme and project management activities.

About the Projects:
With over a hundred projects on the go at any given point of time, our projects span across engineering/infrastructure, electrical/power, networks, enterprise systems and property.

Our uniquely complex environment includes 20+ inhouse systems, hardware (design, build, installation and maintenance) at 90+ NavAid sites, networks (design, implementation and maintenance), IT services (design, maintenance and improvement), construction and maintenance of buildings.

About the Role:
We have three (3) permanent full-time opportunities for Senior Business Analysts to join us at our Auckland (airport) office or Christchurch campus, with preference for these roles to be Christchurch based.

Reporting to the Delivery Practice Manager, you’ll lead delivery-focused business analysis for complex technology, operational investment and change initiatives across Airways. Working with sponsors, stakeholders, delivery teams and technical specialists, you’ll clarify business needs, shape options and support sound delivery and investment decisions.

You’ll provide senior analysis leadership across the project lifecycle as it helps ensure change is safe, effective, value-driven and aligned with Airways' strategic objectives and regulatory obligations. The project lifecycle includes initiative shaping, business case development, requirements management, solution assessment, readiness and benefits realisation.

As a senior practitioner within the Portfolio Delivery team, you’ll lead the development and improvement of business analysis standards, practices and capability across Airways. Additionally, you’ll provide guidance to other practitioners, strengthen delivery quality, and help build a connected Business Analysis Community of Practice.

For a full list of tasks and responsibilities, refer to the attached position description on our careers site.

About You:
You’ll bring experience leading business analysis across the full project and programme delivery lifecycle within agile or hybrid environments.

Additionally, you will have:

  • 8+ years senior business analysis experience, including:

    • Leading analysis for complex business, technology, operational and change initiatives

    • Shaping business cases, options analysis and investment recommendations

    • Familiarity with benefits definition, measurement and realisation practices

    • Working with structured governance, assurance and gated delivery environments

    • Coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to business analysts or delivery practitioners.

  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Business Analysis, Information Systems, Technology, Commerce or related discipline.

  • Advanced experience in requirements analysis, traceability and change control.

  • Ability to work in a dynamic business environment, influence and collaborate with people internally and externally, show resilience and agility, take ownership and focus on delivering successful business outcomes.

Beneficial:

  • Experience supporting critical infrastructure, operational technology or safety-focused environments.

  • Experience leading business analysis practice improvement, quality assurance, standards, templates, methods or communities of practice.

  • Business process analysis and modelling skills (BPMN).

  • Knowledge of project, programme and portfolio management frameworks.

  • Advanced business analysis certification such as CBAP, BCS International Diploma in Business Analysis, or equivalent senior practitioner accreditation.

  • Knowledge of BABOK principles and practices.

To Apply:
Expand your career at a State-Owned Enterprise (SOE) with an international reputation for innovation and success by submitting your application (CV and cover letter) via the Airways careers site or Seek.

Please note that you must be legally eligible to work in New Zealand to be considered.

This role will require the successful candidate to undergo pre-employment background checks including but not limited to references, drug and alcohol screening and criminal conviction.

Application closing date is Wednesday, 7 October 2026.

At Airways, our people are at the heart of what we do to keep NZ skies safe. We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where people feel they belong and can bring their whole self to work. We make our recruitment decisions based on the best candidate for the job and encourage applications from diverse candidates. We are proud to hold both Rainbow Tick and Gender Tick accreditations.

title: Recreation Therapist - Bachelor's Degree
description:
Salary Details

The salary range for this position is CAD $40.19/Hr. - CAD $50.20/Hr.

Job Summary

Come work as a Recreation Therapist with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH) at G.F. Strong Rehabilitation Centre in Vancouver, BC! Apply now to join the team!

Within the context of a dynamic patient/client/resident and family-centred care model, and in accordance with established standards of professional practice, and the vision and values of the organization, works in a team-based environment and provides therapeutic recreation/leisure interventions to designated patient/clients/residents. Participates as a member of an integrated collaborative health care team by assessing the patient’s/client’s/resident’s recreation and leisure needs, abilities and interests, maintaining a variety of records, planning and implementing therapeutic recreation care plans, evaluating the effectiveness of the intervention and communicating with the patient/client/resident/family and health care team members. Contributes to the organization and delivery of Recreation Therapy services and participates in designated quality assurance initiatives, meetings, research and education, as required.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Certified Therapeutic Recreation Specialist (CTRS) credential and successful completion of the National Council for Therapeutic Recreation Certification (NCTRC) exam.
  • Baccalaureate in Therapeutic Recreation or Leisure Studies from an accredited university.
  • Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and Emergency First Aid.
  • Valid Class IV Driver's License.

Knowledge & Abilities

  • Basic knowledge of recreation therapy theory and practice within a rehabilitation and/or patient/client/resident/family centred model of care.
  • Basic knowledge of evidence-based clinical practice related to designated clinical area.
  • Basic knowledge of research process and methodology.

title: Principal Client Platform Engineer
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox is seeking a Principal Client Platform Engineer to serve as the technical architect of our global endpoint ecosystem. Reporting to the Client Services Manager, you will define the long-term strategy for how our fleet scales, secures, and evolves. This role goes beyond day-to-day management — you will establish architectural standards, drive automation-first platform design, and ensure thousands of builders have secure, reliable tools to do their best work. From strengthening our security posture in a complex hybrid environment to mentoring senior engineers, you will shape the technical foundation that powers innovation at Roblox.

You Will:

  • Standardize the global security and management strategy for our entire fleet of macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and ChromeOS devices to ensure peak performance and ironclad compliance.
  • Evolve of our deployment pipeline, driving the automated rollout of patches, OS upgrades, and complex certificate lifecycles for all endpoints.
  • Lead the hardening of our endpoint security posture, partnering with InfoSec to architect automated remediation workflows and deploying advanced observability tools like CrowdStrike, and Kolide.
  • Design and scale internally owned systems within our hybrid environment.
  • Lead complex platform initiatives from architecture through global deployment and operational maturity.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Corporate Engineering, Security, Engineering, and People Ops to align technical roadmaps with broader company goals.
  • Navigate and resolve high-level ambiguity, transforming vague technical requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point, diagnosing deep-level architectural failures in hardware, software, and enterprise networking.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, providing senior-level response for critical system availability and high-priority security incidents.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, systems architecture, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Proven experience securing and managing global fleets of 5,000+ devices.
  • Deep expertise with endpoint management platforms such as Jamf Pro, Workspace ONE, Google Endpoint Management, Fleet, or Microsoft Intune.
  • Strong programming ability in Python, Bash, Go, or Ruby with a focus on automation and systems integration.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps-based configuration management.
  • Advanced knowledge of Identity and Access Management and Zero Trust architecture across Okta, Google Workspace, and Entra ID.
  • Strong understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and enterprise networking security.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large technical initiatives and influence cross-functional stakeholders.

You Are:

  • A security-focused architect passionate about solving complex endpoint challenges at scale.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguity, with the ability to provide technical clarity and direction in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Heavily metrics-driven and customer-centric, using data to validate the effectiveness of security controls and improve the Builder experience.
  • A collaborative engineer who builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners and mentors junior & senior team members.

title: General Superintendent - Advanced Manufacturing
description:
Overview

The General Superintendent provides overall leadership for field operations and execution for the assigned project(s).

Suffolk is seeking people who are bold. Curious. Innovative. Caring. Looking for the career opportunity of a lifetime. We’ll challenge and inspire you to be your very best. We’ll embrace what makes you unique and lift you up as you take chances. Here, you’ll find a place where you can act with purpose and integrity, bringing intelligence and grit to every aspect of your job. Join us for the chance to achieve your ambitions and build your legacy.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor assigned projects for conformance with the construction schedule, expected quality levels, and adherence to the company’s Standard Operating Procedures
  • Work with clients and architects throughout the project, responsible for developing relationships that generate client satisfaction
  • Recruit qualified talent; mentor, coach, and train them to perform and ensure effective matching of talent to project scope. This includes Superintendents, Assistant Superintendents, Field Engineers, Career Start Project Engineers and Co-ops
  • Provide leadership, advice, and assistance to field staff regarding materials, sequencing, scheduling, personnel and methods of construction
  • Serve as an advocate for Field Operations
  • Actively participate in the development of business by supporting the Business Development Department
  • Pre-construction/Estimating:
    • Participate in Sales Presentations and pre-construction services
    • Review projects for constructability, develop a plan for construction
    • Prepare a summary baseline schedule by providing the logic and durations of major work activities to the scheduler
    • Confirm baseline schedule achieves the delivery requirements of the project
    • Create site access and staging/sequencing plans and conduct technical reviews
    • Provide input on budgets and determine field staff requirements
    • Attend the Project Turnover meeting
    • Provide the Project Team input on scope reviews and Exhibit “B”s
  • Construction; Responsible for implementing all Suffolk policies and procedures including:
    • Field Staff Assignments and performance evaluations
    • Weekly site visits to evaluate conditions including safety and general presentation
    • Ensure that field personnel are performing to established standards
    • Oversee the development of the baseline schedule and monitor all project schedules for compliance
    • Provide leadership in the monthly update and narrative process
    • Confirm that workmanship and materials conform to plans and specifications
    • Review project schedules during weekly visit, highlighting potential challenges
    • Provide leadership in responding creatively to challenges to bring projects in on schedule and under budget where feasible
    • Ensure timely completion of punch lists
    • Participate in the one-year warranty walkthrough, ensures timely completion of all issues and that appropriate records are kept
  • Client Relationships and Meeting Management:
    • Attend all scheduled meetings necessary to monitor and manage projects
    • Attend owner meetings as necessary and Project Team (PM/PE) meetings at least twice monthly
    • Maintain continuous client contact to gauge performance perceptions
    • Communicate relevant information to project teams
    • Foster and maintain effective working relationships with team members
  • Training:
    • Coordinate field training in job specific and safety training
    • Ensure that field staff are trained according to Suffolk guidelines
    • Participate in design and delivery of Suffolk-specific training

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management and experience relative to size/scope of projects
  • Minimum of 15 years of general contracting experience within the Advanced Manufacturing space
  • Each project has specific characteristics regarding size, complexity, sector etc, which dictate the precise years of experience and industry knowledge necessary for success, above and beyond generic construction knowledge and experience
  • Applicable area licenses
  • The ability to constantly multi-task and handle competing priorities between Suffolk business needs, organizational issues, and sound customer relations
  • Business judgment to negotiate the critical balance between budget and construction processes
  • Excellent organizational skills to manage the many details necessary for successful construction
  • Judgment to know when to appropriately escalate issues up the chain of command
  • A strong sense of urgency and initiative, and the ability to quickly study complex issues
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to confidently and decisively take action
  • Excellent diplomatic and communication skills, able to interact effectively with senior management, and the ability to handle and resolve conflict effectively in a firm but fair manner
  • Candidate must possess Suffolk’s Core Values: Passion, Integrity, Hard Work, Professionalism, and Caring

Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; talk or hear; perform fine motor, hand and finger skills in the use of a keyboard, telephone, or writing. The employee is frequently required to stands; walk; and reach with arms and/or hands. Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. The employee will spend their time in an office environment with a quiet to moderate noise level. Job site walking.

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. By integrating data, artificial intelligence, and advanced technology through our Seamless Platform, we connect design, construction, and operations to deliver smarter, more predictable results and redefine how America builds.

Suffolk manages some of the most complex and transformative projects in the country, serving clients across healthcare, life sciences, education, gaming, aviation, transportation, government, mission critical, and commercial sectors. Suffolk is privately held and is led by founder, chairman and CEO John Fish. Suffolk is ranked #8 on ENR’s list of “Top CM-at-Risk Contractors.” For more information, visit www.suffolk.com and follow Suffolk on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Instagram.

title: Senior Program Officer, TCU Computer Science Program
description:
Senior Program Officer, TCU Computer Science Programs
Position Description
The American Indian College Fund (College Fund) strives to positively impact the lives of American Indians by supporting their higher education and career objectives. College Fund team members believe education is the answer and collectively we raise funds, provide scholarships, and holistically support students in achieving their goals. Programming, research, and enhancing the capacities of tribal colleges and universities (TCUs) are also integral elements of our mission.
Note: The fields of CS and AI are both broad and interconnected, and TCUs in this program are supported to build capacity in both areas. However, many foundational concepts of AI are built from an understanding of traditional CS topics and principles. For this reason, and for the sake of simplicity, references to the Computer Science Program will be stated as computer science or “CS” though it supports capacity building in both CS and AI.
The priority of the College Fund Computer Science Program is to facilitate the development and capacity of TCUs with new or improved CS learning opportunities. And as a result, seeks to increase both the number of community-based ICS Computer Science academic programs and the number of Native students and community members with Computer science and knowledge. Programming under this initiative primarily empowers TCUs to build capacity through the development of computer science courses through certificate and degree programs, through hiring and professional development of computer science instructors, and through support of TCU-identified areas that help create a computer science culture. The development of programs includes fostering innovative, community centered approaches to integrating, enhancing, and developing computer programming, architecture, and curriculum and by providing direct support to computer science students to participate in internships, apprenticeships and classroom learning programs. Further, the initiative seeks to increase the integration of computer science and knowledge and education throughout TCUs various academic programs, ensure delivery of introductory computer science courses throughout the TCU system, and encourage participation in computer science education through outreach to students of all ages.
The Senior Program Officer of TCU Computer Science provides expertise in program design and development, faculty development, and creation of services that support student pathways into computer science education. The Senior Program Officer is responsible for the successful implementation of all aspects of the TCU Computer Science program and the implementation with TCU and other external partners. They manage the Computer Science Initiative, the consortium of TCUs with funding under the TCU Computer Science Program, who are actively building and/or adapting their computer science academic programs.
The Senior Program Officer supervises the Computer Science Specialist position and related consultants. This position will work directly with TCU administration, staff, faculty, students, and other external constituents such as donors and contractors, and fellow College Fund employees.
Engagement in strategic growth and expansion of the College Fund Computer Science Program is an expectation for this position, therefore, visioning, planning and implementation of new grant programming is a critical area of focus for the Senior Program Officer. The Senior Program Officer serves as a mentor to the Programs team members and supports the team in alignment with the College Fund’s strategic and annual plans. Close collaboration and proactive communication with other members of the Programs, Research and Evaluation, Student Success Services, and Resource Development departments are essential for overall program success. Evolution and refinement of the Computer Science Program through Programs team alignment and broader organizational focus is imperative to success.
Job Objectives and Responsibilities
  1. Designs, innovates, grows, and leads the overall TCU Computer Science Program
    1. Develops program plans and monitoring systems, including process for selecting TCUs to participate in program based on TCU readiness, faculty, and other resources.
    2. Collaborates with TCUs on program implementation through co-visioning, planning, implementation of re-granting program, evaluation, and replication/expansion.
    3. Creates formal and informal relationships with industry, education organizations, and computer science associations.
    4. Provides financial oversight according to the approved grant budget.
    5. Fosters widespread awareness and effective collaboration of computer science among TCUs to share best practices through a community of practice.
    6. Monitors grantee progress towards grant objectives and provides support and guidance, and problem solves as needed to ensure objectives are met.
    7. Coordinates retreats/gatherings/convenings and site visits
    8. Coordinates and manages consultants and contractors, as needed.
    9. Ensures communication and reporting to donors are appropriate and timely.
    10. Participates in program development processes that highlight emergent outcomes, practices, and program models at TCUs.
    11. Supports program evaluation by aiding the development of indigenous evaluation metrics and methodologies for showing progress and defining overall success of the program.
    12. Provides reporting on program activities and impact.
  2. Manages and develop a direct report.
  3. Fosters relationships with foundations, corporations, and private donors interested in funding the TCU Computer Science Program by writing case statements and grant proposals that match tribal college community needs with donor interest.
  1. Facilitation of an advisory process whereby industry and education partners have the opportunity to support TCUs program development and student experiences.
  1. Uses the advisory process with industry and education partners to rebrand the TCU Computer Science Program to explicitly incorporate Artificial Intelligence (AI) and clearly communicate AI alongside CS as pillars of this program and its funding opportunities.
  1. Works to contribute to College Fund Strategic Goals and Objectives
    1. Collaborate with other teams within the College Fund to accomplish organizational goals.
    2. Actively participates in department level and organizational strategic and annual planning.
    3. Engages in Programs and College Fund discussions related to program impact and provides summarized/analyzed project information.
    4. Supports sharing of successful programming between the College Fund and the TCUs and among the TCUs themselves
    5. Creates and gather monthly and quarterly summaries of the TCU Computer Sciences program for reporting to Board and senior leadership.
    6. Disseminates information about program activity for internal accountability, fundraising, and public education purposes.
    7. Presents College Fund programming and outcomes at conferences and other venues.
    8. Creates and gathers monthly summaries of sponsored programs for reporting to Board and senior leadership.
    9. Shares student stories and program successes to support the College Fund’s general awareness and fundraising efforts.
  2. Supports related programming managed by the Programs Team when needed.
  3. Extensive travel (plane and car) is expected for conducting successful TCU grant implementation, site visits, and selected conferences.
  4. Administers other duties as assigned.
Job Requirements
Competencies
  • Demonstrated initiative and creativity in program development and program management Self-directed, and seeks to develop new innovations in programming
  • Ability to manage a program in an organized way while also maintaining flexibility with multiple partners at various stages and capacity for implementation
  • Experience in communicating program highlights and success to broad audiences via multiple media streams
  • Ability to develop and enhance relationships with Native-led and other organizations that are focused on building CS/AI capacity in Native communities in the K-12 space
  • Strong and proactive communicator comfortable in developing relationships with new people by listening and learning
  • Strong financial management of programs
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and prioritize work to meet project, department, and organizational timelines
  • Ability to contribute to department strategic and annual planning
  • Strong desire to engage in professional development to increase program, leadership and research skills
  • Flexibility to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within and across departments as well as with external partners
  • Willingness to travel extensively during certain periods and to remote locations
  • Proficient IT skills particularly with databases and Microsoft Office products
Education/Experience/Certification Requirements
  • Master’s or higher degree or work equivalent in STEM field, with relevant technical coursework in computer science and artificial intelligence. Significant experience in program design, implementation, and supporting virtual communities of practice.
  • Extensive experience working with AI/AN communities focused on students in high school and/or college.
  • Experience in curriculum development and program evaluation.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Technical Program Management
  • Experience with program leadership and design.
  • Experience managing programs in person and virtually with rural Native communities.
  • Experience working with TCUs at the faculty or administrative level.

Work Environment and Physical Activities

title: Director, Corporate and Securities Counsel
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

AMD is seeking a Director, Corporate & Securities Counsel to provide strategic legal support across a wide range of corporate, securities and governance matters. This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Corporate & Securities. The role provides legal counsel on securities compliance and SEC reporting, corporate and subsidiary governance, capital markets and debt financings, executive compensation, and strategic transactions.

In this high-impact role, you will partner with senior legal leaders and cross-functional teams including, Accounting, Finance, Treasury, Tax, Investor Relations, Stock Administration, Corporate Development, Corporate Communications, Corporate Sustainability, and Corporate Giving. You will deliver practical, business-oriented advice in a fast-moving public company environment and help shape AMD’s disclosure, governance, compliance and transactional practices. You will also build scalable processes and support models that enable the company’s continued growth.

THE PERSON:

You are a pragmatic, business-minded corporate and securities lawyer who thrives in a complex public company environment and serves as a trusted advisor to senior executives and cross-functional partners. You bring strong legal judgment and can translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable advice. You balance legal risk with business objectives, communicate precisely, and take ownership of ambiguous, time-sensitive matters. You are collaborative, direct, and humble, with the ability to lead a team, improve processes, and move work forward with urgency while protecting AMD’s interests.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Advise on compliance with federal and state securities laws, including Exchange Act and Securities Act reporting, Nasdaq requirements, Regulation FD, insider trading requirements, and Rule 10b5-1 plan administration.
  • Ensure the timely preparation, accuracy and filing of all SEC filings, including all periodic reports (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), proxy statements, registration statements, securities offerings, and Section 16 filings.
  • Review earnings materials, investor presentations, press releases, and other public communications.
  • Provide legal support for executive compensation and equity compensation programs, including equity plan documentation and stock administration activities.
  • Advise on sustainability-related disclosures and public statements.
  • Provide legal support for capital markets and treasury matters, including debt and equity financings, credit facilities, share repurchase programs, banking services agreements, and FX hedging and related ISDA documentation.
  • Support strategic transactions and other complex corporate projects, including diligence, transaction documentation, governance approvals, integration planning and coordination with internal stakeholders and outside counsel.
  • Lead global subsidiary governance and entity management, including entity formations, dissolutions, reorganizations, ongoing maintenance, compliance obligations, and improved tracking and monitoring processes.
  • Support AMD’s international tax activities, including international tax structuring and intercompany agreements.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team while advancing operational excellence, process standardization, AI-enabled tools, and scalable support models across the corporate and securities legal function.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong, demonstrated corporate and securities experience in a publicly traded company, top-tier law firm or a combination of both.
  • Extensive experience with SEC reporting, securities law compliance and corporate governance.
  • Experience supporting proxy statements, annual shareholder meetings, and public company governance activities.
  • Strong business judgment, proactive issue-spotting skills, and the ability to identify and address legal and business risks before they become problems.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to translate complex legal concepts into digestible, easy to use content for senior leaders and other non-legal teams.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to align stakeholders, solve problems, and execute priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex projects and transactions, manage competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, including coaching, delegation, prioritization, performance management, and professional development.
  • Highly organized and results oriented with strong attention to detail.
  • High integrity, professionalism, sound ethics, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.

LOCATION:

  • Santa Clara, CA or San Jose, CA

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

title: IT Application Analyst II - Term Limited
description:
Overview

Term-Limited Position: This position is funded as a term-limited assignment with a minimum duration of 12 months. Based on organizational needs and continued funding, the assignment may be extended for up to an additional 12 months. Appointment to this position does not guarantee continued employment beyond the term-limited assignment. If a regularly funded position becomes available during or following the assignment, the incumbent may be appointed to the position, subject to organizational policies, applicable employment requirements, and business needs. There is no guarantee of continued employment or appointment to a regular position.

As an IT Application Analyst II, you’ll support the enterprise applications that keep Community Transit running – from financial and human capital management systems to applications supporting vehicle maintenance, inventory, scheduling, and customer communications. You’ll troubleshoot issues, monitor application performance, coordinate upgrades and enhancements, and partner with internal teams and vendors to keep critical systems reliable and effective.

A key initial focus will be supporting our PeopleSoft ERP and HCM applications, while building your knowledge across a broader portfolio of enterprise systems. You’ll work closely with business partners and IT teams across infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and integration, service delivery, and project management to solve problems, improve application support, and contribute to upgrades and modernization efforts.

We’re looking for someone with strong application support and troubleshooting skills who enjoys digging into complex problems and working across teams to find solutions. PeopleSoft and data management experience are especially valuable, along with the ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and balance day-to-day production support with enhancements and project work.

Essential Duties

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support for complex issues, including problem identification, investigation, and resolution for all customer-facing technologies.
  • Inform the design, build, implementation, and maintenance of complex infrastructures. Perform complex system audits and ensure systems are functioning as expected. Inform and participate in the preparation and maintenance of architecture and design configuration and ensure documentation is updated accordingly, as directed.
  • Manage and oversee data being transferred to-and-from business systems. Analyze and troubleshoot anomalies or detected technology related events and ensure appropriate action is taken.
  • Monitor information technology, including systems, applications, and infrastructure for performance and reliability in relation to established service level agreements. Develop and monitor service levels and delivery results and identify and implement changes necessary to meet business needs.
  • Create complex reports, presentations, and documentation. Develop meeting agendas and lead meeting discussions. Capture and track actionable items to completion.
  • Maintain communications between internal and external customers and vendors in support of technology systems.

Requirements

  • Must have a valid Washington State driver's license by hire date to operate a CT company vehicle, as needed

An equivalent combination of education and experience to successfully perform the job duties is also accepted.

Knowledge Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience in the design, build, implementation, and maintenance of complex systems
  • Project management life cycle, techniques and methodologies
  • IT management principles, operations, and practices
  • Digital security best practices
  • Selection, design, and implementation of applications, systems, or networks

Inspiring and fostering team commitment, pride, and trust. Facilitating cooperation and motivating team members to accomplish group goals while treating others with courtesy, sensitivity, and respect
  • Customer service

You may also be required to lift and carry materials up to 10 pounds occasionally.

title: Residential Services Coordinator
location: Homekey Palo Alto Interim Lodging - Sunnyvale, CA 94089
description:
Shift: Full-Time

Pay Rate: $21-23/hourly

Schedule: Sunday-Thursday; 3:30PM-12:00AM

ABOUT LIFEMOVES

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

POSITION PURPOSE

LifeMoves | Palo Alto provides interim supportive housing in Palo Alto 24 family units and 64 individual units. During their stay, clients participate in holistic services tailored to each household’s unique needs and goals. Clients receive support to build self-sufficiency and return to housing stability, including but not limited to accommodations, meals, laundry, case management, and therapy. The team supports clients with housing, employment, benefits, physical and behavioral health through case management, workshops, and connection to specialized resources.

The Palo Alto Residential Service Coordinator plays an important role in keeping the program site safe, welcoming, and running smoothly. Reporting to the Operations & Services Manager, this position is often the first to respond to client needs, helping with both everyday requests and urgent situations. Additionally, the position supports volunteers, donors, and community visitors, making sure everyone feels respected and informed. Key responsibilities include keeping the site secure by monitoring access, completing regular safety checks (rounds), and supporting daily tasks like welcoming new clients, preparing rooms, and organizing supplies.

This role requires strong attention to the safety and emotional well-being of clients, especially during times of stress or crisis. Staff use a calm and compassionate approach to help resolve problems and support stability. By creating a supportive environment, this position helps clients feel safe and builds trust to work toward their goals, including finding permanent housing.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide calm, supportive crisis response and connect clients to appropriate resources as needed
  • Support daily operations by responding to needs and questions from clients, volunteers, donors, and visitors with radical hospitality, professionalism, and compassion.
  • Monitor site safety through regular rounds and camera observation to ensure a clean, safe, and welcoming environment. Report maintenance or pest issues promptly and support pest control efforts by maintaining cleanliness and preparing spaces for treatment as needed.
  • Manage facility meals, supplies, and donations, ensuring proper inventory, and maintaining organized storage.
  • Support team collaboration by creating reports, updating shift logs and participating in meetings.
  • Maintain a high level of ethical conduct regarding confidentiality, boundaries, and professionalism while fostering a supportive environment for all.
  • Conduct welcomes, move-ins, transitions, and move-outs, ensuring accurate documentation, positive experiences for clients, and completing tasks such as cleaning rooms, bagging belongings, and preparing spaces as needed.

General Agency Responsibilities

  • Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying learnings to daily work.
  • Attend continuing education opportunities to grow expertise and uphold agency standards.

Perform other duties as assigned to meet program and organizational needs.

title: Associate Director, Program in General Education
description:
Job Summary:

Manage and plan academic affairs operations including faculty support, curriculum management and training.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Director of the Program in General Education, the Associate Director provides program leadership and critical pedagogical and administrative support for the 75 General Education courses offered each year and the diverse range of faculty and teaching staff who teach these courses. Leading academic and administrative planning processes for Gen Ed courses, the Associate Director identifies, devises and assesses solutions for programmatic and pedagogical needs; develops and implements programs, services and resources for faculty and their teaching staff; and advises them collectively and individually as needed.

The Associate Director assists the Director in formulating policies and procedures and recommends improvements to overall course administration and support. The Associate Director works closely with other members of the senior leadership team to maintain and promote the quality of the program’s academic offerings by contributing substantially to the strategic planning and design of the program, improving student support , and advising faculty and teaching fellows/assistants to promote high-quality learning experiences. The Associate Director manages a team of two grade-55 Course Coordinators responsible for the day-to-day support for the courses.

Duties & Responsibilities:

1. Collaborates with the Director on leadership of the Program in General Education through strategic planning and representing the department on various committees and working groups.

  • Works interdepartmentally on large-scale projects, such as the joint Harvard College Curriculum resource creation.
  • Serves as de-facto director when the Director is out of the office.

2. Manages a team of two grade-55 Course Coordinators who perform all administrative responsibilities for the Program in General Education including all logistical support for courses (staffing, space, field trips, guest speakers, course materials, etc.).

3. Collaborates with the director on strategic leadership for pedagogical support for Gen Ed faculty and courses.

  • Provides pedagogical support and training to encourage adoption of major pedagogical initiatives set by FAS and the Gen Ed Faculty Standing Committee, such as AI, grading, course engagement, and curricular design.
  • Partners and consults with faculty and TFs on course innovation projects and troubleshoots challenges identified in course reviews to ensure high-quality learning experiences for students.
  • Leads trainings and develops resources for faculty and teaching staff (e.g. Head TF Orientation, templates, guides and manuals).
  • Collaborates with the Bok Center for Teaching and Learning .

4. Supports the implementation of key strategic pedagogical initiatives across the Harvard College Curriculum programs (including Expository Writing and the First-Year Seminar Program), such as the curricular response to GenAI and the adoption of other emerging educational technologies.

5. Acts as the office’s first responder and representative for emergent and/or sensitive concerns, including employment or labor issues that involve the HGSU-UAW union; coordinating with local offices such as General Counsel and the Office of Labor and Employee Relations as necessary.

6. Compiles, analyzes, and provides data as requested by the Standing Committee on General Education, Office of the President, the Dean of FAS and/or Harvard College, HPAC, Admissions, Development, and other stakeholders.

title: Python Backend Consultant (Data Engineering & Data Pipelines)
description:
Job Description

Python Backend Consultant (Data Engineering & Data Pipelines)

Employment Type: 6–12-month contract

Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior-Level

Pay: $15-$22/hr USD


Job Summary

BCI is seeking a skilled contract Python Backend Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems and data pipelines. **Please note: This will be a 6-12 month contract.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Python, integrating data from multiple sources, and developing reliable, high-performance backend services that support analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives. This role requires expertise in Python, cloud technologies, databases, API development, and modern data engineering practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines for processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using Python-based frameworks.
  • Integrate data from databases, third-party APIs, cloud storage, and enterprise applications.
  • Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures, and implement solutions to improve reliability.
  • Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and automated testing processes.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements.
  • Optimize database queries and data models for efficient processing and retrieval.
  • Deploy and maintain applications and pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Create technical documentation, maintain coding standards, and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • A minimum of 5 years + of experience in Python backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in hands on development with Python and object-oriented programming.
  • Bash/Shell Scripting
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or MongoDB.
  • Experience with data processing libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.
  • RESTful API development using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

title: Software Development Engineer, AI Trust & Innovation
description:
About the Team
Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

Role Overview
We are seeking an exceptional Software Development Engineer II to build the foundational systems and consumer-facing features that enable trustworthy AI experiences at scale. You will partner closely with our Principal Engineers and Managers to design and implement privacy-preserving AI architectures, responsible AI frameworks, and accessibility features that set the standard for consumer AI products.

This is a high-impact role where you'll tackle complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer trust—balancing performance with privacy, building explainable AI systems, and creating guardrails that protect customers while enabling delightful experiences.


Key job responsibilities
What You'll Build

Privacy-Preserving AI Systems:
* Design and implement federated learning and differential privacy techniques for on-device and hybrid AI architectures
* Build privacy-preserving data pipelines that minimize data collection while maintaining model quality
* Create consent management frameworks and data minimization systems that give customers control
* Architect on-device vs. cloud processing trade-offs that optimize for both privacy and performance


Consumer-Facing Trust Features:
* Develop explainable AI interfaces that help customers understand how AI makes decisions
* Build transparency controls that show customers what data is used and how
* Create privacy dashboards and settings that give customers meaningful control over their AI experiences
* Implement cross-device identity management with privacy-first design principles

Key Technical Challenges
* Latency vs. Privacy Trade-offs: Optimize time-to-first-token and response times while maintaining strong privacy guarantees through on-device processing and selective cloud offloading
* AI Safety at Scale: Reduce hallucinations to <1% while maintaining 95%+ accuracy across diverse customer queries and contexts
* Ambient Computing Privacy: Build privacy controls for always-on environments that balance proactive assistance with clear boundaries
* Multimodal AI Systems: Architect distributed systems that handle text, voice, and visual inputs while preserving privacy across modalities
* Real-time Evaluation: Create low-latency evaluation systems that assess model outputs for safety, accuracy, and bias before reaching customers

What Makes You Successful
Customer Obsession for Trust: You deeply understand that trust is earned through consistent, transparent, and privacy-respecting experiences. You make technical decisions that prioritize customer trust even when it means additional complexity.

Technical Excellence: You have strong computer science fundamentals and practical experience building distributed systems. You write clean, maintainable code and establish best practices that enable your team to move fast without breaking things.

AI & Privacy Expertise: You understand both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems. You know how to implement privacy-preserving techniques without sacrificing user experience.

Bias for Action: You thrive in ambiguous environments where you need to make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation and safety. You ship iteratively and learn from customer feedback.

Inclusive Mindset: You design systems that work for all customers, considering diverse abilities, contexts, and use cases from the start rather than as an afterthought.

Why Join Us
* Work on generative AI technology that impacts millions of customers daily
* Shape the future of responsible AI and set industry standards for privacy and trust
* Partner with world-class product, design, and research teams
* Solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer protection
* Build systems that make AI accessible and trustworthy for everyone


About the team
Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth.
