Your New Role

The Warner Bros Discovery Procurement Global Senior Analyst is responsible for assisting in the quality assurance and compliance activities resulting in increased accuracy of the source-to-contract process. This role works closely with the procurement team, internal stakeholders, and suppliers to drive efficiency in the source to pay process. The candidate for this position should possess strong knowledge and understanding of the procurement and contract process. This position will report to the Director for Procurement Global Process Owner.

Your Role Responsibilities:

  • Guide the business through the end-to-end source to contract process ensuring that our business units are compliant with our policies and procedures
  • Collaborate with key departments and business units to identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation
  • With support from manager, maintain source to contract processes documentation and ensure that they are up to date

  • Document a recommendation along with alternatives considered for key decisions
  • Support and lead training to Procurement, Business, and cross functional teams on new/current source-to-contract processes
  • Ensure all procurement activities comply with legal standards, regulations, and internal policies, including identifying and mitigating supplier risks
  • Support the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) process and tool
  • Support the Procure to Pay (P2P) process
  • Partner closely with Global Business Services to communicate process changes, ensuring timely updates and clear guidance is provided.
  • Support the adoption and compliance of new P2P procedures and address questions as they arise.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 3 - 5 years, preferably in procurement, contract management, or supply chain preferred

  • Experience in using systems and solutions to manage the source to contract process (i.e. Workday Strategic Sourcing, Ariba, SAP, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, Contract Lifecycle Management solutions)

title: Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 3
description:
Primary Function of Position:

Contribute your technical manufacturing, design, and project management skills to a dynamic development team creating high volume automation assembly lines for precision instruments and accessories. This position will focus on developing and executing manufacturing validation processes to achieve product safety, reliability, and KPI goals for the surgical accessories product line. Individuals in this role must demonstrate strong process development and capability analysis skills.provide daily support for manufacturing operations, design improvements for existing accessories and provide equipment engineering support for new product introductions.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Function as plant contact for machine integrator in development, evaluation, and shipment of automation lines
  • Validate, maintain, and improve high volume automation manufacturing assembly lines including: Document, procure, qualify, implement, and improve fixtures, hand tools and manufacturing equipment.
  • Determine and incorporate critical feature inspection and test checkpoints into process.
  • Develop manufacturing line equipment specifications to guide machine design.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute IQ/OQ/PQ and PPQ (qualification) documentation on high volume automation assembly lines.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement projects to improve first pass yield, cycle time reduction, product reliability, and cost reduction.

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

  • English Advanced level, read, written, spoken.
  • 5+ years work experience as Equipment Engineer, Test Engineer, Automation Engineer, Mechatronic or similar.

  • Controls/Robotics programming knowledge a strong plus.
  • Experience with high volume automated assembly processes
  • Experience with robotics and automated line controls (PLC, I/O Components, etc.) required
  • Great attitude, eager, willing/able to take initiative, works well with others in team environment.
  • Experienced in ISO9001/13485, or medical device manufacturing environment a plus.
  • CAD experience preferred (SolidWorks, AutoCAD).
  • Able to travel periodically to USA-based suppliers.

title: POS Associate
description:
Horace Mann is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Policy Owner Services Associate (POS Associate) to support the processing and maintenance of insurance applications and policy changes for existing Horace Mann customers.

In this role, you’ll play an important part in ensuring accurate policy administration, timely service, and a positive customer experience. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and committed to maintaining high quality and productivity standards while working in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Policy Processing & Administration

  • Process new business applications and policy changes submitted to Policy Owner Services (POS).
  • Perform accurate data entry for applications, policy updates, and maintenance requests.
  • Review applications and requests for missing information or requirements.
  • Process changes and corrections to policy dates, premiums, and payroll deductions.
  • Obtain and update payroll slips as needed to ensure deduction accuracy.
  • Handle policy administration requests for both current and legacy products.
  • Issue approved applications as directed by underwriting.

Workflow & Quality Management

  • Maintain all assigned work items within established service level expectations.
  • Review workflows regularly to ensure accurate status updates and timely processing.
  • Research and resolve errors or discrepancies promptly and accurately.
  • Meet established productivity and quality standards, including:
    • Monthly productivity scorecard of 80% or greater
    • Monthly audit error rate of 5% or less
    • No more than 3 Special Audit errors per month over the prior quarter

Customer & Agent Support

  • Communicate professionally with Horace Mann customers and agents through written correspondence.
  • Provide timely and accurate responses to inquiries and requests.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to support smooth policy processing and issue resolution.

Qualifications & Experience

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Be able to type 45 WPM.
  • 1+ years of college preferred
  • Previous experience in health or life insurance operations preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Basic computer proficiency and data entry experience preferred

Additional Information

  • Normal office environment
  • Hybrid work arrangement (combination of in-office and work-from-home)

Pay Range:

  • $18.80- $25.43/hr.

Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs. We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them. This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. Our tailored offerings include special rates and benefits for educators.

title: Voice Data Communications Engineer, Junior
description:
Overview

The Work

The Voice Data Communication Engineer, Junior will provide technical direction, engineering expertise, and support across a variety of communication domains, including the planning, designing, development, installation, testing, and maintenance of large communications networks. This entry-level position will allow you to leverage foundational skills while gaining hands-on experience and professional growth within a dynamic environment.

This position aligns with Cayuse’s core values of Innovation, Excellence, Collaboration, Adaptability, and Integrity by fostering technical solutions that meet customer needs, promoting teamwork, and prioritizing quality in deliverables.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Network Design & Development: Assist in planning, designing, and developing large-scale voice and data communications networks to meet performance, security, and scalability requirements.
  • Installation & Infrastructure Support: Participate in the installation and deployment of voice/data communication systems, ensuring adherence to organizational and industry standards.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting: Conduct thorough testing and troubleshooting of communication network components to ensure reliable functionality and optimal performance.
  • Maintenance: Support the maintenance and repair of network infrastructure, addressing and resolving issues to ensure uninterrupted operation of communication systems.
  • Technical Documentation: Assist in preparing detailed documentation, network configurations, and system procedures to support ongoing operations and future upgrades.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional technical teams to coordinate activities and implement communication solutions that align with business needs.
  • Industry Best Practices: Apply engineering knowledge to meet organizational goals while ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Qualifications – Here’s What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • At least 2 years of relevant work experience in voice/data communications engineering is preferred but not required for candidates with certifications and strong technical aptitude.
  • Certifications: One of the following certifications is mandatory to qualify for the position:
    • BICSI Installer 1
    • Avaya Certified
    • Nortel Certified
  • Top-Secret Clearance is required.
  • Must be able to pass a background check. May require additional background checks as required by projects and/or clients at any time during employment.

Minimum Skills:

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate in a clear, professional, and articulate manner.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with high-level attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast past environment with changing priorities; adaptable to change and a quick learner.
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well independently as well as on a multi-functional team.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately
  • Proficient in MS Office, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Foundational understanding of voice and data communication technologies, protocols, and standards (e.g., VoIP, TCP/IP, SIP).
  • Ability to analyze, interpret, and resolve network issues efficiently.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Interest in developing skills in large communications network environments.
  • Familiarity with network and telecommunication tools and diagnostic utilities (hardware and software).

Our Commitment to you / overview of benefits

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance; Wellness Program
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability options
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance (Company Provided)
  • Voluntary Life and AD&D options
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with matching after one year
  • Paid Time Off

Reports to: Program Manager

Working Conditions

  • Professional office environment, with the ability to work onsite in the main office.
  • Must be physically and mentally able to perform duties extended periods of time.
  • Ability to use a computer and other office productivity tools with sufficient speed to meet the demands of this position.
  • May require lifting and moving hardware equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Some tasks may involve standing, bending, or working in confined technical spaces.
  • Must be able to establish a productive and professional workspace.
  • Must be able to sit for long periods of time looking at computer screen.
  • May be asked to work a flexible schedule which may include holidays.
  • May be asked to travel for business or professional development purposes.
  • May be asked to work hours outside of normal business hours.

Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Cayuse is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, skills, and abilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with any applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Corrugator Supervisor
description:

Kampack, GA is a leading manufacturer of corrugated paper sheets and products. We are committed to delivering high-quality packaging solutions while fostering a collaborative and dynamic work environment.

title: Cloud Developer REQ133
description:
As a Senior Cloud Developer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and supporting secure and resilient cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS. You will work closely with application, security, network, and operations teams to deliver reliable and compliant cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in cloud platforms, Infrastructure as Code, cloud networking, security, automation, and production operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure across enterprise and multi-account environments.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and operational activities using Terraform, Ansible, AWS Systems Manager, Python, and other automation tools.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure, networking, deployment, and automation issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.
  • Implement cloud security requirements and support the remediation of security, compliance, vulnerability, and audit findings.
  • Monitor and continuously improve cloud infrastructure availability, performance, resilience, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain cloud architecture documentation, technical standards, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with application, cybersecurity, network, cloud service provider, and vendor teams to translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, and supportable cloud solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance to engineers and project teams, participate in architecture and solution reviews, and promote engineering best practices across cloud infrastructure, automation, security, and operations.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise AWS cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in AWS architecture and core services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, and multi-account AWS environments.
  • Strong understanding of AWS IAM and cloud security, including least-privilege access, access governance, security controls, vulnerability remediation, and audit and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with Singapore Government Commercial Cloud (GCC/GCC+) environments would be a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with experience performing root cause analysis and resolving complex production infrastructure issues.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for cloud infrastructure automation and integration.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure deployment using tools such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, or equivalent.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams and communicate technical concepts to stakeholders at different levels.

title: Enterprise Systems Architect- CAMEO/ MBSE
description:
Enterprise Systems Architect

Hybrid | Washington, DC | Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility Required

If you are looking for meaningful work, a team that respects your voice, and a company that genuinely cares about doing the right thing for both the mission and each other, we would love to talk.

Why This Role Exists

The work we do has real impact, and the people behind it matter just as much.

D&G is seeking an Enterprise Systems Architect to support the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives (CBRNE) Office. The CBRNE Office leads DHS efforts to safeguard the United States against chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, explosives, and related health security threats by coordinating with domestic and international partners.

The Enterprise Systems Architect will be a member of a team providing an ongoing program of analysis to support decisions regarding approaches to fill current and future capability gaps through risk assessments, gap analysis, and CBRNE architecture development.

What You Will Do

• Perform mission pathway/mapping analysis and decomposition considering CBRNE threats.
• Perform capability analysis for systems and architectures and represent these systems and architectures in a visual and written form.
• Apply architectural framework methodology to support development of DoDAF viewpoints and models.
• Support capability assessment studies, gap analysis, and risk assessments.
• Support activities to trace program requirements to CBRNE architecture.
• Support annual program technical reviews and the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process.
• Participate in program management working sessions and support program managers in executing day-to-day architecture activities.
• Provide technical leadership and guidance on enterprise architecture development and architectural modeling efforts.
• Review architecture products, models, and engineering deliverables to ensure technical quality, consistency, and compliance with established architecture standards.
• Collaborate with program leadership to identify opportunities for continuous improvement of enterprise architecture processes, modeling practices, and architecture methodologies.

What We Are Looking For

Required

• Bachelor's degree.
• 5-7+ years of enterprise architecture and systems architecture experience supporting complex government or Department of Defense environments.
• 5+ years of experience developing architectural models, mission architectures, and multiple DoDAF/UAF viewpoints using Cameo Systems Modeler and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles.
• Demonstrated experience performing mission pathway analysis, mission decomposition, capability analysis, architecture development, gap assessments, and risk assessments.
• Experience tracing requirements to architecture products and supporting capability-based analysis.
• Experience reading and interpreting government policy, regulations, and directives, with the ability to apply those interpretations fully and legally.

Preferred

• Ability to support multiple projects, implement initiative management principles, business process development, business re-engineering, and strategic business projects.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, stakeholders, and team members.
• Experience assessing Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, or Explosives (CBRNE) detection systems, threats, and/or related policies.
• Experience working with the DHS CBRNE Office, Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA), or DHS.
• Experience leading and mentoring systems engineering teams while promoting knowledge sharing, collaboration, and technical excellence.

Clearance and Eligibility

• Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility required.
• This role is restricted to U.S. person(s) (U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and other protected individuals under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Location

• Hybrid. Currently requires two day per week onsite at the DHS CBRNE Office located on the St. Elizabeths Campus in Washington, DC. This requirement may change to full-time onsite based on government needs.

Who We Are

At D&G Solutions, people come first; our teammates, customers, and the communities we serve.

We are one of the fastest growing companies in the Washington, DC area and proud to be recognized nationally as a Best Place to Work. As an 8(a), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned, and Women-Owned Small Business, we bring ownership, accountability, and care to everything we do.We believe in giving back and proudly support organizations such as Homes for Our Troops, SemperK9, and Wreaths Across America.

Our teams are welcoming, collaborative, and deeply committed to mission success. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, respected, and trusted, and we work hard to create that environment every day.

What We Offer

Competitive salary | Comprehensive benefits | 401(k) | Bonus and profit sharing | Flexible hours | Education reimbursement | Generous paid time off

If you want to work for a company that cares about its people, contribute to a mission that truly matters, and be part of a team where you are valued for who you are as well as what you do, we would love to hear from you.

title: CNO Research & Development Engineer
description:
Salary: Base Salary + KiwiSaver + Health Insurance

Join our diverse and talented people and work at the heart of national security, providing essential intelligence to the NZ government to protect New Zealand and its people.

At the Government Communications Security Bureau (GCSB) | Te Tira Tiaki, our mission is to protect and enhance Aotearoa New Zealand's security and wellbeing. We provide Signals Intelligence and Cyber Security and resilience to organisations of national significance to successfully navigate in an unpredictable world.

The Government Communications Security Bureau (GCSB) is seeking software developers to deliver capabilities to maintain and enhance GCSB's Intelligence mission.

The role & what we are looking for

This is an awesome opportunity to join a well-established specialist software research and development team. As part of this team, you will be responsible for delivering exciting and often unique projects, building and supporting capabilities for the GCSB's Computer Network Operations (CNO), and enhance GCSB's intelligence mission.

This is a diverse role requiring broad skills across several areas. To be successful in this role, you will have strengths in a number of the following areas:

  • C, C++, C#, .NET, Python software development
  • Development for the Win32/POSIX API, and/or networking APIs
  • Planning and conducting independent research
  • Cyber security concepts and vulnerabilities, exploit techniques and methods for their remediation
  • Assembler or embedded systems programming
  • Analysis and design of network protocols
  • Understanding of mobile device operating systems, applications & security
  • Linux and/or Windows systems administration & security
  • Reverse engineering
  • Automating the testing and deployment of systems and products
  • DevOps, Docker, Agile and various modern development systems and approaches
  • The development of complex networking, IOT, mobile or embedded systems

Enthusiasm and tenacity will be necessary as you research, design, implement, and maintain our software and Intelligence systems. You will solve unique, challenging problems to support the security and wellbeing of New Zealand and enhance your skills collaborating across our various teams, systems and technologies.

As well as interesting work, we offer a range of benefits including:

  • Flexible hours, as your work/life balance is important to us
  • Four weeks annual leave plus some additional days for your wellbeing
  • Gym, social clubs and events
  • Medical insurance and Vision Care package
  • Professional development opportunities - we are committed to ongoing learning and continuous improvement
  • The promise that you never have to take your work home with you

Expected appointing ranges for Levels 1 - 3 are below:

  • Level 1 - $87,048 - $92,851 per annum
  • Level 2 - $103,009 - $114,454 per annum
  • Level 3 - $120,359 - $128,383 per annum

The level of appointment will be determined on assessment of skills and experience by the selection panel for this position.

Before you apply

Working within our unique environment means we have to ensure you're eligible for employment.

You must:

  • Have been a New Zealand Citizen for at least 10 years

OR

Hold a current NZ Residency Class Visa and ideally have been a citizen of the UK, USA, Canada or Australia for at least 10 years

  • Be eligible to obtain a Top Secret Special (TSS) security clearance
  • Ordinarily, this means you'll have a 15-year checkable background in countries NZSIS Vetting can make meaningful and reliable checks.

Still unsure? Use this online tool to self-check your eligibility for a TSS security clearance: http://www.protectivesecurity.govt.nz/eligibility-tool

The NZIC treats all applications for employment in the strictest confidence, and we expect that you maintain a similar level of confidentiality during the recruitment process and throughout your career.

We'll provide you with information and tips throughout the recruitment process, but in the meantime check out our Myth Busting booklet: https://beyondordinary.nzic.govt.nz/mythbusting

You can also learn more about our work and understand our areas of focus by reading New Zealand's Security Threat Environment | New Zealand Security Intelligence Service

title: DevOps Engineer III
description:
Overview

Tyndale is seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer III to lead automation and delivery initiatives that support the full lifecycle of our custom-developed software. This is a senior technical role with the opportunity to influence how applications move from development through QA and into production while improving the tools, automation, and practices that make software delivery more reliable and efficient.

You’ll partner closely with Development, QA, and Infrastructure to strengthen CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, testing environments, application reliability, and operational practices. As a senior technical resource, you’ll also help shape DevOps roadmaps, evaluate emerging technologies, troubleshoot complex issues, and share your expertise across the IT team.

HYBRID/REMOTE: Tyndale supports a strong work-life balance. This opportunity requires onsite work a minimum of 1 day per week, and 4 days per week remotely. To be considered, candidates must reside within a commutable distance from our corporate headquarters in Pipersville, PA (Bucks County).

About Tyndale

The Tyndale Company is a private, a Top Workplace winner in PA and TX, and an industry leading national supplier of arc-rated flame-resistant clothing (FRC) to the energy sector including utilities, oil and gas, transportation, chemical manufacturing, and NFPA 70E markets. We’re a family-owned business providing a retail-style apparel experience to hundreds of thousands of energy workers across the US and Canada. We’re the leading distributor of innovative FRC solutions, and the largest industrial supplier of Carhartt FR, Ariat FR, and Wrangler FR clothing.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of custom-developed software from Development through QA and into production, ensuring reliable and efficient deployments.
  • Design, build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines, DevOps automation, deployment processes, and supporting tools.
  • Partner with Development, QA, and Infrastructure to provide effective environments, troubleshoot complex application and deployment issues, and improve overall software delivery.
  • Influence software architecture and deployment approaches to improve application maintainability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Design and maintain integration-pipeline testing and production validation processes that support dependable software releases.
  • Monitor application and infrastructure health and performance, investigate issues, and drive appropriate resolution and continuous improvement.
  • Lead DevOps automation initiatives and contribute to technology roadmaps, including evaluating emerging technologies, tools, vendors, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource, providing guidance, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and training on DevOps tools and delivery practices.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation and support maintenance, upgrades, and deployment activities outside normal business hours when required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant study in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field is beneficial.
  • 4–6 years of relevant professional experience required.
  • Proficiency designing, building, and supporting CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, Bamboo, or similar technologies.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code and configuration automation, including technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
  • Proficiency with scripting and source control technologies, such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, Git, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience supporting AWS infrastructure, multiple application environments, integration/production validation, and Microsoft infrastructure including Active Directory, Group Policy, and Exchange.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently resolve complex technical issues and provide guidance to others.
  • Experience with technologies such as Jira/Confluence, Docker/Kubernetes, Redis, virtualization platforms, and networking concepts preferred.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with competitive premiums. Paid parental leave. Mental health support through an EAP and partial reimbursement on copays, fertility support, and robust wellness programs with annual reimbursements.
  • Work-Life Balance: Many positions with Tyndale offer hybrid onsite + remote work schedules, generous PTO, paid holidays + a floating holiday, and more.
  • Financial Compensation: Competitive salary, 401(k) with matching, and bonus opportunities.
  • Career Growth & Development: Training/certification/tuition reimbursement programs and demonstrated paths for knowledge share and internal promotion opportunity.
  • Culture & Perks: Family-owned values, award winning culture, team-engagement events, casual dress code, company-sponsored charitable events and activities, and an inclusive workplace that values collaboration and integrity.

Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply on our website, www.tyndaleusa.com/careers.

title: Full-Time Board Certified Behavioral Analyst
company: SpringHealth Behavioral Health and Integrated Care
description:
Our Company

SpringHealth Behavioral Health and Integrated Care

Overview

Make an Impact That Goes Beyond Behavior

Are you a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) looking for an opportunity where your clinical expertise can make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals and their families?

We’re looking for a passionate BCBA to provide behavioral and therapeutic support through individualized assessment, treatment planning, and evidence-based behavioral interventions. You’ll work closely with individuals, families, caregivers, and a multidisciplinary team to develop strategies that promote progress, independence, and improved quality of life.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct behavioral assessments and evaluations
  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized Behavior Intervention Plans
  • Provide ongoing clinical support and recommendations
  • Partner with individuals and families throughout the treatment process
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary professionals and coordinate psychiatric supports as needed
  • Train and educate staff on behavioral programs and interventions
  • Respond to behavioral needs and provide clinical guidance when challenges arise
  • Maintain accurate documentation, caseload records, and required clinical reports

What You’ll Need

  • Current Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification
  • Experience implementing Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) programming and behavioral interventions
  • Strong clinical assessment and problem-solving skills
  • A collaborative approach and passion for helping individuals achieve meaningful outcomes

If you’re looking for a BCBA opportunity where you can use your clinical skills, build strong relationships, and see the impact of your work, we’d love to connect with you. Apply today!

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) to evaluate behavior, skills, and needs.
  • Develop individualized Behavior Intervention Plans (BIPs) based on assessment results and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to refine diagnostic and therapeutic approaches.
  • Design and implement evidence-based Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) interventions tailored to each client's unique needs and goals.
  • Continuously monitor and adjust treatment plans to reflect progress and address emerging needs.
  • Apply ABA techniques to improve social, communication, academic, and daily living skills.
  • Implement strategies to reduce maladaptive behaviors and promote positive behavior changes.
  • Collect and analyze data on behavior and progress to evaluate the effectiveness of interventions and make data-driven decisions.
  • Maintain detailed records and prepare reports to track patient progress and communicate with stakeholders.
  • Educate and support parents and caregivers in understanding ASD and implementing behavioral strategies at home.
  • Provide guidance on managing challenging behaviors and enhancing communication and social skills.
  • Work closely with other professionals, including speech therapists, occupational therapists, and educators, to ensure a cohesive approach to treatment.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings and share insights to optimize care plans and outcomes.
  • Supervise and mentor Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) and other direct support staff, providing training and feedback to ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and offer professional development opportunities for team members.
  • Engage with community resources and support networks to enhance the client’s social and environmental integration.
  • Ensure that all interventions and practices adhere to ethical guidelines, professional standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with developments in the field of behavior analysis and autism treatment, integrating new research and best practices into clinical work.
  • Address and manage crisis situations effectively, utilizing de-escalation techniques and ensuring the safety of the client and others.
  • Complete and finalize daily clinical documentation within SpringHealth’s EHR.
  • Assist in developing procedures for training materials for staff with the purpose of enhancing programs for clients and ensuring that program operations are in compliance with established guidelines.
  • Continued education on behaviorally based interventions & techniques to stay competitive in the field.
  • Complete monthly & quarterly notes outlining the client’s progression through goals.

Qualifications

  • Must be a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) in good standing with the BACB.
  • Review and interpret highly technical information; write technical materials; and/or speak persuasively to implement desired actions; and analyze situations to define core issues and draw conclusions.
  • Specific knowledge-based competencies required to satisfactorily perform the functions of the job include age-appropriate activities/behaviors; understanding of CPT codes/payor rules/regulations/policies; language grammar/punctuation/spelling/vocabulary; and research-based accepted treatment modalities and assessment.
  • Must have reliable transportation.
  • Ability to perform physical tasks, including standing for extended periods, infrequent lifting to 50 pounds, frequent pushing, pulling, reaching, turning, twisting, bending, stooping, and squatting, walking, and climbing.

About our Line of Business

SpringHealth Behavioral Health and Integrated Care, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, offers a holistic approach and integrated care for people with cognitive, developmental, or intellectual disabilities who often need additional resources. The behavior analysts, therapists, social workers, counselors, and psychologists at SpringHealth combine their expertise to deliver high-quality behavioral services for clients to live more positive, active, and social lives. For more information, please visit www.springhealthbehavioral.com. Follow us on Facebook and LinkedIn.

title: AML Analyst

Nayax devices can be found all over the world, with branches in 12 countries and over 80 distribution partners, our devices serve consumers in over 120 countries and accept 80+ payment methods and 50+ currencies.

Nayax Australia is looking for an AML Analyst to join our Legal & Compliance team in Sydney. In this role, you'll own the case-level side of our AML/CTF compliance program: sanctions screening, ongoing customer due diligence, and KYC/KYB escalations across our Australian and New Zealand payment facilitation operations. You'll work closely with the Director of Legal and Compliance (ANZ) and our Regulatory Compliance and Risk teams, playing a hands-on role in the day-to-day compliance work that keeps our merchants onboarded efficiently


Your Key Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Conduct KYC/KYB reviews and approvals and identity verification cases for escalations
  • Perform ongoing customer due diligence (OCDD) reviews, including enhanced due diligence (EDD) where risk factors warrant it, review of customer profiles, ownership structures, and source of funds, PEP and adverse media screening, alert triage, and escalation of unresolved identity checks
  • Document OCDD and KYC outcomes in Salesforce Compliance Cases
  • Conduct sanctions screening quality assurance reviews and escalate discrepancies
  • Support remediation of OCDD configuration action items working with third-party platform providers as required
  • Support maintaining card scheme compliance certifications as required
  • Contribute to and maintain the compliance SOP library
  • Provide training and technical guidance to the onboarding team on compliance procedures and escalation criteria
  • Support cross-border and cross-entity compliance matters as directed

Requirements

  • 1–3 years' experience in AML/CTF and sanctions compliance, ideally in payments, fintech, or financial services
  • General familiarity with AML/CTF regulatory concepts (e.g. AUSTRAC and/or DIA frameworks)
  • Experience with PEP and adverse media screening tools
  • Comfortable with case management systems (e.g. Salesforce) and structured documentation
  • High attention to detail and sound judgement in escalation decisions
  • Ability to work independently while flagging risk appropriately
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g. law, business, or finance) is desirable but not essential


Why Join Nayax:

  • Competitive salary package, including annual performance bonus

  • Hybrid working arrangements, special vacation days, and incentive trips
  • Ongoing professional development and study support
  • Equipment allowance

Learn More about Nayax

Founded in 2005, Nayax provides an end-to-end platform for payments, empowers businesses to grow revenue, reduce operational costs, and deliver seamless commerce experiences. Our customer-first mindset and commitment to in-house innovation have positioned us at the forefront of the cashless payment revolution, serving the unattended and retail sectors around the world.

We support over 80 payment methods in 60+ currencies, hold a European payment institution license, and have formed strategic partnerships with global financial institutions to deliver powerful, scalable solutions.

With more than 1,200 employees across 13 global offices, Nayax operates in 120+ countries. Our global headquarters in Herzliya Hills, Israel, is our largest site, housing over 600 employees across 20+ departments.

  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.

What you can expect from joining our team

  • Career development and training opportunities

title: Frontend Developer (React / Next.js + React Native)
description:
Company Description Navam Intellitech builds Intellishala, an AI-powered school platform designed for CBSE classrooms in Grades 9–12. The platform provides an integrated environment for teaching, assessment, and tracking learning, with features such as an NCERT-grounded AI tutor, searchable question bank, and automated test creation and scoring. Intellishala streamlines homework management and offers dedicated teacher and student portals aligned with real classroom workflows rather than administrative dashboards. It also delivers class analytics and report cards that help schools identify and address learning gaps within the term. Intellishala is already live in CBSE classrooms and is actively onboarding additional schools, contributing to innovation in AI-driven education.


Role Description

This is a full-time Frontend Developer role remote in India. You'll be the frontend hire at an early-stage company, working directly with the founder, and you'll handle frontend for the Intellishala web portal.

Day to day, you'll turn Figma designs into accurate, responsive and accessible UI; refine existing workflows based on feedback from teachers using the product in their classrooms; build and maintain the marketing site; and help design and build the mobile app from early on. You'll ship in small pull requests, and help write the frontend documentation as the codebase grows.


Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience building production UIs with React and TypeScript
  • Comfortable with Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS
  • Experience with React Native or Expo, or the drive to learn it quickly
  • Able to implement Figma designs precisely, including responsive layouts and accessibility basics
  • Working knowledge of Git, pull requests and code review
  • Comfortable consuming REST APIs; familiarity with Supabase or Prisma is a plus
  • Able to work independently, communicate clearly in writing, and flag problems early
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (a strong portfolio counts)
  • Experience in ed-tech, or publishing an app on the Play Store or App Store, is a plus


Compensation: ₹6–10 LPA


How to apply: Apply on with your resume and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Include one project you're proud of, ideally with a live link.

title: Staff, AI Security Architect
description:
English version follows the Korean.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡의 AI Security Architect는 인공지능 및 머신러닝 플랫폼 전반의 보안 아키텍처를 설계, 정의, 관리하는 핵심 역할을 수행합니다. 본 포지션은 전사 차원의 AI 보안 표준 아키텍처, 모델 안전성 프레임워크, 리스크 거버넌스 체계를 수립하며, 쿠팡의 리더십 원칙과 문화를 실천하는 기술 리더로서 차세대 AI 인프라에 Secure-by-Design 원칙을 내재화합니다.

업무 내용

• AI/ML 플랫폼의 보안 아키텍처 설계 및 확장
• 엔드투엔드 보안 설계 수립, 복잡한 AI 파이프라인 위협 모델링, 모델 생애주기 전반에 대한 보안 표준 정의
• 데이터 기반 AI 리스크 관리 및 위협 거버넌스 체계 수립
• 보안 위험 지표 정의, 플랫폼 보안 수준 평가 및 조직 목표와의 아키텍처 정합성 확보
• Principal Software Engineer, Enterprise Architect, 개발 조직 리더 등 주요 이해관계자와의 긴밀한 협업 관계 구축
• LLM Guardrails, Agentic System, 실시간 데이터 프라이버시, Cloud MLOps 등 차세대 AI 플랫폼의 보안 요구사항에 대한 전문성 확보
• 변화하는 기술 환경 및 위협 요소에 신속하게 대응하고 AI 보안 아키텍처 혁신 주도
시스템 설계 검토, 고위험 아키텍처 감사, 기술 거버넌스 표준 수립을 통한 데이터 유출·모델 • 역설계(Model Inversion)·파이프라인 침해 방지
• 개발 생산성과 시스템 안정성 향상을 위한 보안 프레임워크, 자동화된 컴플라이언스 체계 및 고위험 보안 리뷰 가이드 제공

자격 요건

• 컴퓨터공학, 정보보호, 컴퓨터공학 관련 분야 학사 이상 보유자로 기술 분야 경력 6년 이상을 보유하신 분
• 엔터프라이즈 아키텍처, 클라우드 보안 또는 소프트웨어 보안 설계 분야의 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
• AI/ML 시스템, AWS/GCP/Azure 기반 클라우드 인프라에 대한 깊은 아키텍처 이해를 보유하신 분
• Prompt Injection, Model Theft, Data Poisoning, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs 등 AI 특화 보안 위협에 대한 전문 지식을 보유하신 분
• 분산 환경의 복잡한 애플리케이션을 위한 위협 모델, 보안 표준, 참조 아키텍처 설계 경험을 보유하신 분
• 체계적인 사고와 창의적 문제 해결 능력을 바탕으로 대규모 아키텍처 과제를 해결하실 수 있는 분
• 다양한 조직과 협업하며 합의점을 도출하고 영향력을 발휘하실 수 있는 분
• 경영진 및 시니어 기술 리더를 대상으로 효과적인 커뮤니케이션을 통해 보안 전략을 추진하실 수 있는 분

우대 사항

• SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP-ISSAP, CCSP 등 보안 또는 아키텍처 관련 전문 자격증을 보유하신 분
• AI/ML 시스템 구축 및 운영 경험을 보유하신 분
• 개인정보 보호, 기밀 컴퓨팅(Confidential Computing), 차등 프라이버시(Differential Privacy), 데이터 보호 규제 관련 전문성을 보유하신 분
• AI 모델 내 개인정보(PII) 처리 및 보호 체계 수립 경험을 보유하신 분
• 빠르게 성장하는 테크 기업, 대규모 이커머스 환경 또는 글로벌 클라우드 환경에서 AI 보안 혁신을 주도한 경험을 보유하신 분
• Zero Trust 기반 AI 플랫폼 구축 또는 보안 아키텍처 전환 경험을 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 - 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

Coupang’s AI Security Architects play a critical role in safeguarding our technology ecosystem by designing, defining, and governing the enterprise-wide security architecture for all artificial intelligence and machine learning platforms. As a AI Security Architect, you will establish standard reference architectures, model safety frameworks, and risk governance protocols across the organization. You will act as a principal technical leader and ambassador, championing Coupang’s leadership principles while embedding secure-by-design standards into our next-generation AI infrastructure.

What You Will Do

  • Architect and scale secure AI/ML foundations for Coupang’s rapidly expanding business by designing end-to-end security blueprints, threat modeling complex pipelines, and establishing enterprise standards for secure model lifecycles.
  • Employ a data-driven approach to AI risk management and threat governance. Define key security risk metrics, evaluate platform posture, and ensure architectural alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Build close relationships with key stakeholders, including principal software engineers, enterprise architects, development leaders.
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the business domains and specialized security demands for emerging technology platforms (e.g., LLM guardrails, agentic systems, real-time data privacy, and secure cloud MLOps infrastructure).
  • Rapidly respond to our evolving technical and threat landscape, aggressively driving architectural innovations to create a world in which our customers ask, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
  • Improve the AI security ecosystem by reviewing system designs, auditing high-risk architectures, and authoring technical governance standards to prevent data leakage, model inversion, and pipeline compromise.
  • Enhance developer efficiency and system reliability by delivering friction-free security frameworks, automated compliance patterns, and guidance during high-severity architectural security reviews.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or a related field, and 6+ years of total experience in technology, with significant focus on enterprise architecture, cloud security, or software security design.
  • Deep architectural knowledge of AI/ML systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), and specialized security threats unique to AI (e.g., prompt injection, model theft, data poisoning, and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs).
  • Demonstrated experience authoring threat models, enterprise security standards, and secure reference architectures for complex, distributed applications.
  • Ability to solve high-impact architectural challenges through systemic thinking, creative problem-solving, and cross-team consensus.
  • Ability to influence senior technical leaders and drive strategic security adoption across business units through executive-level communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Recognized industry credentials in architecture or security (e.g., SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP-ISSAP, CCSP) alongside demonstrated hands-on experience with AI/ML systems.
  • Deep expertise in regulatory compliance, confidential computing, differential privacy, and data protection regulations (e.g., PII handling in AI models).
  • Experience leading AI security transformation or building zero-trust AI platforms within a high-growth tech company, large-scale e-commerce ecosystem, or global cloud environment.

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process

  • Application Review - 1st Interview - 2nd Interview - Offer
  • The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.
  • Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

Details to Consider

  • This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled.
  • Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
  • Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.
  • Job titles and responsibilities may be subject to change depending on the candidate’s overall experience, etc. This will be communicated to the candidate at the appropriate time before the offer.
  • Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met.
  • This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes

Privacy Notice

  • Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below.

Document Return Policy

  1. This notification is given pursuant to Article 11 (6) of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act.
  2. A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the “Company”), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant.
  3. A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a “Request for Return of Hiring Documents” [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant’s designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail.
  4. In preparation for a job applicant’s request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
  5. The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.

title: Solution Architect Infrastructure and Platform - Clerk Grade 9/10 - Sydney

  • Ongoing full-time - Sydney CBD based

About the role:

The Solution Architect - Infrastructure and Platform provides specialist leadership in the design of resilient, secure, and scalable infrastructure and platform solutions that underpin NSW Parliament’s digital services.

Our people:

title: HSE Advisor
description:
About Us

At SECURE, we lead the way in waste management and energy infrastructure, providing unmatched security and peace of mind to our customers. Our strength lies in our size, extensive network, solid reputation, industry expertise, and a relentless can-do attitude.

With an expansive infrastructure network spanning Western Canada and North Dakota, we deliver essential solutions where they are needed most. Our partnerships focus on safely recovering oil and metals, disposing of liquid and solid waste, recycling materials such as metals, water, and oil, and reclaiming contaminated land to reduce environmental footprints.

SECURE is committed to innovation, helping our customers lower costs, reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and exceed their business, safety, and environmental goals. We go beyond expectations — mitigating risks, reducing financial obligations, and maximizing value for our clients.

Join SECURE and be part of a team that steps up to make a meaningful difference in the industries we serve and the world we share.

Your Opportunity at SECURE

As an HSE Advisor, you will provide hands-on health and safety support to SECURE’s Specialty Chemicals field operations in Leduc, Nisku, and the surrounding area. You will help implement SECURE’s HSE Management System, strengthen proactive safety practices, and work closely with operations, contractors, and HSE team members to promote safe, compliant, and consistent work environments. This role is ideal for an experienced HSE professional who enjoys being visible in the field and making a practical and meaningful impact.

This role is based out of Leduc, Alberta

The Team

You will join a collaborative Specialty Chemicals team that values strong partnerships, open communication, and a proactive approach to health and safety. Working closely with operations and HSE professionals, you will help build strong relationships and support a culture where everyone takes ownership of safety.

Work Environment

This is a field-focused role based in Leduc, Nisku, and the surrounding area, with regular on-site engagement across Specialty Chemicals operations. You will work directly with employees, leaders, contractors, and third-party service providers to support hazard identification, safe work practices, training, inspections, incident prevention, and the consistent application of SECURE’s HSEMS.

A Day in The Life

  • Effectively implement SECURE’S HSE Management System (HSEMS) in alignment with SECURE values and culture, and in compliance with all legislative requirements.
  • Provide HSE support for operations and interface on HSE matters with all levels of operations and HSE personnel.
  • Support a proactive approach to safety management and loss prevention and provide value to the organization.
  • Maintain a high level of on-site field support (Leduc/Nisku and area).
  • Strong in supporting core HSE systems including Site Hazard Assessment, Field Level Hazard Assessment, Safe Work Permits, site orientations, facilitating training, tracking of safety tickets, emergency response plan(s), facility inspections, hazard hunts, coaching safe work/behavior practices, safety meetings/toolbox talks, hazard identification and control, incident reporting and investigation.
  • Ensuring communication and consistency is maintained through active engagement in safety meetings, Ops/HSE calls, and general safety communications.
  • Collaborating with SECURE personnel & third-party contractors to align SECURE’s safety program with their requirements, ensuring compliance and meeting mutual expectations.
  • Assisting in updating and maintaining components of the HSEMS as requested.
  • Continually progress personal development, specifically maintaining up-to-date safety tickets and related training.
  • Providing additional support as required.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in industry-related HSE operations: chemical blending, oilfield (drilling, completions, production), pipelines, construction/trades, welding/fabricating, rail/trans-loading, pulp & paper laboratory processes or any other heavy industry or chemical processing-related industry.
  • Hands-on experience supporting HSE functions and implementing HSE initiatives at large commercial/industrial/facility construction projects involving multiple third-party contractors, sub-contractors and/or trades.
  • OHS Certificate, CRSP or NCSO designation (or actively working towards one of these designations).
  • Working knowledge of safety management systems and safe work practices
  • Practical knowledge and experience in supporting proactive safety and helping build a strong proactive safety culture
  • A strong understanding of the HSE regulatory process and principles
  • Ability to communicate, multi-task, prioritize and work well with multiple stakeholders on-site and within SECURE Specialty Chemicals division
  • Strong ability to communicate, build working relationships within the organization as well as with external stakeholders, vendors, and contractors
  • High proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), web-based Safety Management Systems (ITrak)/Power BI
  • Direct operational experience in one (or more) of the following industries.
    • Chemical Blending or Chemical Processing-related industry.
    • Oilfield; Drilling, Completions, Production
    • Pipelines
    • Construction, Trades
    • Welding/Fabrication
    • Rail/Trans-loading
    • Pulp and Paper
    • Large Laboratory Processes
    • Other heavy industries not already mentioned.

The following are considered assets in this role: (including but not limited to)

  • Maintain Training and Tickets in:
  • Safety Leadership
  • Standard First Aid and CPR
  • WHMIS
  • TDG
  • H2S Alive
  • Confined Space Entry
  • Ground Disturbance
  • Fall Protection
  • Rigging/Hoisting
  • Mobile Equipment
  • Incident Investigation
  • Experience in on-site third-party contractor management and SIMPOS will be an asset in this role.

What's in it for you

At SECURE, we focus on opportunities for growth and improvement for our employees, our customers, our partners, and the communities we operate in. We are an energetic team, driven by the needs of our customers, and we care about making a meaningful contribution. We strive to attract, retain, and motivate employees by offering a competitive compensation package that recognizes employee contributions and performance.

In addition to rewarding job opportunities, we offer:

  • Competitive industry wages and compensation programs which include:
  • Employer-paid benefits: health, dental & more
  • Health Care Spending Account
  • Employee Wellness Programs
  • Employee Savings Plan
  • Career progression
  • A competitive employee referral program
  • Industry-leading safety standards
  • Community investment initiatives (Our Stories)

We believe our team’s strength comes from our diversity.

Every SECURE employee has the right to feel safe and welcome. We pride ourselves on being a respectful workplace where all employees have equal access to opportunity and support.

We are a trusted partner. We extend those same efforts outside of the organization through our respectful engagement with our diverse base of stakeholders in the communities in which we operate.

Applicants are not assessed on the grounds of race, national or ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, or physical handicap. Our operations span across Canada and the United States, and we actively seek out a wide range of applicants for both field operations and office roles.

title: Director, Strategic Change Leadership Lead - Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs (CMG)
description:
The Position

From the beginning, Genentech has been a team of highly dedicated, passionate individuals. We are a place where people are united around a single purpose and an ambitious vision. Together, we aspire to deliver ever better health outcomes for patients while lowering overall healthcare costs. Our goal is to compel the customer to act on behalf of their patients while showing great commitment to the rare disease community, whose support is key. Utilizing innovative methods to identify patients who may benefit from treatment, we must take a highly strategic approach to patient access while assisting patients and their caregivers to navigate the healthcare system.


Overview

The Director, Strategic Change Leadership Lead, is a key member of the Strategy & Activation team, working across Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs (CMG). This role drives the successful adoption of strategic initiatives and organizational capabilities by applying deep expertise in change leadership, organizational effectiveness, and team effectiveness.

As a trusted advisor to senior leadership, you will shape and execute change strategies that enable cross-functional alignment, innovation, and sustainable performance. You’ll foster a culture of resilience, adaptability, and continuous improvement, ensuring that change becomes a lasting competitive advantage.



Key Responsibilities

Strategy Development & Execution

  • Serve as a strategic advisor and thought leader, leveraging a comprehensive understanding of the Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs (CMG) functions to guide both transformational and incremental change.
  • Balance strategic partnership with hands-on execution, guiding teams through both the design and delivery of change.
  • Conduct diagnostic assessments to identify change readiness, gaps, and opportunities, using these insights to develop, adapt, and implement strategic change management frameworks tailored to CMG's needs.
  • Proactively identify potential risks, resistance points, and systemic patterns that may impact change initiatives across the CMG teams, developing targeted mitigation strategies to drive breakthrough results and long-term sustainability.

Change Capability & Culture Activation

  • Lead the activation of CMG-wide strategic initiatives that embed shared mindsets and behaviors, ensuring adoption and sustained impact with senior leadership support.
  • Embed core behavior shifts that bring CMG’s Value to life by cultivating the Change Leadership Capabilities curriculum — focused on:
    • Role Modeling Change (responsibility and accountability, decision making, shifting from “me” to “we”)
    • Leading Change (creating psychological safety, managing productive conflict, addressing resistance)
    • Communicating Change (connecting hearts and minds, leveraging change accelerators).
  • Coach senior and people leaders to strengthen these capabilities and lead change with confidence.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior leaders, department heads, and key stakeholders across the CMG teams to ensure alignment and buy-in for change initiatives.
  • Actively partner with Learning & Skill Development (L&SD), People & Culture (P&C), and Communications partners to manage the sequence and flow of information, training, and accountability.
  • Leverage an indirect network of change champions across the organization to scale change actions and narratives and support change adoption and sustainability.

Implementation and Monitoring

  • Monitor the effectiveness of change management initiatives, track progress against metrics, and provide regular updates to senior leadership, demonstrating business impact.
  • Establish mechanisms for continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, feedback, and data-driven insights to refine approaches and enhance future change initiatives.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in organizational development, strategic initiative execution, transformation programs, or business operations within a complex, matrixed environment, with a strong emphasis on leading large-scale organizational change.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
  • Deep expertise in organizational change management, championing change in a positive way with demonstrated experience in leading cross-functional cultural initiatives from strategy to implementation.
  • Proven track record of sustained organizational impact and successfully executing change management strategies in complex and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proficient in coaching senior leadership teams and demonstrated expertise and experience in team coaching or systemic practice (e.g., Certified Coach, Systemic or Team Coach preferred).
  • Systems thinker who understands the importance of change across people, process, technology, and culture.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning for customer-centric solutions.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus at all levels of the organization.
  • Master’s degree or professional certification in Change Management (e.g., CCMP, Prosci ADKAR, Kotter's Change Management Model).
  • Experience in the Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or similar regulated industries is a plus.

title: QA Engineer (1-Year Contract)
description:
About Moloco:

Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.

Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. Moloco Ads is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. Moloco Commerce Media enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.

Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.

Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!

Mission of the Role

Ensure the quality, stability, and reliability of Moloco’s services by conducting rigorous manual testing and building AI Agent-driven automated testing frameworks. The QA Engineer will balance hands-on exploratory testing with modern AI technologies to write test cases, analyze failures, and optimize testing pipelines. By working closely with Software Engineers, you will improve product quality, development efficiency, and release confidence.

What You will Do

  • Conduct thorough manual testing for new features, complex edge cases, and user-centric scenarios to ensure high product quality before release.
  • Design, build, and scale an AI Agent-assisted test automation framework to transition repetitive manual tests into automated integration and end-to-end tests.
  • Utilize AI Agents for automated test generation, script maintenance (auto-healing), and enhancing exploratory testing.
  • Analyze bugs and errors found during both manual and automated testing, and communicate actionable findings (repro steps, root-cause insights) to Software Engineers.
  • Choose the appropriate testing strategy for each service or feature, balancing manual testing, automation, regression coverage, and release risk.
  • Integrate AI-driven QA tooling into CI/CD pipelines to identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle.
  • Improve development efficiency and performance by identifying quality risks early and integrating QA into the development process.
  • Work closely with Software Engineers to enhance and improve programs, testability, and release quality.
  • Maintain clear test documentation, defect records, and guidelines to ensure seamless QA operations.

How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with software-testing coursework or at least one year of software-testing experience.
  • Basic understanding of Agile/DevOps software development practices and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).
  • Strong attention to detail with a proven ability to identify edge cases, negative scenarios, boundary conditions, and gaps in requirements through manual testing.
  • Familiarity with API testing, backend service verification, frontend testing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Korean.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience or strong interest in leveraging AI tools/LLM Agents for QA processes (e.g., automated test script generation, auto-healing, log analysis).
  • Familiarity with Jira or comparable test-management and issue-tracking tools.
  • Familiarity with security/penetration testing concepts.

Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being:

We take care of you and create the conditions for you to do the best work of your career. Through a lens of inclusion, we offer innovative benefits that empower our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can do the best work of their lives.

Moloco Values:

  • Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. With humility, we become more open and accessible to each other. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
  • Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with rigor and integrity. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
  • Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one mission and vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.
