title: Commercial Legal Specialist, Technical AI Implementation
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Join Anthropic's Commercial Legal team as a Technical AI implementation specialist, where you'll be responsible for leveraging Claude and other technologies to scale and increase efficiency of legal operations. You'll drive AI adoption across team workflows, optimize internal tooling, and lead cross-functional initiatives to enhance productivity. This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the future of legal operations through technology while working with Claude and other business critical systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement AI-powered solutions to streamline contract review and redlining processes
  • Manage integrations between existing legal systems and AI tools
  • Develop automated self-service solutions for high-volume, low-touch contracting processes, including FAQ chatbots and guided workflows
  • Create AI-based tools for handling commercial contract diligence requests
  • Optimize contract management platforms with AI capabilities
  • Create and manage comprehensive program plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation, to guide project execution
  • Build and maintain metrics dashboards to track efficiency improvements
  • Establish practical governance processes for AI use in legal operations
  • Coordinate with Engineering and Product teams on solution development
  • Identify and mitigate potential risks and issues that could affect program success, ensuring proactive problem-solving

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience evaluating and implementing legal technology platforms such as contract management systems, workflow management systems, or document management tools
  • Show genuine curiosity about AI/ML applications and hands-on experience with LLM tools (especially Claude!)
  • Possess excellent problem-solving skills and can translate legal business needs into scalable technical solutions
  • Excel at cross-functional collaboration and can communicate effectively with both technical and legal stakeholders
  • Self-directed and can manage multiple technical projects simultaneously

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in legal operations, legal technology, or technical roles supporting legal teams
  • Technical aptitude with system integration knowledge
  • Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, analytical, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
  • Proven project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver quality results
  • Collaborative team player mindset with genuine interest in technology development and AI, thriving in fast-paced environments

Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$170,000—$220,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Technical Claims Specialist, Construction Defect
description:
Description

Senior Technical Claims Specialist — Construction Defect at Liberty Mutual!

Bring your expertise to a team that handles the most complex work in the industry.

We're hiring a Senior Technical Claims Specialist to join a team dedicated to Construction Defect claims — one of the most intellectually demanding and highly regarded specialties in commercial casualty. This is a role for an experienced claims professional who wants real ownership: you'll drive coverage, liability, litigation strategy, and resolution on sophisticated commercial casualty matters from start to finish, with the autonomy that comes from being recognized as a subject matter expert.

You'll work across primary, umbrella, and excess claims — directly and as a Third-Party Administrator (TPA) — including Wrap-Up/Controlled Insurance Programs (CIP, OCIP, CCIP) and a full spectrum of retention structures, from zero-dollar deductibles to large self-insured retentions, fully fronted programs, and Captives. If you want variety and complexity in your caseload, this is it.

Why you'll want this role

• Real technical ownership. You'll determine coverage, investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve — not just process. Your judgment drives outcomes.

• Recognition as an expert. This role is built for someone who already operates at a senior level and wants to be treated — and consulted — as one, including mentoring newer talent and advising Claims Management on emerging trends and legislation.

• Meaningful variety. Construction Defect work spans owners, developers, construction managers, general contractors, and subcontractors across every trade — no two files look alike.

• A seat at the table. You'll partner directly with Underwriting, Reinsurance, Defense Counsel, Coverage Counsel, and Home Office Legal, shaping strategy on high-stakes matters.

• Flexibility with structure. This role is primarily remote, with a light-touch office cadence — just two in-office days per month for those within 50 miles of one of our hub locations (Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; and Weatogue, CT). Policy subject to change.

What you'll do

• Determine coverage — including additional insured and contractual tender analysis (in and out) — and draft clear, well-reasoned coverage position letters.

• Investigate complex commercial casualty claims, determine liability, and set/adjust reserves (loss and ALAE) proactively and responsively.

• Evaluate claims, negotiate settlements, and authorize payment or denial — including coverage denials and coverage litigation management when warranted.

• Review lawsuits, construction contracts, and certificates of Insurance; build resolution strategies for claims, coverage disputes, and litigation.

• Analyze allocation, co-carrier contributions, time-on-risk, and covered vs. non-covered damages.

• Manage tenders across multiple parties — Owners, Developers, Construction Managers, General Contractors, and Subcontractors.

• Maintain clear, well-organized file documentation and data capture to support trend analysis and reporting, including Large Loss Reports.

• Build and lead the right resolution team for each matter — Defense Counsel, Home Office Legal/Litigation, and Outside Coverage Counsel as needed — and oversee outside counsel practices and billing.

• Serve as a trusted point of contact for Policyholders, Brokers, Co-Carriers, Excess and Fronting Carriers, and internal partners across Underwriting, Client Services, and Billing.

• Mentor and train other claims professionals, and stay ahead of legislative, judicial, and industry trends that affect specialty coverage.

• Contribute to special projects that shape how the team operates.

What we're looking for

An experienced claims professional with a strong commercial casualty and/or construction defect background, sound judgment on complex coverage and liability questions, and the confidence to lead files, mentor others, and manage litigation strategy independently.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 to 7 years claims adjusting experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of Construction Defect/Commercial General Liability claims investigation, coverage evaluation, reserving & expense management, resolution strategy, negotiation, litigation management, claims evaluation as well as the insurance legal and regulatory environment.
  • Advanced to expert level of skill in the area of customer focus, problem solving, communications, gaining support, teamwork, and adaptability and demonstrated ability to work independently, achieve results and execute thoroughly

  • Create and maintain project-specific reference architecture diagrams and engineering-oriented documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to present at team-wide code reviews.

Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of data ingestion using unstructured, semi-structured, and structured data.
  • Knowledge of data quality concepts and the ABC framework.
  • Familiar with source code versioning tools such as Git.
  • Comprehensive understanding of both Star Schema modeling and Normalized Relational modeling. Understanding of Data Vault 2.1 is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of data preparation needs for Large Language Models.
  • Familiar with metadata capture, row access policies, data masking policies, and data governance principles.

Experience:

  • 3+ years in database technologies and data engineering experience
  • 3+ years of modeling, building, and testing data products experience
  • 2+ years in cloud data infrastructure with a SaaS delivery model. Azure and Snowflake experience are a plus.

We value your professional and personal growth by investing heavily in training and continuing education, so you have the tools to do your best as you develop your career. In this position, you’ll gain hands-on experience in human resource, building both knowledge and practical skills in recruitment. Our Mission, Values and Culture:

The Department of Fish and Game's mission is to manage, protect, maintain, and improve the fish, game, and aquatic plant resources of Alaska. The work done in the Division of Administrative Services (DAS)- Human Resource Section, is to directly support all departmental programs with necessary services to ensure we meet department, divisional, and federal objectives.

The Alaska Department of Fish & Game strives for a diverse and inclusive workforce where safety and well-being are paramount, and employees at all levels promote a culture where everyone is valued, treated equitably, and treated respectfully.

At DFG’s DAS, we don’t just support the mission—we live it. We value each person as an individual and take pride in the work we do for our department and for the Alaskans who depend on us. When you join the HR group, you become part of a team that champions work–life balance, encourages professional growth, and cultivates a positive, supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

You’ll work alongside dedicated colleagues who care deeply about Alaska’s resources and the communities that rely on them. Together, you’ll be part of a cohesive, collaborative recruitment team committed to bring exceptional talent into DFG. This position offers the opportunity to build practical experience in hiring processes, strengthen your HR skillset, and make a meaningful impact on the workforce.

The Working Environment You Can Expect:

This position is in Juneau at DFG Headquarters, located on the Juneau Downtown Boardwalk and Gastineau Channel Waterfront. This facility is in the heart of downtown with ample amenities nearby.

ADF&G supports work-life balance by offering a hybrid in-office and telework scheduling after a successful training period. Working hours can be flexibly scheduled between the standard operating hours, Monday-Friday.

Work is conducted independently, but with support and general supervision from the Human Resource Business Partner and guidance from the HR Recruitment team.

Who We Are Looking For:

We are interested in candidates who possess some or all of the following position specific competencies:

  • Recruitment/Placement: Knowledge of HR concepts, principles, and practices related to identifying, attracting, and selecting individuals and placing them into positions to address changing organizational needs.
  • Personnel and Human Resources: Knowledge of hiring, classification, benefits, labor relations, negotiation, and Federal, state, and local employment regulations.

title: Supply Chain Operations, Process Operational Excellence Team (POET)
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The ISCaP team is looking for an exceptional Supply Chain Operations Specialist to help us build on this mission as the volume of products, services, and locations continues to grow. The ideal candidate is one who thrives in ambiguity, is very customer obsessed, focused on operational excellence and is willing to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. The ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization, make data driven decisions, and apply good judgement to manage escalations, competing priorities, and deliverables is essential to this role. Successful candidates will be able to balance think big with realities of delivering on customer promises today. They will also have excellent analytical and creative thinking skills, and the ability to break down complex problems with no clear answers (and at times, conflicting data) into simple, innovative solutions and/or clear, measurable implementation plans.

Do you enjoy solving very complex problems while seeking to invent and simplify? Are you excited by large complex supply chain? Do you enjoy leveraging your creativity to solve real world analytical and capacity delivery problems? Come work with smart people and make major contributions towards enhancing our infrastructure for millions of customers world-wide.

Why you will enjoy it:
In this highly visible and critical role, you will be the voice of the customer in developing operational excellence plans and work extensively with AWS teams including operations, engineering, product management, and finance to help grow the business. You will use your operational and analytical skills to set a vision for the future, translate this vision into reality, and innovate on behalf of our customers. You will have ownership, not just responsibility. In addition, you will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team.

Role Responsibilities:

- Serve as a key member of the Supply Chain Operational Excellence (POET) team in helping to manage and deliver Infrastructure capacity to select regions around the world..
- Understand the technical requirements of our partners and work closely with the internal development teams to guide the direction of supply chain activities.
- Develop new analytical models for supply chain solutions.
- Execute strategic business objectives while working with key internal stakeholders to improve the supply chain with the latest internal and external information.
- Prepare and give detailed data-driven business reviews to senior management, focused on improving forecasting accuracy and associated impacts.
- You will be a positive influencer across diverse teams, be able to effectively rally support for your initiatives, and be able to help deeply technical teams create simple solutions to meet your program goals.
- Keys to success in this role include exceptional analytics, judgment, and communication skills.


About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:

title: Project Manager I
description:
Overview

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington.

With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.

At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

Working within the Immunotherapy Integrated Research Center’s Project Management Office (IIRC PMO), the IIRC Project Manager I manages a portfolio of complex projects. The IIRC PMO leads project teams that include cross-functional Center groups such as the IIRC Clinical Operations Team, Shared Resources, Therapeutic Products Program, and Clinical Research Support, to drive successful execution of translational research partnerships across these programs. The PM I manages internal and external collaborations across multiple departments and workgroups to ensure project milestones and deliverables are met in an efficient manner. This position requires flexibility in a rapidly changing environment, as well as excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall coordination and management of complex clinical trials and clinical research opportunities from early partnerships to trial open.

Responsibilities

  • Create timelines and track trial implementation progress for financial, contractual, regulatory, and clinical activities.
  • Serve as project/study liaison, representing the project/study to other Center departments, funding sources, affiliated individuals or institutions, and outside organizations.
  • Lead cross-functional teams and track action items and deliverables.
  • Manage internal and external stakeholder expectations.
  • Triage project issues and ensure solutions are implemented.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to determine prioritization of competing activities.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with faculty members, project sponsors, research administration, administrative departments and peers.
  • Manage multiple projects of varying size as assigned.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BA/BS in related field or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum of three years post-master's or five years post-bachelor's related project/study management experience in a research setting.
  • Grant and contract experience.
  • Budgeting experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced meeting organizational, planning, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience with managing a multiple project portfolio.
  • Highly effective team player and excellent communicator with an ability to interact with internal and external stakeholders, scientists, and executives with diverse information needs and communications preferences.
  • Strong computer skills and experience with the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Experience with key project artifacts, such as charters, project plans, risk matrices, dashboards, and roles and responsibilities documents (e.g., RACIs).

description:

  • Align architectural decisions across diverse groups, including business SMEs, application owners, security specialists, platform engineers, and external vendors.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 8+ years operating as an Integration Architect, Solution Architect, or Senior Technical Analyst.

  • Deep foundational knowledge of RESTful services, microservices ecosystems, event-driven architectures, messaging protocols, and batch processing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in energy, LNG, oil and gas, commodities, or financial trading sectors.

  • Practical knowledge of AWS integration components (e.g., API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, Lambda, ECS, S3, IAM).

  • Experience collaborating with commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) software vendors, system integrators, and globally distributed delivery teams.

Performance Indicators

  • Delivery of fully ratified, comprehensive requirements and high-level integration designs.

  • Seamless transition of architectural blueprints to engineering teams, minimising downstream ambiguity and rework.

  • Strict adherence to enterprise architecture, security protocols, and operational guardrails.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate technical dependencies and integration risks early in the project lifecycle.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading and executing the full product development lifecycle of medical device endoscopes and end to end vision pipeline, from initial concept through commercial launch. title: Senior Environmental Scientist 2-NEPA
description:
The Opportunity

RETTEW is seeking an experienced Environmental Scientist III to join our Natural Sciences team.


In this role, you will support environmental review and clearance for transportation and infrastructure projects, with a primary focus on compliance with the National Environmental Policy Act.


You will prepare environmental documentation, coordinate technical studies, evaluate potential impacts, and work with clients, agencies, and multidisciplinary teams to move projects through the environmental-clearance process.


This opportunity is well suited for an environmental professional who can independently manage assignments while collaborating with others and asking questions when project conditions or requirements are unclear.



What You'll Do

As an Environmental Scientist III, you will:

  • Prepare and coordinate NEPA clearance documents, environmental assessments, technical reports, agency correspondence, and other project deliverables.
  • Evaluate project plans and environmental data to identify affected resources, potential impacts, permitting considerations, and project risks.
  • Determine the technical studies, agency coordination, and documentation needed to support environmental decisions.
  • Coordinate studies involving wetlands, waterways, threatened and endangered species, cultural resources, hazardous materials, noise, agricultural resources, and other applicable environmental considerations.
  • Conduct or support field investigations, environmental assessments, sampling, monitoring, and data collection.
  • Coordinate with clients, transportation agencies, regulatory agencies, engineers, planners, scientists, and other technical specialists.
  • Support Section 4(f) evaluations, environmental commitments, mitigation tracking, public-involvement activities, and project meetings.
  • Develop and manage scopes, budgets, schedules, and assigned tasks while meeting project deadlines and quality requirements.
  • Direct or coordinate tasks completed by other technical and field staff.
  • Support environmental work for transportation, energy, and other infrastructure clients based on project needs.



What We're Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in environmental science, environmental studies, biology, ecology, natural resources, environmental planning, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant environmental experience, including qualifying internship experience.
  • Professional experience supporting environmental review and clearance under the National Environmental Policy Act.
  • Experience preparing or contributing substantively to NEPA documents and supporting technical studies.
  • Understanding of the environmental-clearance process for transportation or comparable infrastructure projects.
  • Ability to independently manage defined assignments, identify environmental requirements, and coordinate work across multiple disciplines.
  • Strong technical writing, research, organization, communication, and computer skills.
  • Ability to perform office and field assignments and travel to project sites and meetings.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to meet RETTEW's requirements for operating a company vehicle.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.


Preferred

  • Experience supporting NEPA clearance for transportation projects.
  • Experience working with PennDOT, the Federal Highway Administration, the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission, or comparable transportation agencies.
  • Experience preparing categorical exclusions, environmental assessments, environmental impact statements, reevaluations, or Section 4(f) documentation.
  • Experience with wetland, waterway, ecological, cultural-resource, or related environmental studies.
  • Experience submitting Chapter 105 permits in PA GreenPort and Keystone Environmental ePermitting System.
  • Experience organizing and participating in public involvement activities.
  • Professional Wetland Scientist certification or OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER training.
  • Section 4(f) experience is helpful but is not required at the time of hire.[ES1.1]



Why RETTEW

At RETTEW, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Help transportation and infrastructure projects move forward responsibly.
  • Take meaningful ownership of environmental-clearance assignments.
  • Work with clients, agencies, and multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Expand your experience across NEPA, Section 4(f), environmental studies, and regulatory coordination.
  • Build ownership in the company through RETTEW's Employee Stock Ownership Plan.
  • RETTEW also offers competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, and professional-development and certification support.



Work Environment

Workplace Designation: Hybrid

Locations: Lancaster, Mechanicsburg, State College, or Williamsport, PA


This position follows RETTEW's standard hybrid schedule and combines office and remote work with field assignments, project meetings, and occasional travel.


Approximately 25% of the position may involve fieldwork. Driving is an essential function and is expected approximately once per week, depending on workload. A company vehicle will be provided in accordance with RETTEW policies.

Field assignments may involve outdoor work in varying weather and terrain, uneven surfaces, vegetation, waterways, traffic, construction activity, and other project-site conditions.



Safety and Compliance Requirements

This position is designated as safety-sensitive. The selected candidate must successfully complete all applicable pre-employment screenings, which may include a background check, drug and alcohol testing, and motor vehicle record review.

Ongoing compliance with RETTEW's safety policies, client requirements, project-site procedures, and applicable environmental regulations is required.



About RETTEW

RETTEW is a 100% employee-owned engineering consulting firm that has been helping clients solve complex challenges since 1969. Our multidisciplinary teams deliver practical solutions that strengthen infrastructure, protect natural resources, and support the communities we serve.


Our culture is grounded in our core values: Act Like an Owner, Value Relationships, and Exemplify Excellence. We empower our employee-owners to grow their careers while delivering meaningful results for our clients.


RETTEW is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, including pregnancy, sexual orientation or gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please contact us at jperalta@rettew.com to request assistance.

description:

Our Company Values:


  • Genuinely Caring: We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You: We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement: We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust: We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.


Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced DevOps Architect with a strong foundation in Systems Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to lead the design, implementation, and evolution of our critical infrastructure and application delivery pipelines. This role will be pivotal in ensuring the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of our systems, while also driving architectural best practices and fostering a culture of automation and continuous improvement across our engineering teams.


You will be responsible for defining the architectural vision for our DevOps practices, proactively identifying and mitigating potential risks, and ensuring our systems are resilient and capable of meeting future demands.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.


DevOps Architecture and Strategy

· Define and champion the architectural roadmap for our DevOps infrastructure and processes, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.

· Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD): Architect and optimize our CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable, and secure software releases.

· Evaluate, select, and implement appropriate DevOps tools and technologies to automate manual tasks, improve efficiency, and enhance system reliability.


Reliability, Performance, and Resiliency

· Apply SRE principles to design and implement highly reliable and available systems, including defining service level objectives (SLOs), service level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets.

· Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to proactively identify and resolve system issues, providing deep insights into system performance and behavior.

· Identify and address performance bottlenecks across the infrastructure and application stack, implementing strategies for capacity planning, load balancing, and caching.

· Analyze system usage patterns and forecast future capacity needs to ensure our infrastructure can handle anticipated growth.


Security, Compliance, and Business Continuity

title: WMS Workflow Architect
description:
THE POSITION:

We are seeking a highly experienced WMS Workflow Architect to provide technical, functional, and strategic leadership for our Datex WMS platform supporting pharmaceutical 3PL operations. This role serves as the design authority across all warehouses, clients, and solution implementations.

You will lead both onshore and offshore WMS configuration teams, ensuring standardization, compliance, architectural soundness, and operational excellence across multi-client pharma distribution environments. This includes oversight of workflow design, regulatory alignment (cGMP/GDP, DSCSA, Part 11), master data governance, integration frameworks, and change-control/validation strategies.

This is a senior-level, hands-on technical leadership role—ideal for someone who combines deep WMS expertise, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to align technology design with operational realities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Enterprise Architecture & Design Authority
    • Serve as the overall owner of the architectural standards, design conventions, and configuration patterns for all Datex WMS workflows.
    • Define and enforce enterprise-wide WMS architecture, including warehouse blueprints, workflow standards, integration patterns, and compliance frameworks.
    • Validate and approve all WMS design changes from onshore/offshore teams.
    • Maintain a detailed understanding of current and future-state warehouse processes, regulatory expectations, and operational pain points.
  • Leadership of Onshore & Offshore Teams
    • Lead, mentor, and support WMS workflow developers, analysts, and QA testers across both onshore and offshore teams.
    • Assign priorities, manage workloads, and ensure timely delivery of enhancements, fixes, client onboarding tasks, and projects.
    • Build capability across teams with training, playbooks, process maps, and reusable design components.
    • Operate as escalation point for configuration, design, integration, and environment issues.
  • Pharma Distribution & Regulatory Compliance
    • Ensure all workflows adhere to DSCSA, cGMP/GDP, 21 CFR Part 11, and audit trail/e-signature requirements.
    • Oversee validation strategy for WMS changes including URS, FRS, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability matrices, and controlled releases.
    • Partner with Quality to ensure readiness for regulatory audits, client audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Workflow Strategy & Solution Design
    • Architect efficient workflows for:
      • FEFO/expiry-driven allocation
      • Lot/batch/serial control
      • Quarantine/QA/hold/release
      • Temperature-controlled workflows
      • Controlled substances handling
      • Multi-client 3PL billing
      • VAS/kitting/custom pharma processes
    • Optimize RF flows, wave strategies, replenishment logic, bin strategies, and exception-handling.
  • Integration & Data Ecosystem Ownership
    • Oversee integration design with ERP, TMS, carriers, automation, and serialization systems.
    • Approve EDI/JSON/XML mappings for inbound/outbound data.
    • Lead architecture for event-driven, API-based, or serverless integration components.
    • Guide data governance across item master, location master, client profiles, and regulatory attributes.
  • Production Environment Leadership
    • Serve as top-level escalation point for major incidents, outages, and complex RCA.
    • Govern change control, release management, environment synchronization, and configuration versioning.
    • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, reduce defects, standardize processes, and elevate operational KPIs.
  • Cross-functional Leadership
    • Partner with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Customer Solutions, Client Onboarding, and leadership to define requirements, evaluate impacts, and build scalable solutions.
    • Support RFP responses, client onboarding, and solution design sessions for new 3PL clients.
    • Communicate architecture decisions and impacts to executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • All other duties as assigned.

title: Senior AI Engineer/ A2A, Databricks, MCP
description:
We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join an enterprise AI platform engineering initiative delivering a Databricks-native, MCP-first platform with a Hub & Spoke governance model, enabling independent spoke teams to build and deploy AI agents across GCP and Azure environments. In this role, you will design and implement core AI agents on the platform, from specification through production-ready deployment, ensuring accurate, reliable, and fully integrated solutions within the platform's shared services.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in use case deep-dive sessions and translate business requirements into specifications using a 15-characteristic framework covering scope, tools, memory, guardrails, evaluation criteria, and acceptance definition
  • Design and implement the RAG pipeline, including document retrieval, chunking strategy, embedding, reranking, and response generation
  • Integrate agents with platform MCP servers for tool access and with the LLM Gateway for model routing
  • Implement prompt engineering practices such as system prompts, few-shot examples, and chain-of-thought patterns, and iterate based on evaluation results
  • Wire guardrails, including prompt injection protection and domain boundary enforcement, for reference agents
  • Run evaluation cycles using the platform Evaluation Framework, including LLM-as-judge scoring and RAG faithfulness and relevance metrics, and iterate until quality gate criteria are met
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineer on data schema and retrieval interface design, and with the QA Engineer on test coverage and the acceptance test query set
  • Support UAT with business stakeholders, address feedback, and prepare agents for production deployment following the platform runbook

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience building LLM-based applications in Python
  • Hands-on experience with RAG pipelines, covering retrieval, chunking, embedding, reranking, and generation
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering, including system prompt design, few-shot patterns, and output structuring
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, including LLM-as-judge, RAG faithfulness metrics, and RAGAS or equivalent
  • Expertise in Databricks and MLflow, including experiment tracking and model serving awareness
  • Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or equivalent tool-use / function-calling patterns
  • Experience with vector stores such as Chroma, Pinecone, or Databricks Vector Search, or equivalent
  • Skills in REST API integration and OAuth authentication flows
  • Strong product thinking, with the ability to connect technical implementation choices to user-facing quality outcomes
  • Iterative mindset, comfortable with repeated evaluation-tune-evaluate cycles without losing focus on delivery deadlines
  • Clear communication with non-technical business stakeholders during UAT and discovery sessions
  • Proficiency in English at a B2+ level

Nice to have

  • Prior delivery of a production RAG or agentic AI system end-to-end
  • Experience working within a governed AI platform, such as an LLM gateway, guardrails, and evaluation framework, rather than fully custom stacks
  • Familiarity with responsible AI concepts, including hallucination, grounding, PII, and prompt injection

Benefits

CONTINUOUS UPSKILLING, LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT

  • Personal development plan
  • Mentoring programs and leadership development
  • Certification and professional development support

CORPORATE BENEFITS

COMPENSATION PACKAGE

MEDICAL & HEALTHCARE

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

title: Lead Project Manager - Financial System Implementation
description:
Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Lead Project Manager to join our State Government Practice Group within our Consulting Team. This contingent position is intended to support a potential engagement with a state housing finance agency. The selected candidate would serve as the client-side project lead and day-to-day representative for a complex enterprise software implementation supporting accounting, single-family programs, multifamily programs, mortgage servicing, data migration, testing, training, and organizational adoption. The Lead Project Manager would coordinate the client, software vendor, subcontractors, and other project participants while maintaining clear governance, delivery controls, executive reporting, and accountability for project outcomes.

Travel Expectations: Up to 50% travel to client sites will be required to support this engagement and future client projects. Travel requirements will vary based on client needs, project phase, and BerryDunn's project portfolio. Candidates located, or willing to relocate to, within commuting distance of the client's office Helena, MT is a value-add.

You Will

As a Lead Project Manager, you will:

  • Serve as the client’s day-to-day project representative and primary point of coordination with software vendors, third parties, and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute an integrated project management plan, schedule, milestones, resource plan, governance structure, and reporting cadence.
  • Lead project governance and support steering committee, working team, decision, escalation, and change control processes.
  • Maintain project risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, actions, and change requests, and provide clear recommendations for resolution.
  • Prepare concise executive-level status reports that communicate project health, schedule variance, key risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate business process review, requirements validation, system configuration, data migration, testing, training, cutover, go-live, and stabilization activities across the project team.
  • Oversee vendor performance and review vendor plans, deliverables, schedules, risks, and quality against approved requirements and contractual expectations.
  • Facilitate timely decision-making and prepare recommendations for client approval of deliverables, changes, and key project decisions.
  • Lead integrated readiness and cutover planning, including entry and exit criteria, dependency management, issue escalation, stakeholder communications, and go-live recommendations.
  • Oversee post-go-live stabilization, including issue resolution, system performance, user adoption, support transition, and continuous improvement recommendations.
  • Produce and quality-review client-facing project deliverables, meeting materials, status reports, decision documents, and escalation communications.
  • Partner with BerryDunn colleagues across project management, data, technical, business process, testing, organizational change management, training, and housing finance disciplines.
  • Support business development activities for state government project, program, and enterprise system implementation opportunities, including proposal development and client presentations.

As an SGPG team member, you will:

  • In partnership with our internal team, lead and support business development and opportunity management activities to identify new opportunities, make go/no go decisions, and respond to state government opportunities related to ERP systems.
  • Assist in the career development of our team to deepen team capabilities and services related to state government ERP system projects.
  • Develop appropriate relationships with ERP system SIs and solution providers in the state government market.
  • Develop training opportunities for our team related to major SI/solution vendors in the state government market.
  • Collaborate with other firm practice groups and practices that can bring ERP system knowledge.
  • Attend national conference(s) representing BerryDunn in the state government ERP system market.
  • Participate in marketing and business development activities, including writing blog posts and leading and participating in prospective client business development meetings.

You Have

Minimum Qualifications and Experience

  • At least five years of experience leading complex enterprise software implementation, modernization, or systems integration projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with/in Housing Finance Agencies.
  • Experience serving in a client-side, owner-side, project management office, program management, or independent oversight role.
  • Strong knowledge of project governance, integrated planning, schedule management, change control, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, decision management, and executive reporting.
  • Experience coordinating business process review, requirements validation, data migration, system integration, testing, user acceptance testing, training, deployment readiness, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Ability to assess vendor performance, identify delivery variances, and communicate practical corrective actions in a clear and constructive manner.
  • Ability to lead meetings, facilitate decisions, manage competing priorities, and maintain progress across multiple workstreams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing client-facing status reports, governance materials, decision documents, and executive communications.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, organization, problem-solving, self-management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and project planning, collaboration, reporting, and presentation tools.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience

  • PMI Project Management Professional certification (PMP).
  • Demonstrated experience working with/in a housing finance agency, department of housing, public housing authority, mortgage or loan servicing organization, or comparable public-sector financial program.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise systems that support accounting, lending, loan servicing, single-family programs, multifamily programs, affordable housing, grants, compliance, or financial reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing data migration, data governance, system integration, reconciliation, testing, and regulatory or internal-control requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or reviewing project artifacts for regulated environments, including financial controls, data security, auditability, and compliance documentation.

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $90,000–$135,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications in excess of the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

description:

  • Unique opportunity to join the RBA's Payments Operations Program, which is strengthening Australia's national payments infrastructure and other critical IT and business system.


About the business/role/team

This is a unique opportunity for you to join the Reserve Bank's Payments Operations Program, which is leading the Bank's work to strengthen its operation of RITS, Australia's real-time gross settlement system, and other critical national payments infrastructure. These payments systems move around $300 billion dollars between financial institutions each day and ultimately settle all non-cash payments in Australia. They are essential for supporting the day-to-day business of the Australian economy.

The role will report to the Manager of the Knowledge Management and Training Workstream and will be working with other members of the team, RBA stakeholders and external providers to analyse knowledge management and training requirements and help co-ordinate the development and rollout of new knowledge management and training arrangements and content.

The Payments Operations Program is a large, business led program which is working to: uplift the operating model and resourcing for the RITS ecosystem; strengthen shared services processes and IT controls that support RITS and related systems; and improve knowledge management processes and systems and related training programs for staff supporting RITS.

About the role

  • Work with RBA stakeholders to analyse and document detailed knowledge management and training requirements.
  • Develop new processes and procedures to support the rollout of a new knowledge management arrangements and training framework.
  • Help co-ordinate the build of new knowledge content and training material, working with RBA subject matter experts and external providers to assess, refine and implement new material.

title: Senior Cisco Network Engineer | Permanent or Contract | Melbourne
description:
Job title: Senior Network Engineer

Industry: ICT Networking

Country: AU

Location: Melbourne

Role type: Permanent or Contract

Experience: Senior

Are you interested in designing, implementing and supporting large and complex network installations?

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our team to design and deploy Cisco and Meraki network solutions. There’s plenty of variety in the work, and you’ll need a current CCNP certification at a minimum, along with strong experience across enterprise networking technologies including LAN, WAN and WLAN, with experience in technologies such as Cisco ISE. If you are a CCIE or have strong Meraki expertise, we would be particularly interested in hearing from you.

This opportunity is available as either a permanent position or a contract engagement, depending on the successful candidate’s preference and experience.

Ready to work with and learn some new networking technologies?

Are you a seasoned Network Engineer with experience in R&S, WLAN or ISE?

Looking to expand your experience with technologies such as Cisco Catalyst Center, SDA Fabric and more?

About Us

IPTel Solutions delivers networking professional services with a client base across Australia and New Zealand.

We currently have an opportunity for an experienced network and communications engineer to join our Melbourne team. You will be responsible for network design and delivery, working alongside our senior engineering team to deliver complex solutions for our customers.

You will have a genuine passion for networking, be a self-starter and be committed to continuous learning and keeping your technical skills current.

You will have the opportunity to work with new and emerging networking technologies, so an enthusiasm for learning, testing and developing your technical capability is important.

You will work alongside a team of like-minded engineers, while also being comfortable attending customer sites and operating independently when required.

About You

  • You are an experienced Senior Network Engineer with strong technical knowledge and a genuine passion for networking and engineering.
  • You have demonstrated experience designing, implementing and troubleshooting complex enterprise network solutions.
  • You are confident working directly with customers, from understanding technical requirements through to design, implementation and handover.
  • You have excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, and can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are capable of working independently on customer sites while also contributing effectively as part of a high-performing engineering team.
  • You take ownership of your work and can be relied upon to deliver projects to a high technical and professional standard.
  • You are committed to keeping your technical skills current and are willing to learn, study and obtain further industry certifications.
  • You have strong analytical and logical problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Specialist expertise in one or more networking technologies would be highly regarded, including Wi-Fi, SDA, ISE, Security, Meraki or SD-WAN.

Essential Criteria

  • Current CCNP certification at a minimum, with CCIE certification or equivalent advanced expertise highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated senior-level experience designing and delivering complex enterprise network solutions, including the ability to take a solution from design through configuration, implementation, testing and handover.
  • Strong hands-on experience across Cisco enterprise networking technologies, particularly LAN, WAN and/or WLAN.
  • Experience with Cisco ISE, Meraki, SDA, SD-WAN or enterprise Wi-Fi would be highly regarded.
  • Strong troubleshooting capability, with the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and take technical ownership of customer projects.
  • Strong customer-facing skills and the confidence to engage professionally with customers and stakeholders.
  • High levels of accuracy, documentation quality and attention to detail.
  • You must already have the right to live and work in Australia.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites as required, with a current driver's licence and access to your own vehicle.
  • You must be physically capable of undertaking the site requirements of the position, which may include low-level ladder work and attendance at building sites.
  • Strong computer skills, including intermediate to advanced Microsoft Word, Excel and Visio.

What's in it For You?

  • Work as part of a multi-state team delivering complex network solutions to enterprise customers
  • Exposure to the latest networking technologies, with training and support from our engineering team and technology vendors
  • Support for your professional development and certification aspirations. Looking to achieve your CCIE? We can help you get there
  • Access to an extensive training lab, including Cisco Catalyst Center and full SDA Fabric
  • A mix of working from home, the office and customer sites
  • Permanent or contract engagement options
  • For permanent employees, a salary of $160,000 to $185,000 + super, depending on experience, capability and certifications
  • Laptop, mobile phone and approved home-working equipment supplied

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an online engineering assessment as part of our recruitment process.

title: Manufacturing Test Engineer III
description:
Who will you be working with?

As a Manufacturing Test Engineer, you will collaborate with a cross-functional engineering team to develop and maintain tools, fixtures, and software that automate the testing of industrial electronics products. You will support both internal and external manufacturing and repair facilities, helping ensure product quality, reliability, and manufacturing efficiency.

How will you make a difference?

  • Collaborate with Quality, Operations, Lean, and Manufacturing Support teams to develop strategies, align resources, and drive execution.
  • Research, define, design, analyze, and validate production test solutions for new products.
  • Design, develop, and maintain test fixtures, tools, and software used for board-level and system-level manufacturing testing.

  • Experience working with Linux or Unix-based operating systems, including real-time operating systems such as QNX or FreeRTOS.
  • Knowledge of electronic circuits and hands-on experience using diagnostic equipment, including digital multimeters (DMMs), oscilloscopes, and other electronic test instruments.

title: Senior Optical Engineer
description:
About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on Senior Optical Engineer to join our System Optics Team. The team is responsible for defining, designing, delivering, and validating optical components and subsystems that meet product-level performance requirements.

This is a product engineering role rather than a pure R&D position. You will own optical components and subsystems from requirements definition and detailed design through qualification, manufacturing introduction, and sustaining support.

The successful candidate will lead lens and optical component design activities, including requirements and specification development, optical design and tolerancing, vendor execution, validation, and future-generation development. This role requires strong hands-on experience with optical design tools and lab-based optical testing and characterization.

What you'll do

  • Own optical design activities for lenses, windows, mirrors, and other optical components, including engineering requirements, specification definition, and requirements flow-down from system-level performance targets.
  • Develop and optimize optical designs using Zemax OpticStudio, CODE V, or equivalent tools, including optimization, tolerancing, sensitivity analysis, Monte Carlo analysis, performance modeling, and manufacturability assessment.
  • Lead optical design execution across internal engineering teams, external design consultants, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
  • Review and approve optical design deliverables, including prescriptions, tolerance analyses, Monte Carlo results, drawings, and supplier documentation.
  • Define specifications, acceptance criteria, and validation methods for optical components and assemblies.
  • Partner with optical suppliers and manufacturing teams to resolve design, fabrication, assembly, and performance issues.
  • Own optical designs from concept and prototype through qualification, NPI, and production support, including yield improvement, cost reduction, and sustaining engineering.
  • Plan and execute hands-on optical testing and characterization, including MTF, wavefront error (WFE), distortion, relative illumination, boresight, and stray-light measurements.
  • Correlate measured optical performance with simulation models, design assumptions, and specifications.
  • Lead future-generation optical design efforts, including architecture studies, trade-off analyses, technology evaluations, and next-generation optical solutions.
  • Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, firmware, DSP, software, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams to ensure optical designs meet system-level requirements.
  • Lead optical design reviews and clearly communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations.
  • Develop practical solutions that balance optical performance, manufacturability, cost, schedule, and product requirements.
  • Develop analysis and automation workflows in Python or equivalent tools to support design, tolerancing, test correlation, and data analysis.
  • Analyze optical performance data and drive root-cause investigation of issues such as aberrations, alignment sensitivity, stray light, ghosting, tolerance stack-up, and manufacturing variation.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. in Optical Engineering, Photonics, Physics, or a related field with 3–5+ years of relevant experience, or a bachelor's degree with 7+ years of relevant optical engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience in lens or optical system design.
  • Proficiency with Zemax OpticStudio, CODE V, or equivalent optical design and simulation software.
  • Strong fundamentals in geometrical and physical optics, imaging systems, aberration theory, and optical system engineering.
  • Experience defining optical requirements and specifications from system-level performance requirements.
  • Experience with optical tolerancing, sensitivity analysis, Monte Carlo analysis, and correlation between simulation and measured hardware performance.
  • Hands-on experience with optical testing, characterization, system bring-up, debugging, and validation.
  • Experience with lens manufacturing processes, optical materials, coatings, mechanical interfaces, and design-for-manufacturing considerations.
  • Experience supporting optical designs through qualification and manufacturing introduction.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading or technically managing optical design work performed by external consultants, optical suppliers, or manufacturing partners.
  • Experience supporting optical products through production, including yield improvement, cost reduction, and sustaining engineering.
  • Experience developing next-generation lens concepts, optical architectures, or system-level trade studies.
  • Experience with optical component and system measurements including MTF, WFE, distortion, relative illumination, boresight, and stray light.

title: Senior Java Engineer - South Bank, QLD
description:
At Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) our purpose is to 'open up the world for those who want to see'. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to experience something amazing – travel!

We're looking for a Senior Java Engineer to help us build and scale a travel platform relied on by some of Australia's largest corporate operators. This is not a full stack role, it's a deep backend engineering position for someone who genuinely enjoys the hard problems: complex, high availability systems that process high volume travel booking at scale.

You'll be a key technical contributor on capabilities that matter, building the backend systems that give travel consultants and managers one consistent, reliable way of managing trips for our customers, rather than a patchwork of workarounds and exceptions. You won't be maintaining someone else's legacy code in isolation; you'll be designing and building new capability from the ground up, including change and cancellation support, waitlist management, and deep policy engine integration, then owning it end to end in production. This is a chance to make decisions that stick: the architecture you choose, the standards you set, and the patterns you introduce will shape how the platform evolves for years to come.

Day to day:

Core Backend Development

  • Design, build, and own complex backend services and APIs using Java (Spring Boot / Spring Framework), with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and correctness
  • Deliver new modules including: change and cancellation processing, waitlist capability, and policy engine integration across the workforce travel platform
  • Implement & consume RESTful APIs and SOAP/Web Services that integrate with airline GDS systems, internal booking engines, and third‑party workforce platforms
  • Build robust, fault‑tolerant service components capable of handling high‑volume, time‑critical travel booking workflows

System Reliability & Observability

  • Ensure the platform maintains high uptime, this is a mission‑critical system for workforce travel operations; downtime has direct operational impact
  • Instrument services with Datadog, including APM tracing, custom metrics, log correlation, and dashboard creation to provide full observability across the travel workflow stack
  • Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs, respond to incidents, and lead post‑incident reviews to drive continuous reliability improvement
  • Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, memory issues, and degradation patterns before they impact customers

Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Lead technical design for new capabilities, producing clear architecture and API design documentation before implementation
  • Conduct rigorous code reviews and hold the team to high standards for API design, exception handling, test coverage, and service contract quality
  • Identify and reduce technical debt, particularly around legacy integration patterns, file‑based data exchange, and monolithic components
  • Mentor and support junior and mid‑level engineers, particularly on Java best practices, Spring internals, and API design

DevOps & Delivery

  • Champion DevOps practices across the team: CI/CD pipeline ownership, automated testing (unit, integration, contract), and deployment hygiene
  • Collaborate with platform and cloud engineering on Azure‑based infrastructure, ensuring services are containerised, scalable, and maintainable
  • Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate complex travel workflow requirements into clean, maintainable backend logic
  • Participate actively in agile delivery processes, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives and drive continuous improvement

You'll be perfect for the role if you have:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise in Java (Java 11+, ideally Java 17 or 21)
  • Proficient with AI coding tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) and able to critically evaluate AI‑generated code in production contexts
  • Expert‑level knowledge of the Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Spring Integration
  • Strong track record designing and building complex REST APIs and Web Services (SOAP/WSDL); including versioning, contract design, and error handling at scale
  • Proven ability to instrument and operate production systems using Datadog — APM, dashboards, monitors, log pipelines, and AI‑powered anomaly detection and forecasting features
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Sybase) including complex query optimisation and schema design

Highly Regarded

  • Experience in travel technology GDS systems (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo), NDC, PNR management, travel platforms
  • Background in workforce management, resource scheduling, FIFO logistics
  • Familiarity with API gateways, service mesh, microservices strategies
  • Azure cloud experience: App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Application Insights

Tech Stack

  • Java 17 / 21, Spring Boot, Spring Framework
  • REST APIs, SOAP / Web Services (WSDL), JSON, XML
  • Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Spring Integration
  • MySQL, Sybase, SQL query optimisation
  • Datadog (APM, dashboards, monitors, log pipelines, SLOs)
  • Azure (App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Storage)
  • GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, automated CI/CD pipelines
  • JUnit, Mockito, integration and contract testing

title: Fresh Foods Clerk
description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Assist customers by providing over-the-counter service and customer service throughout the Fresh Foods department. Operates and maintains the fresh food production areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza), prepares the areas for sales, fries food, operates the rotisserie oven, prepares ready-to-bake/baked pizzas, etc. Receives inventory, verifies receipt of ordered product, and stocks in designated areas. Consistently provides friendly, courteous service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work. Generally works 6-8 hour shifts between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve, and thank customers. Maintains an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Takes orders, answers questions, and performs suggestive selling.
  • Prepares, stocks, displays, straightens, and rotates product in fresh food areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza).
  • Prepare production items according to recipes, food safety procedures, and/or specified cooking times
  • Handles frozen product.
  • Inspects all product for quality and freshness
  • Prepares case by putting the product in fresh pans, rotating product, putting product back, filling, etc.
  • Places proper signage on all products which includes pricing, description, code dating, and COOL information on all required products.
  • Cleans and maintains department equipment such as fryers, slicers, etc. by breaking down and reassembling equipment, operating dish washer and hand washing dishes, cleaning all appropriate parts with sanitizing solution.
  • Maintains clean and sanitary department by washing parts, tables and wrapping stations; taking trash and paper to the appropriate balers; cleans floors and coolers; cleaning and maintaining glass display counters on the inside and out; etc.
  • Receives inventory, stocks, verifies receipt of ordered product and orders.
  • Follows strict sanitary guidelines and completes associated records.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or needed.
  • Understands and follows all food safety procedures and requirements.

Requirements

Ability to:

  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Communicate (hearing & speech) effectively with customers to receive orders and perform customer relation skills.
  • Conduct visual inspections, read and follow production guides, recipes and product labels, log production quantities, temperature readings, etc. on proper forms.
  • Perform basic math (add, subtract, divide and multiply) and compute weights and measures.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, equipment (e.g., knives) and work aides.
  • Complete training course and meet minimum time standards of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear hair net, beard net and gloves and other personal protective equipment as required.
  • Use cleaning chemicals and handle related food products.
  • Stand, walk and move rapidly for extended periods of time.
  • Bend, stoop, twist, turn and reach over the counter and in tight areas frequently.
  • Lift up to 50 lbs. occasionally and reach, push and pull racks.
  • Handle refrigerated goods (-20°F to 28°F)
  • Work around machinery emitting heat (400°F rotisserie and 325°F hot shortening).
  • Must be 16 years of age or older.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

Additional Requirements:

  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

Machines and Equipment Operated:

  • Cash Register
  • Film over wrapper, digital scales, etc.
  • Knives and other kitchen utensils.
  • Electric Slicers
  • Deep fryers, ovens, etc.
  • Oil filtering machine
  • Dishwasher
  • Trash compactor
  • Cardboard bailer
  • Hand, pallet jack
  • Conveyor ovens

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job. All employees must comply with Company policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and qualifications required of personnel may vary.

EEO/Inclusivity

As the WinCo Foods community continues to grow, our variety of perspectives and wide range of experiences are essential to our strategy and success. We are committed cultivating and celebrating an inclusive environment in which all employees are valued and respected.

About the role (What you'll be doing)

Key Skills:

  • Reliability and a strong work ethic.
